description:
HSBC Life is a world-class institution where you can specialize in Insurance but enjoy the advantages that come with being part of a leading global international bank. Insurance is about people, and the promises they make.At HSBC Life we help deliver on these promises by providing a wide variety of life insurance products and services to our clients throughout the Asia-Pacific Region. Our Employees enjoy a dynamic and innovative workplace and a world of opportunities to develop their careers in a high-profile growing business segment. We empower our team of high-performing individuals to build skills and explore new experiences to realise the full potential of being part of HSBC.Together we pursue efficient ways of working. We harness the latest data and technology solutions to achieve meaningful outcomes for our clients. The protection we offer creates broad and lasting impact, helping clients to be healthier, more productive and more confident in their futures.

We are currently seeking a high calibre professional to join our team as an Brokerage Business Development Manager.

In this role you will:

• Own growth of HSBC Life Brokerage Partnerships within the broker segment, delivering sustainable acquisition.

• Identify, prioritize and build a high-quality pipeline of broker opportunities.

• Lead end-to-end partnership execution: commercial proposition, business case, negotiation, contracting and onboarding.

• Develop and run joint go-to-market plans with brokers (sales enablement, training, case management) to drive measurable performance.

• Manage and deepen existing broker relationships through regular governance, performance reviews, issue resolution and optimization.

• Partner with internal stakeholders to deliver compliant, scalable solutions and a strong broker/client experience.

• Ensure partnerships meet regulatory, conduct and operational risk requirements, with appropriate controls, documentation and ongoing monitoring.

• Provide market intelligence and translate insights into partnership strategy and prioritization.

• Track and report performance against KPIs and drive continuous improvement.

• Act as a key contact person of HSBC to external partners, building credibility and long-term strategic relationships.

To be successful you will need:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, or a related field.

• Solid experience and understanding in life insurance products, market trends, and regulatory requirements, preferably in Broker channel business.

• Prior experience in business development, sales, or a related role within the insurance industry.

• Insurance related license is preferred, including completion of Insurance Intermediaries Qualifying Examination Paper 1,2,3 and compliance with related Continuing Professional Development (CPD) requirements

• Proven track record of achieving business growth and developing strategic partnerships.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

HSBCLife2026

description:
ICAP
ICAP, part of TP ICAP group, provides a wide variety of execution and information services to wholesale market participants.

We offer broking services covering a wide range of asset classes, including Commodities, Credit, Equities, FX, Money Market Funds and Rates.

Role Overview
We are looking for hungry individuals who flourish in a team environment. Individuals who are sociable and thrive in building long term relationships with clients, this is the right opportunity for you! You will be required to work in a fast paced energetic environment.

Role Responsibilities

• Promote TP ICAP Group.

• Provide complete support to the brokers for the smooth running of the desk.

• Ensure timely input of trades into trading systems.

• Resolve any trade queries received internally and externally, and ensure any trade discrepancies are resolved in a timely manner.

• Identify trade opportunities and calculate strategies.

• Keep trade records up to date.

• Update real-time manual / electronic whiteboards with market data.

• Provide input on various projects for brokers and traders.

• Provide trade details to brokers and traders on a daily basis.

• Give live quotes to traders through the messaging systems.

• Monitor markets and follow financial news and developments.

• Understand the underlying products being traded and keep up to date with knowledge of new products/procedures.

• Liaise with clients, (via telephone and face to face) to understand the business objectives of your clients as to provide a reliable and efficient broking service.

• Develop new business with existing clients and on-board new clients following the correct process with the Client On-Boarding team.

Experience / Competences
Essential

• Understands ideas and has a viewpoint on the markets and economy

• Willingness to engage with internal and external stakeholders outside of the immediate desk environment

• Experience in sales or broking

Desired

• Build relationships and networks with both internally and externally wherever possible.

• Demonstrates ability to work effectively with others.

• Seeks opportunities for improvements.

• Demonstrates high levels of energy in seeking out and achieving new goals.

• Self-starter who can use their own initiative.

• Ability to work effectively in a high-pressure environment, can keep emotions under control in difficult situations with proven resilience.

Job Band and Level

• Professional, 4

#LI-CL1

description:
About TP (Tullett Prebon)
A world-leading intermediary in the wholesale financial and energy markets, Tullett Prebon seeks to maximise value for its clients' trading activities across voice, hybrid and pure electronic channels.
We offer broking services for a wide range of asset classes, including Equities, Credit, FX, Rates and Insurance Derivatives.

Across all asset classes, Tullett Prebon offers e-solutions to give clients the choice to enter prices and execute trades electronically and directly via one of our hybrid electronic trading systems, or to engage with brokers to help identify and negotiate trades.

Role Overview
Tullett Prebon is looking for hungry individuals who flourish in a team environment. Individuals who are sociable and thrive in building long term relationships with clients, this is the right opportunity for you! Prior experience is not a prerequisite, as long as you have a keen interest in financial markets. You will be required to work in a fast paced energetic environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Promote Tullett Prebon (TP) as a company

• Provide complete support to the brokers for the smooth running of the desk

• Ensure timely input of trades into trading systems

• Resolve any trade queries received internally and externally, and ensure any trade discrepancies are resolved in a timely manner

• Identify trade opportunities and calculate strategies

• Keep trade records up to date.

• Update real-time manual / electronic whiteboards with market data

• Provide input on various projects for brokers and traders

• Provide trade details to brokers and traders on a daily basis

• Give live quotes to traders through the messaging systems

• Monitor markets and follow financial news and developments

• Understand the underlying products being traded and keep up to date with knowledge of new products/procedures

• Liaise with clients, (via telephone and face to face) to understand the business objectives of your clients as to provide a reliable and efficient broking service

• Develop new business with existing clients and on-board new clients following the correct process with the Client On-Boarding team

Experience / Competences
Essential

• Foundational understanding of financial markets, with exposure to equities or derivatives preferred

• Demonstrated interest in equity markets, trading strategies, and market‑driven environments

• Numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret and communicate market data effectively

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• High attention to detail and ability to work with precision under pressure

• Ability to perform in a fast‑paced, commercially driven trading environment

• Strong problem‑solving mindset and intellectual curiosity

• High ethical standards and commitment to responsible market conduct

Desired

• Basic understanding of options theory (e.g. Black‑Scholes, implied volatility, Greeks)

• Familiarity with financial market data platforms (e.g. Bloomberg, Refinitiv) or trading systems

• Additional European or global language skills

• Strong interpersonal and relationship‑building skills

• Interest in corporate events, earnings cycles, and equity‑specific catalysts

• High energy, resilience, and strong motivation to build a career in front‑office broking

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The SMB Account Executive team helps small and medium-sized businesses across Southeast Asia start and grow with Stripe. Based in Singapore, we work with prospective and existing customers to understand their business needs, identify opportunities across Stripe's product suite, and help them get more value from our platform. We pair a consultative approach with focused, efficient sales execution to acquire new users, drive product adoption, and grow and retain customer relationships.

What you'll do

As an SMB Account Executive based in Singapore, you'll manage the full sales cycle for new and existing SMB customers across Southeast Asia. You'll build pipeline, uncover customer needs, recommend relevant Stripe solutions, and close new business, expansion, and renewal opportunities. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to help customers succeed while developing your sales and product expertise.

Responsibilities

• Own the full sales cycle for SMB opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through commercial discussions and close.

• Build and manage a pipeline of new and existing customers through outbound prospecting, lead follow-up, research, and territory planning.

• Understand customers' business goals and pain points, and connect them with relevant solutions across Stripe's product suite.

• Drive growth within existing accounts by identifying opportunities for additional products, increasing adoption, and managing renewals.

• Deliver clear, compelling product walkthroughs and proposals that demonstrate how Stripe can support customers' goals.

• Manage multiple opportunities at high velocity, maintaining accurate pipeline records and forecasts.

• Partner with Solutions, Customer Success, Product, Risk, and Operations teams as needed to address customer needs and coordinate effective handoffs.

• Provide a thoughtful customer experience in every interaction, regardless of deal size, and share customer feedback to help improve our products and sales approach.

Who you are

We're looking for a curious, motivated seller who enjoys building relationships, solving customer problems, and working in a fast-paced environment. You're comfortable reaching out to prospective customers, learning technical concepts, and balancing new business opportunities with the growth of existing accounts.

If you meet the minimum requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 3+ years of relevant experience in sales or customer-facing roles.

• Ability to build pipeline through proactive outreach and manage sales opportunities from discovery through close.

• A consultative approach to understanding customer needs and communicating the value of relevant solutions.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate across internal and external teams.

• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple opportunities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience selling to or supporting customers in Southeast Asia.

• Experience selling SaaS, payments, or other technology products to SMB customers.

• Experience growing existing accounts through product adoption, upselling, or renewals.

• An interest in technology and familiarity with APIs, or a willingness to learn.

• Comfort using data and spreadsheets to evaluate pricing and communicate business value.

description:
About Grab and Our Workplace
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. Guided by The Grab Way and our four core values of Heart, Hunger, Honour, and Humility, our mission is to drive Southeast Asia forward by creating economic empowerment for everyone.

Get to Know the Team
Our IoT Growth and Strategy team develops key strategies and leads new strategic programs for Grab across IoT, Physical AI and emerging technologies. We shape business and operating models, build partnerships and test ideas in the field to scale programs across regional and global markets. Our work spans real-world data for AI, connected devices and services, fleet monetisation and new solutions for merchant operations. You will help build initiatives as they take shape, working with commercial, technical and Operations teams from early experimentation through real-world deployment.
Get to Know the Role
We are looking for an AI-native Program Manager with a strong sales operations focus. Based in Singapore on a definite contract, you will support regional and global revenue programs alongside the team lead and program owners. You will combine AI-enabled workflows with hands-on work with Operations teams, vendors and partners, owning delivery of assigned initiatives against agreed milestones and commercial outcomes.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

• Run assigned fleet, Physical AI and IoT revenue initiatives from pilot through commercial rollout. Turn agreed priorities into delivery plans and align teams on milestones, dependencies and outcomes.

• Build AI-assisted workflows for opportunity research, proposal preparation, follow-ups and program updates. Test and improve automations that reduce repetitive work and help the team act faster.

• Engage directly with Operations teams, vendors and partners through working sessions, site visits and pilots. Identify practical constraints, resolve delivery issues and turn field feedback into clear actions.

• Drive sales operations from qualified opportunity to launch, coordinating requirements, proposals, approved pricing inputs, contracting and onboarding with commercial teams, Legal, Finance and Procurement.

• Coordinate the commercialisation of IoT devices and services, including vendor readiness, sample testing, pilot execution and deployment handovers across markets.

• Use AI-enabled analysis and dashboards to identify pipeline bottlenecks, forecast revenue and monitor program outcomes. Work with Finance to connect delivery progress with billing and realised revenue.

• Support Physical AI delivery by translating customer requirements into collection or delivery plans with technical and Operations teams. Track quality, acceptance milestones and readiness for invoicing.

• Support Merchant Operations initiatives through hands-on discovery and pilot coordination. Work with merchants and country teams to test solutions and improve rollout and adoption.

• Keep delivery moving as requirements change. Bring options for resolving blockers, escalate key decisions early and build reusable playbooks from successful experiments and rollouts.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

• An AI-native way of working, with hands-on experience using AI assistants and workflow automation for research, analysis, commercial preparation and project execution. Be ready to explain a workflow you have built or improved.

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in program management, sales operations or commercial operations, with examples of delivering projects and solving practical problems.

• Commercial judgment and an understanding of how opportunities move from discovery and proposals through contracting, deployment and revenue realisation.

• Comfort working directly with Operations teams, vendors and partners, including site visits and pilot execution. You take initiative, ask practical questions and follow issues through to resolution.

• Ability to interpret data, validate AI outputs and build useful dashboards or simple prototypes, with sound judgment on accuracy and confidential information.

• Clear communication with commercial, technical and Operations teams. You can explain priorities, coordinate people across markets and follow through on commitments without formal authority.

• Ability to work through ambiguity, prioritise multiple initiatives and learn technical products quickly. Experience in B2B technology, Physical AI, IoT, hardware or merchant operations is an advantage.

Life at Grab
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

• We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.

• With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.

• Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave , and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave

• We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.

What we stand for at Grab
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

description:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.

As a member of our CRM Sales team you will have a major impact on our future success. CRM & Industry Solutions is a rapidly growing focus area for ServiceNow. Members of this team will have an opportunity to drive the growth engine for ServiceNow, along with support from the business unit and executive team

ServiceNow is seeking a CRM Account Executive that is a customer facing domain expert, that drives innovative business solutions with our customers
The CRM Account Executive will oversee market success of ServiceNow's CRM & Industry solutions. These products are built on our market leading Service Management platform and create a single source of truth that allows enterprise processes to execute with uniform information.
What you get to do in this role:
The CRM AE builds relationships with clients while achieving quarterly and annual sales quotas for an assigned territory.

• Developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory with a target prospect list, and a regional sales plan

• Arranging and conducting initial Executive and CxO discussions and positioning meetings; close collaboration with your Solution Consulting counterpart and extended team to deliver ‘art of the possible’ demonstrations showcasing ServiceNow’s CRM solution

• Sales process management and opportunity closure

• Ongoing account management to ensure customer satisfaction and drive additional revenue streams

• Support the regional ServiceNow partner channels to drive an effective customer experience

• Use internal technology to manage leads, providing accurate forecasting, territory plans, and goals

• Use Data Management through all sources such as CRM, social media, search engines and AI tools

• Occasional travel for training or meetings may be required

To be successful in this role you have:

• Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

• 10+ years in sales with success generating new business sales of enterprise-class Customer Experience or other Business solutions

• Experience selling into South East Asia Enterprise customers across Singapore, Thailand, Philippines, Indonesia and Malaysia is a must

• Advanced knowledge of sales force automation, customer service management, enterprise resource planning or other business application technologies would be ideal

• Experience with the sales process with the ability to navigate and progress short and long complex sales cycles

• Understanding of business sales processes

• Bachelor's degree in business, marketing or related discipline

• Travel required: 50%

Work Personas

Accommodations

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
Export Control Regulations

All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

description:
SLSQ427R275

This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a playbook. As the Go-to-Market Leader for APAC Retail & Consumer Goods, you will architect and execute a category-defining strategy from the ground up. You'll operate with the mindset of a founder of a hyper-growth enterprise—a rare opportunity that demands entrepreneurial instincts, relentless drive, and the courage to build in ambiguity.

Databricks is scaling at extraordinary speed. Databricks is the market share leader in data + AI in Retail & Consumer Goods, and this vertical represents one of the most significant growth opportunities in our portfolio. We need a leader who thrives in white space, who sees undefined territory not as risk but as canvas. You will shape how APAC’s largest retailers and consumer brands harness Data and AI to transform their operations, unlock new revenue streams, and reimagine customer experiences.

You will report to the Global VP of Consumer Industries, but your impact will extend across the entire organization—influencing product direction, shaping partner ecosystems, and setting the strategic agenda for one of our most consequential markets.

The impact you will have

• A Scalable APAC Growth Engine Design and execute a go-to-market strategy that doesn't yet exist in its final form. You’ll establish C-level relationships with flagship accounts, construct an ecosystem of ISVs, SIs, and alliance partners, and create repeatable motions that accelerate revenue growth across Retail, Consumer Goods, Restaurants, and Wholesale.

• Programmatic Opportunity Capture Identify the highest-value use cases and industry-specific opportunities—demand forecasting, unified customer intelligence, supply chain optimization, real-time pricing—and build scalable programs that systematically convert these opportunities into revenue. You won't pursue targets one at a time; you'll construct the engines, assets, and activation frameworks that allow us to capture entire categories of opportunity across the region simultaneously.

• A Partner Ecosystem from First Principles Identify, cultivate, and scale relationships with the partners who will amplify our reach. This isn't about managing existing relationships—it's about seeing what partnerships should exist and making them real.

• Data-Driven Operational Excellence Use rigorous analysis to surface gaps, inefficiencies, and untapped opportunities within our go-to-market approach. Build the feedback loops and improvement mechanisms that compound our effectiveness over time.

• Sales Plays That Travel Create comprehensive, scalable sales initiatives tailored to APAC’s diverse geographies while contributing frameworks that support Americas and EMEA. You'll work cross-functionally to ensure these plays move from concept to revenue.

• Industry Thought Leadership Establish Databricks as the authoritative voice in Retail & Consumer Goods transformation. Author white papers, command stages at premier industry events, and engage C-suite executives with a point of view that shapes how the market thinks about Data and AI.

• Cross-Functional Influence Serve as a trusted advisor across product, sales, pre-sales, marketing, and partner teams. Your credibility will be earned through results, and your influence will extend far beyond your formal remit.

• Market-Defining Content Collaborate with marketing to develop industry-specific collateral, demand generation campaigns, and event strategies that resonate with sophisticated enterprise buyers.

• Sales Team Acceleration Build enablement content and coaching programs that elevate the entire verticalized sales organization—making others more effective is as important as your direct contributions.

What we look for

• An Industry Insider with Builder DNA You've held senior leadership or practitioner roles in Retail or Consumer Goods. You understand the industry's challenges from the inside—but you're energized by building something new rather than optimizing what exists.

• Entrepreneurial by Nature You've operated in environments where the path wasn't paved. You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, moving quickly, and course-correcting based on market feedback. Ambiguity is where you do your best work.

• A GTM Architect You have extensive experience constructing vertical go-to-market programs on technology platforms, working cross-functionally to deliver measurable revenue growth and customer value.

• An Executive Relationship Builder You engage naturally with CXOs and senior business leaders. You create trust through substance, not just polish, and you know how to translate technical capability into strategic business value.

• A Transformation Leader You've led large-scale change initiatives and understand both the technical and human dimensions of enterprise transformation in complex organizations.

• Technically Fluent You possess deep familiarity with the data and AI landscape, retail technology standards, and the broader ecosystem trends reshaping the industry.

• Regulatory Aware You understand key APAC regulatory environments—such as data privacy, payments, sustainability, and sector-specific compliance—and can navigate these considerations in strategic conversations.

• A Program Operator You've managed complex vertical initiatives end-to-end: gathering requirements, coordinating technical teams, driving marketing alignment, and managing partner relationships to hit milestones.

• A Force Multiplier You have proven ability to train and enable sales teams, making the entire organization more effective at positioning solutions to Retail & Consumer Goods customers.

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

About the role

We are looking for a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to build qualified pipeline across assigned accounts and markets. You will work with Account Executives, Marketing, and partners to identify the right prospects, understand their priorities, and create useful first conversations about Okta.

The person who succeeds in this role combines thoughtful prospecting with strong follow-through. You are comfortable working across inbound and outbound sales, using research and AI tools to work more effectively, and adapting your approach to different industries, people, and business needs. You are also curious about how partners contribute to customer relationships and business growth.

What you’ll do

• Qualify, follow up with, and develop inbound leads across assigned accounts.

• Research companies, industries, and contacts to plan relevant outbound outreach.

• Use calls, email, and other approved channels to start conversations and create qualified meetings for Account Executives.

• Listen carefully to understand a prospect’s business context, priorities, and reasons for exploring a solution.

• Record clear and accurate notes in Salesforce and other sales tools, and provide a useful handoff to the Account Executive & forecast to the leadership.

• Work with Account Executives to plan account outreach, coordinate follow-up, and support progress from initial interest to qualified opportunity.

• Partner with Marketing and Channel teams on campaigns, events, and partner-related opportunities.

• Represent Okta at in-person and online events, and follow up with attendees in a timely and relevant way.

• Use AI tools to support account research, preparation, and outreach. Review AI-generated content for accuracy, relevance, and appropriate use.

• Track your activity and results, meet agreed targets, and use performance data to improve your approach.

• Share useful practices, learnings, and market insights with the team.

What you’ll bring

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in corporate sales, inside sales, business development, or lead generation, including inbound and outbound prospecting.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills. Additional ASEAN language skills are a plus.

• Familiarity with partnership ecosystems and an understanding of how partners can support customer engagement and business growth.

• Confidence using AI tools in a professional setting, with the judgment to check outputs and use them responsibly.

• The ability to research an account, prepare thoughtful questions, and tailor outreach to the person you are contacting.

• A customer-focused approach and the ability to connect customer needs with relevant solutions.

• Strong organization and follow-through, including accurate record keeping and timely handoffs.

• A proactive, resilient approach to learning and working through challenges.

• The ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, changing environment and take ownership of your goals.

• Willingness to work from the Singapore office Monday through Thursday.

It would be helpful if you also have

• Experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, or enterprise software.

• Experience working with customers, prospects, or partners across Asia.

• Experience using Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo or similar sales engagement tools.

• Experience supporting event follow-up or partner-led sales activity.

Additional Information About the Role

• Start date: January, 2027

• Office schedule: In the Singapore office Monday through Thursday

• Work authorization: Candidates must already be authorized to work in Singapore. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Renewals Account Manager to join our team. This is a remote role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Renewals in the Renewals department. You will join a global group of professionals passionate about driving a secure, cloud-enabled digital future as a leader in cloud security. You will demonstrate the power and agility of cloud transformation by managing a high volume of renewals, aligning with cross-functional teams, and contributing directly to customer retention and success.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

•
Manage the timely renewal of contracts for customers in the commercial segment with $50K and lower ARR, adapting to threshold changes based on evolving business needs

•
Take total ownership of the renewal process, ensuring exceptional experiences and high satisfaction levels for both customers and partners throughout a high-volume renewal ecosystem

•
Identify and qualify commercial opportunities while developing and maintaining trusted partner relationships with key internal stakeholders across Deal Desk, Pricing, Customer Success, and Sales Operations

•
Drive adoption of modern AI tools to efficiently manage tasks, optimize daily workflows, and maximize productivity to consistently meet and exceed targets within a variable compensation model

• Identify growth opportunities by developing a strong foundational understanding of Zscaler products to successfully migrate legacy contracts to current SKUs and hand off potential upsell opportunities to Account Executives

Who You Are (Success Profile)

•
You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

•
You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

•
You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

•
You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

•
You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

•
Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

•
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience

• 3+ years of experience in high-volume renewals, sales, customer retention, or account management environments

•

Proven ability to efficiently manage a large volume of concurrent commercial transactions while consistently hitting performance and financial targets

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

•
Advanced ,active use of AI within your role to drive deeper data insights, elevate personal productivity, and uplift the overall quality of work for yourself and your team

•
Prior knowledge of Zscaler’s product portfolio, operational tools, and commercial contracting frameworks

description:
WHO WE ARE:

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

Why join
Be part of a dynamic organization that is at the forefront of transaction banking innovation.

What you do

As an Implementation Manager for Transaction Banking Products, you will be responsible for overseeing the successful implementation and integration of our transaction banking solutions, including API, H2H, and SWIFT. With a minimum of 2 years of experience in the banking industry, you will play a crucial role in ensuring a seamless onboarding experience for our clients, while collaborating closely with internal stakeholders.

• Manage end-to-end implementation projects for transaction banking products, including API, H2H, and SWIFT.

• Collaborate with clients to understand their specific requirements and develop tailored implementation plans.

• Coordinate with internal teams, such as Sales, product management & development, legal, operations, and technical support, to ensure smooth execution of implementation projects.

• Provide guidance and support to clients throughout the implementation process, addressing any concerns or issues that may arise.

• Conduct regular status meetings with clients to track progress, address challenges, and ensure timely delivery of solutions.

• Provide handover and training to client services team after implementation.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas for process improvement and contribute to the enhancement of implementation methodologies.

• Stay updated on industry trends, regulations, and best practices related to transaction banking products, and share knowledge with the team.

• Drive innovation and process improvements to improve productivity and client experience.

Reporting to Implementation Team Lead, Implementation & Client Services

Who you are

• Bachelor’s degree in business, banking & finance, or a related field is preferred.

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in the banking industry, specifically in transaction banking or related roles.

• Strong knowledge of transaction banking products, including API, H2H, and SWIFT.

• Proven experience in managing end-to-end implementation projects, preferably in a banking or financial services environment.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen attention to detail.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, managing multiple projects simultaneously.

• Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools.

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements and industry standards related to transaction banking products.

• Mature, diligent, outcomes-driven, self-starter, all-round team-player

Who you work with
Global Transaction Banking Division offers cash management, trade finance and supply chain finance solutions. To SMEs. Large corporations. Financial
institutions. And government entities across the region. It’s all about making banking simpler. And more convenient. For corporate customers. And their
customers. For you, it’s all about building your career in a business that is building a reputation for breaking new ground by innovating at the intersection of technology and customer-centricity.

What we offer:

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

description:
Sales Specialist SaaS

About the Team

Rubrik's Product Line Sales organization drives focused growth across Rubrik's specialized workloads, including our SaaS data protection and security portfolio (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, and other critical SaaS applications). This team partners closely with core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success to bring deep product and technical expertise into every SaaS opportunity — from first conversation through technical validation to close. The Role We're hiring a SaaS Product Line Sales Specialist to own and accelerate Rubrik's SaaS data protection business within a defined territory. This is a highly technical, quota-carrying overlay role: you'll be the subject-matter expert who can go deep on tenant architecture, identity and access models, backup and recovery mechanics, and the shared responsibility model — and use that fluency to win deals against SaaS-native point solutions. The ideal candidate has sold in this exact space before and understands both the buyer and the competitive landscape intimately

The Role

We're hiring a SaaS Product Line Sales Specialist to own and accelerate Rubrik's SaaS data protection business within a defined territory. This is a highly technical, quota-carrying overlay role: you'll be the subject-matter expert who can go deep on tenant architecture, identity and access models, backup and recovery mechanics, and the shared responsibility model — and use that fluency to win deals against SaaS-native point solutions. The ideal candidate has sold in this exact space before and understands both the buyer and the competitive landscape intimately.

What You’ll Do

• Own the SaaS product line number: partner with core Account Executives to identify, qualify, and close SaaS data protection and security opportunities across net-new and existing accounts.

• Lead with technical credibility: articulate Rubrik’s SaaS architecture, security posture, and the gaps in Microsoft’s and Google’s native shared responsibility model in a way that resonates with both technical and business buyers.

• Drive technical discovery and validation: run or co-lead discovery calls, demos, and proof-of-concept engagements for M365, Google Workspace, and Salesforce workloads alongside Sales Engineers. • Win competitive deals: build and defend positioning against SaaS-native vendors, translating technical differentiation into business value.

• Build territory and account plans: develop a coverage strategy in partnership with core sales, SE, and channel teams to maximize SaaS attach and expansion within the install base.

• Engage multiple stakeholders: present to IT administrators, security and compliance teams, and executive economic buyers, tailoring the message to each audience.

• Forecast with discipline: maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in Salesforce and participate in regular business reviews.

• Stay current: maintain deep knowledge of Rubrik’s SaaS roadmap, the M365/Google Workspace/Salesforce ecosystems, and the competitive landscape.

What You’ll Bring

• SaaS sales experience: 3+ years of quota-carrying sales experience selling SaaS data protection, security, or governance solutions for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or Salesforce environments.

• Directly relevant background: experience at a SaaS data protection or management vendor is strongly preferred.

• Genuine technical depth: comfortable discussing tenant architecture, APIs, identity and access management (Entra ID/Azure AD), backup and recovery mechanics, and security and compliance frameworks without relying solely on a Sales Engineer.

• Proven technical selling motion: a track record of running or co-leading technical discovery and proof-of-concept engagements, not just handing off to a technical resource.

• Consultative approach: comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across IT, security, and executive buyers in mid-market and enterprise accounts.

• Overlay/specialist experience: prior success working in a platform-selling model alongside core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success.

• Track record: consistent history of quota attainment and strong pipeline generation.

• Education: bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

• Hands-on familiarity with Microsoft 365 administration, Entra ID/Azure AD, or Salesforce administration.

• Experience selling a data security or resiliency platform that spans SaaS, cloud, and on-premises workloads.

• Existing relationships with IT, security, or compliance buyers in target accounts

Why Rubrik

Rubrik is a leader in data security and cyber resilience, helping the world's leading organizations secure and recover their data from cyberattacks and operational disruptions. Joining the Product Line Sales organization means working at the intersection of deep technical expertise and high-growth sales — with the backing of Rubrik's platform, brand, and go-to-market engine.
Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

About this role

What team will you be on?
The regional APAC ex-Japan Request for Proposal (RFP) function within APAC Institutional Client Business oversees strategic proposal development and drives coordination across Institutional distribution channels, playing a key role in securing new business. Based in Hong Kong, the team collaborates closely with colleagues across Institutional Client Business, product strategy, and other business functions to provide high-quality, consistent, and cohesive quantitative and qualitative information to prospects and consultants.

Why is your role important?
The RFP Writer (Associate) leads the drafting of detailed proposals for major institutional APAC ex-Japan clients across a diverse range of BlackRock’s products, playing a vital role in winning new business. The role requires a strong understanding of BlackRock’s offerings, strategies, structure, and unique selling points to convey these effectively in RFPs and other new business-related documents to secure assets. The role offers considerable exposure to a wide range of products and key internal clients, particularly in APAC ex-Japan, and the opportunity to build a high profile and develop within the business over the medium term.

What will you be doing?

• Managing RFPs within a defined scope, delivering consistent, high-quality, and timely responses in collaboration with key stakeholders on a diverse range of products, including alternatives, equity, fixed income, multi-asset investments, and custom solutions

• Representing the team professionally with colleagues, clients, and stakeholders, making sound decisions within the role’s scope and escalating risks appropriately

• Supporting the training of junior RFP writers in the region through expertise and partnership, while liaising with global peers to maintain consistent global practices

• Partnering with product strategy teams to build growing subject matter expertise in how they invest money on behalf of clients

• Refreshing and improving RFP Q&A database content on an ongoing basis, and playing a key role in its continuous improvement

• Contributing ideas and insights that improve execution, and contributing to team projects, including designing solutions with long-term impact and using AI-enabled tools to streamline work, reduce manual effort, and increase team efficiency

What are we looking for?

• A degree and 3+ years of financial services experience. Prior experience as a RFP writer is highly preferred

• High standards of excellence, urgency, and accountability, with the ability to prioritize effectively across multiple RFPs and deliver high-quality work against hard deadlines

• A commitment to continuously building skills, adopting new ways of working, and embracing new technology to improve how work gets done

• A “we before me” approach as a trusted, reliable team player who leads with empathy and respect, seeks diverse input, proactively shares information, and contributes to a connected and inclusive culture

• Analytical depth and strong attention to detail in written and numerical content, and the ability to communicate with clarity, transparency, and integrity, escalating risk concerns early

• Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Sound investment knowledge across asset classes and advanced Microsoft Excel and Word

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com . We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn , Instagram , YouTube , X , and TikTok .

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

description:
WHO WE ARE:

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

Why Join
As a Business Banking Sales professional at OCBC, you'll have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of entrepreneurs and business owners. You'll help them achieve their goals, grow their businesses, and create lasting value. If you're passionate about sales, enjoy building relationships, and are driven to succeed, this role is for you.

How you succeed
To excel in this role, you'll need to truly understand the needs and desires of our business customers. You'll build long-term relationships, identify opportunities, and provide tailored solutions to help them grow and succeed. You'll also need to stay up-to-date with market trends, industry developments, and regulatory changes to provide expert advice and guidance.

What you do

• Solicit new commercial property loan opportunities through building of strong referrals from channels such as Property agents, brokers etc.

• Understand the business life cycle of small businesses to help them expand their reach and provide prudent financial solutions to support the companies’ growth

• Demonstrate good credit acumen with ability to mitigate financing risk to ensure robustness of our credit portfolio

• Strong cross team collaborations with internal and external stakeholders to nurture and grow new business and partnership opportunities

Who you work with
Global Commercial Banking serves the entire spectrum of customer segments, from large corporations to government entities and small to medium-sized enterprises. Our team offers simple, convenient, and innovative solutions that take care of everything, from cash management to trade finance. As a Business Development Manager in Emerging Business Sales, you will be part of a dynamic team that is dedicated to helping our customers achieve their business goals.

Who you are

• Degree holder, with min. 1-2 years of credit and sales experience covering local SMEs preferred

• Fervent individual who is self-driven and possesses the willingness to take on additional initiatives to drive the overall business strategy.

• Strong interpersonal skills, with ability to connect with customers

• Sound analytical skills with ability to interpret and analyse company financial

• Passionate individual who is innovative and enjoys a dynamic work environment

• Highly focused, driven and results-oriented individual

What we offer:

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Stripe, you will drive Stripe’s future growth engine by working with Demand Gen and the Account Executive team to qualify leads and collaboratively build Stripe’s sales pipeline. You get excited about engaging with prospects to better qualify needs. You are adept at identifying high value opportunities and capable of managing early sales funnel activities.You are used to delivering value in complex situations and are energized by learning about new and existing products. Finally, you enjoy building – you like to actively participate in the development of the demand generation and sales process, the articulation of Stripe’s value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets. If you’re hungry, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

For the first months, you’ll be part of the SD Associate program which is designed to accelerate your onboarding and ramp to full productivity as an SDR. This intensive program is built to help you quickly build and develop skills required to be successful in this role. Upon completion, you’ll continue learning and growing in your career as part of Stripe’s Sales Development Academy. These programs are endorsed and supported by sales leaders as an important part of investing in our people.

We take a data driven, analytical approach to sales development, and are looking for someone who is confident in both prospecting to customers and in helping design our strategy. If you’re hungry, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

• Research and create outreach materials for high value prospects, in partnership with SDRs and AEs

• Follow up with Marketing generated leads to qualify as sales opportunities. Move solid leads through the funnel connecting them to a salesperson, and arranging meetings

• Execute outbound sales plays created by marketing

• Initiate contact with potential customers through cold-calling or responding to inquiries generated from Marketing

• Develop relationships with prospects to uncover needs through effective questioning to qualify interest and viability to prepare hand-off to sales

• Follow-up with potential customers who expressed interest but did not initially result in a sales opportunity

• Effectively work through lead list meeting/exceeding SLAs, consistently update activity and contact information within the CRM system and support weekly reporting efforts

• Collaborate and provide feedback and insights to Marketing to help improve targeting and messaging

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• A track record of top performance or prior success

• Superior verbal and written communication skills

• Self starter who is able to operate in a hyper growth environment

• This role requires in-office participation three (3) days per week in our Singapore office

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

description:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.

As a member of our CRM Sales team you will have a major impact on our future success. CRM & Industry Solutions is a rapidly growing focus area for ServiceNow. Members of this team will have an opportunity to drive the growth engine for ServiceNow, along with support from the business unit and executive team

ServiceNow is seeking a CRM Account Executive that is a customer facing domain expert, that drives innovative business solutions with our customers
The CRM Account Executive will oversee market success of ServiceNow's CRM & Industry solutions. These products are built on our market leading Service Management platform and create a single source of truth that allows enterprise processes to execute with uniform information.
What you get to do in this role:
The CRM AE builds relationships with clients while achieving quarterly and annual sales quotas for an assigned territory.

• Developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory with a target prospect list, and a regional sales plan

• Arranging and conducting initial Executive and CxO discussions and positioning meetings; close collaboration with your Solution Consulting counterpart and extended team to deliver ‘art of the possible’ demonstrations showcasing ServiceNow’s CRM solution

• Sales process management and opportunity closure

• Ongoing account management to ensure customer satisfaction and drive additional revenue streams

• Support the regional ServiceNow partner channels to drive an effective customer experience

• Use internal technology to manage leads, providing accurate forecasting, territory plans, and goals

• Use Data Management through all sources such as CRM, social media, search engines and AI tools

• Occasional travel for training or meetings may be required

To be successful in this role you have:

• Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

• 10+ years in sales with success generating new business sales of enterprise-class Customer Experience or other Business solutions

• Experience selling into South East Asia Enterprise customers across Singapore, Thailand, Philippines, Indonesia and Malaysia is a must

• Advanced knowledge of sales force automation, customer service management, enterprise resource planning or other business application technologies would be ideal

• Experience with the sales process with the ability to navigate and progress short and long complex sales cycles

• Understanding of business sales processes

• Bachelor's degree in business, marketing or related discipline

• Travel required: 50%

Work Personas
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here . To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
Equal Opportunity Employer
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
Accommodations
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
Export Control Regulations
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

description:
As a Client Success Analyst reporting to the Head of APAC Client Success, you'll play a critical role in helping institutional investors and investment managers unlock the full value of Dasseti's platform — supporting ESG data collection, sustainability reporting, and portfolio-level insights at every stage of the investment lifecycle.

You'll thrive in this position if you're client-focused, analytically minded, and bring a genuine passion for ESG and sustainable finance to a fast-paced, high-impact fintech environment. While this role will cover a broad range of clients within the investment management industry, there will be a focus on ESG clients.

Key Responsibilities

• Guide clients through onboarding and platform adoption, configuring end-to-end workflows (entity management, questionnaires, portfolio structures, data analytics and reporting).

• Advise clients on how to align platform configuration with key ESG frameworks and regulations, including TCFD, SFDR (PAI indicators), EDCI, and PCAF financed emissions methodologies.

• Act as the primary point of contact for functional and technical queries, bridging client needs and internal data, reporting, and product teams.

• Lead investigation and resolution of data incidents, tracing root causes across system logs, audit trails, and portfolio imports.

• Contribute to client retention and growth by participating in business reviews, identifying expansion opportunities, and proactively managing client health.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Environmental Science, Sustainability, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3-5 years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role within a SaaS environment.

• Demonstrable experience with ESG and sustainability data, carbon accounting, or sustainability reporting frameworks (e.g., TCFD, SFDR, EDCI, GHG Protocol, PCAF).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex client requirements into practical platform solutions.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis and reporting.

• Clear communicator with excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a global, fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Power BI or similar business intelligence tools, including data dictionaries and data models.

• Familiarity with industry classification systems (e.g., NACE, GICS) and investment structures (funds, entities, look-through).

• A relevant ESG qualification (e.g., CFA Certificate in ESG Investing) or experience supporting institutional investors and senior client stakeholders.

This position will be located in Hong Kong and offers the opportunity for a hybrid work environment at least 3 days a week in-office, subject to change.

Benefits & Rewards
We offer a competitive, well-rounded rewards package designed to support the financial, physical, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families (where applicable).

We utilize a structured job architecture and career framework to ensure growth opportunities are transparent, fair, and accessible to all employees.

Come as You Are

Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

description:
A Career with Point72's Market Intelligence Team

On our proprietary research team—Market Intelligence—you’ll partner with our investment professionals and Compliance team to work with alternative data to uncover insights about companies, industries, and the broader economy through deep fundamental research and applying data science and engineering techniques. You’ll work alongside a talented team with diverse skills, backgrounds, and perspectives. Our industry researchers, product managers, and data scientists and engineers work together to build compliant research products. We look for other bright, motivated, and collaborative people to join our team and grow with us—a majority of the leaders in our group were promoted from within.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Shape artificial intelligence product initiatives that help investment and business teams across Asia-Pacific work more efficiently and generate stronger insights
• Serve as a hub resource in Singapore for Investment Services APAC, partnering across Macro, Cubist Systematic Strategies, Market Intelligence, CDS, and Finance
• Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, workflows, and success measures for artificial intelligence-enabled tools
• Analyze user feedback, adoption patterns, and operational pain points to identify high-impact opportunities for automation and workflow improvement
• Partner with researchers, data professionals, engineers, and control functions to advance approved ideas from discovery through delivery
• Support prioritization of a cross-business product pipeline by assessing impact, feasibility, dependencies, and readiness for adoption
• Coordinate testing, documentation, user training, and rollout activities to help teams adopt new capabilities with confidence
• Monitor product performance after launch and recommend refinements that improve accuracy, usability, and business value
• Communicate product progress, risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders across functions and seniority levels

WHAT'S REQUIRED

• At least two years of experience in product analysis, business analysis, data analytics, or artificial intelligence-enabled product delivery
• Experience supporting stakeholders across APAC business functions, ideally in a Singapore-based role or regional hub environment
• Understanding of artificial intelligence product concepts, including use case discovery, requirements gathering, testing, adoption tracking, and performance measurement
• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate workflows, interpret data, and translate findings into practical product recommendations
• Ability to document business requirements, process flows, user feedback, and acceptance criteria clearly and logically
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain product concepts to technical and nontechnical stakeholders
• Strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment
• Commitment to the highest ethical standards

WE TAKE CARE OF OUR PEOPLE

We invest in our people, their careers, their health, and their well-being. When you work here, we provide:

• Health care benefits

• Generous parental and family leave policies

• Mental and physical wellness programs

• Volunteer opportunities

• Support for employee-led affinity groups representing women, minorities and the LGBT+ community

• Tuition assistance

ABOUT POINT72

Point72 is a leading global alternative investment firm led by Steven A. Cohen. Building on more than 30 years of investing experience, Point72 seeks to deliver superior returns for its investors through fundamental and systematic investing strategies across asset classes and geographies. We aim to attract and retain the industry's brightest talent by cultivating an investor-led culture and committing to our people's long-term growth. For more information, visit https://point72.com/.
