description:
About Grab and Our Workplace
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Get to Know the Team
The F&B Merchant Acquisition team oversees, shapes, and grows the merchant business in Grab Singapore.
We partner with restaurants and businesses to help them grow their customer base, increase sales and visibility, and succeed both online and offline.
Get to Know the Role
You will help restaurants adopt Grab's suite of business solutions designed to increase revenue, improve customer engagement, and improve daily operations. As Grab continues to expand its merchant ecosystem, you will help merchants identify growth opportunities through a broader suite of business solutions across both online and offline channels.
These solutions include:

• Table management solutionsDeals, loyalty and customer engagement tools

• Food delivery

• QR ordering

• Digital payment solutions

• Advertising and promotional solutions

• Customer insights and CRM tools

You will work directly with restaurant owners and important decision-makers, helping them identify opportunities to grow their business through Grab's ecosystem and recommending suitable solutions to support their commercial goals.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys looking for new business, building relationships, solving merchant challenges, and making an impact on business growth.
You will report to the Manager, Merchant Sales and be based onsite at Grab Singapore.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

• Identify and acquire new restaurant partners through cold calling, networking, referrals, field prospecting, and face-to-face meetings

• Build and manage a strong pipeline of sales opportunities with disciplined CRM and pipeline management

• Understand merchants' business challenges and growth priorities, and recommend suitable Grab solutions to support their growth

• Conduct sales presentations, negotiations, and contract discussions with business owners and important decision-makers

• Build long-term relationships with merchants and identify future growth opportunities across Grab's ecosystem

• Work with Operations, Marketing, and Account Management teams to ensure successful onboarding and adoption of Grab solutions

• Contribute ideas and initiatives to improve sales processes, team effectiveness, and overall business performance, team effectiveness, and overall business performance

What Essential Skills You Will Need

• 0-3 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, merchant acquisition, or other client-facing commercial roles

• Proven experience in prospecting, hunting, and acquiring new business opportunities, in a consultative way

• Experience establishing communication and engagement with prospects, with the ability to engage business owners and decision-makers

• Understand merchant needs and recommend suitable business solutions

• Thrives in fast-paced, target-driven environments and takes strong ownership of responsibilities

Life at Grab
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

• We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.

• With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.

• Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave , and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave

• We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.

• Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For at Grab
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Hong Kong, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About The Opportunity

We're looking for a hands-on product manager to drive growth across our platform's trading and asset business — spot, perpetuals, TradFi, and beyond. You'll ship the product features behind our growth programs, run the campaigns (including token-listing campaigns) that power them, and grow the trading volume and assets they generate — owning the full lifecycle from requirements and delivery through launch, execution, data, and iteration.

What You’ll Be Doing

•
Drive product feature delivery. Own the end-to-end delivery of related product features — requirement grooming, UI/UX reviews, tracking dev and QA progress, and launch acceptance — to ship on time and at high quality.

•
Run campaigns end-to-end. Set up, configure, and manage the full lifecycle of marketing campaigns — including token-listing campaigns, new-token Staking, and related Campaigns — ensuring each integrates smoothly with the underlying product features.

•
Grow trading volume and assets through campaigns. Use campaigns and incentives to grow trading volume across the platform's asset categories (spot, perpetuals, TradFi); design and rapidly iterate growth mechanics with clear hypotheses, validate them against real data, and tailor the lever to each category's users and mechanics.

•
Own channel attribution and analysis. Build and maintain channel attribution — breaking trading volume down by channel, campaign, and incentive — and use data analysis to run volume breakdowns, channel ROI, and user segmentation to find the highest-leverage opportunities and guide resource allocation.

•
Monitor and optimize. Track real-time data during launches and campaigns — user engagement and conversion funnels — respond quickly to anomalies and risk-control alerts, and produce regular retrospective reports.

What We Look For In You

•
3+ years in product management, growth, or campaign operations — ideally with trading or fintech products.

•
Strong data analysis skills; able to reach conclusions independently from data and turn them into decisions.

•
Solid understanding of trading products (spot, derivatives, TradFi) and their users.

•
Comfortable driving execution across functions and keeping many moving parts on track.

•
Fast and decisive under ambiguity; a clear communicator who can turn complex data into recommendations leadership can act on.

Nice-To-Haves

•
Crypto-native or fintech background.

•
Genuine interest in trading, with hands-on trading experience.

•
Global market growth experience.

•
Comfortable leveraging AI tools to boost output.

Perks & Benefits

•
Competitive total compensation package

• L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•
Various team building programs and company events

• Wellness and meal allowances

• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX 's Candidate Privacy Notice .

description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role Elastic, the Search AI company, is looking for a high-energy Enterprise Account Executive to drive net-new revenue and expansion within strategic Enterprise accounts. You’ll be the owner of a defined territory where you’ll build your own pipeline, tell the Elastic Search AI story, and close complex, multi-stakeholder deals in a consumption-based model. This role sits at the intersection of sales execution, technical fluency, and cross-functional collaboration—and is critical to our growth in the Enterprise segment.

What You Will Be Doing

•
Own your territory & build pipeline: Develop and execute a proactive outbound cadence (email, call, social) that generates ≥50 % of your booked opportunities.

•
Deep discovery & qualification: Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like MEDDPICC so you chase only the highest-confidence deals.

•
Value storytelling & demos: Craft and deliver tailored narratives and live demos that map Elastic’s Search, Observability, and Security capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

•
Mutual deal strategy & forecast accuracy: Collaborate with customers to build formal close plans and keep your CRM up-to-date, maintaining ≥90 % forecast accuracy within ±10 %.

•
Executive negotiation & closing: Lead high-stakes contract and pricing discussions—defend your value, structure give/get trades, and land multi-year consumption commitments.

•
Domain & cloud acumen: Position Elastic as the Search AI platform of choice by speaking fluently about cloud economics, usage-based pricing, and modern data architectures.

•
Cross-functional partnership: Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and RevOps to accelerate deals and drive exceptional customer outcomes.

What You Bring

•
Proven SaaS quota‐carrying success: 5+ years closing complex Enterprise deals, consistently overachieving targets in a consumption-based or usage-model environment.

•
Expert discovery & qualification skills: Demonstrated ability to apply MEDDPICC or equivalent frameworks to drive disciplined pipeline and eliminate low-probability deals.

•
Compelling value storytellers: Track record of delivering executive-level presentations and demos that tie product capabilities to real dollars saved, revenue gained, or risk mitigated.

•
Strong negotiation chops: History of landing multi-year, high-ACV contracts while protecting margin and securing executive stakeholder buy-in.

•
Technical & cloud fluency: Comfortable discussing a broad range of technical topics including observability, security, vector/traditional search, and cloud cost optimization.

•
Collaborative mindset & coachability: A learner who partners effectively with internal teams, incorporates feedback, and embodies Elastic’s values of community and openness.

•
Open Source enthusiasm: Genuine appreciation for open-source communities and the Elastic model—bonus if you’ve sold or advocated in an OSS context.

Bonus Points

•
Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.

•
Familiarity with observability (logs, metrics, traces) or security analytics (SIEM/XDR) use cases.

If you’re driven to build your own pipeline, master complex deal cycles, and help customers unlock the power of Search AI, we’d love to talk. Apply today!

description:
About this role

Your team
The Japan Wealth team serves a broad range of intermediary clients, including securities firms, banks and other wealth distribution partners, providing investment solutions and services across asset classes.
Within the team, this Tokyo-based role focuses on investment communication, investor education and content delivery, helping financial advisors and investors better understand markets, investment opportunities and portfolio solutions.

Your role and impact
BlackRock Japan is seeking an Associate to support the continued growth of our Wealth business through client education, investment communication, content development, and wholesale distribution engagement.
This is a specialist wholesale role focused on investment communication, client engagement, and investor education rather than traditional relationship management. You will have the opportunity to represent BlackRock externally, delivering presentations, training programs, seminars, digital content, and investment insights for financial advisors and investors across Japan.
Success in this role will reflect both commercial contribution and the ability to educate, engage, and inspire audiences through impactful communication and thought leadership. As a visible representative of BlackRock in Japan, you will help strengthen the firm’s brand, client relationships, and investor engagement across in-person and digital channels.

Your responsibilities
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

• Deliver investment seminars, market outlook presentations, training programs, conferences, and webinars for financial advisors, relationship managers, and investors across Japan, serving as a presenter, moderator, and spokesperson where appropriate.

• Translate complex investment concepts into compelling, accessible narratives across active strategies, ETFs, multi-asset, retirement, and alternative investments, strengthening BlackRock’s position as a trusted investment educator.

• Develop and deliver engaging educational and thought-leadership content across webinars, video, podcasts, articles, digital channels, studio recordings, live broadcasts, and other investor engagement formats.

• Build strong partnerships with securities firms, banks, trust banks, insurers, and digital platforms, working with distribution colleagues to support strategic growth and business development initiatives.

• Identify market trends, regulatory developments, and evolving investor needs, using analytics and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to improve audience engagement, content effectiveness, and commercial outcomes.

• Partner across investment, product, Product Strategy, Portfolio Specialists, Marketing, Communications, Risk & Analytics, and Operations to deliver coordinated client experiences and incorporate market feedback into product positioning, content, and business strategy.

• Conduct client-facing activities in accordance with BlackRock policies and Japanese regulatory requirements, while maintaining disciplined CRM practices and appropriate business reporting.

Your experience

• Approximately 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in areas such as asset management, wealth management, securities, banking, insurance, financial media, investment education, journalism, or related fields.

• Exceptional Japanese-language communication, presentation, storytelling, and public-speaking skills, with the ability to simplify complex investment concepts and engage audiences in person and through digital channels.

• Strong understanding of financial markets, investment principles, products, and portfolio construction, with the ability to translate investment knowledge into accessible and actionable client communication.

• Experience delivering investment seminars, advisor training, conferences, webinars, broadcasts, or similar educational programs, with confidence presenting or appearing in live and recorded formats.

• Flexibility and willingness to travel within Japan as needed to engage distributor branches, sales professionals and clients.

• Highly collaborative and effective in a global matrix organization, with strong professional integrity and a client-centric mindset.

• Native-level Japanese and business-level English; knowledge of Japan’s wealth and intermediary distribution landscape is advantageous.

• Relevant regulatory licensing or willingness to obtain required registrations; familiarity with data analytics and AI-enabled tools supporting client engagement and content delivery is advantageous.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com . We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn , Instagram , YouTube , X , and TikTok .

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

Job Description

As an Equity ETF Strategist, you will support ETF product development, positioning, and commercialization across APAC. Working cross-functionally with Product Development, Marketing, and Distribution teams, you will help execute go-to-market strategies, deliver compelling product narratives, and provide market and competitive insights to support the growth of Invesco's ETF business.

Key Responsibilities / Duties :

• Deliver ETF analytics and investment insights across equities and active strategies, supporting product positioning, client engagement, and commercial opportunities across APAC.

• Develop high-quality ETF content and thought leadership, including presentations, market commentary, product updates, performance analytics, and educational materials for internal and external audiences.

• Support ETF product strategy and commercialization through product positioning, go-to-market execution, product prioritization, and shelf optimization to meet evolving client and market needs.

• Partner with cross-functional teams across Product Development, Portfolio Management, Marketing, Distribution, Legal, and Compliance to deliver effective, compliant, and commercially focused ETF solutions and communications.

• Conduct market, competitive, and regulatory analysis to identify growth opportunities, support product innovation, and ensure alignment with local regulatory requirements across APAC markets.

• Drive client engagement, product advocacy, and operational excellence by serving as an ETF subject matter expert, representing Invesco at client and industry events, and leveraging analytical tools (e.g., Bloomberg, FactSet, Morningstar Direct, Excel/VBA, Power BI, Python) to enhance insights, automate processes, and improve efficiency.

Work Experience / Knowledge

• 8+ years of relevant experience in equity research, ETF product strategy, product development, portfolio management, or quantitative investing, with a strong understanding of equity markets.

• Strong ETF and/or index product expertise, including knowledge of ETF market dynamics, product structures, commercialization strategies, and regulatory frameworks across APAC.

• Proven ability to analyze, position, and commercialize equity investment solutions for diverse client segments.

• Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including index methodologies, performance attribution, portfolio analytics, and data-driven investment research.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel, SQL, Python, VBA, Power BI, Bloomberg, FactSet, Morningstar Direct, and other analytics tools.

• Experience developing ETF product positioning, thought leadership, and client-facing content across active and passive investment strategies.

• Strong commercial acumen with experience in market and competitor analysis, go-to-market execution, and driving ETF growth initiatives.

Skills / Personal Attributes

• Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to derive actionable insights from complex datasets.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Chinese, with the ability to convey complex investment concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Commercially minded and client-focused, with a track record of translating investment insights into compelling product narratives and business opportunities.

• Collaborative and influential, with the ability to build strong partnerships across Product, Portfolio Management, Distribution, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance.

• Highly organized, adaptable, and detail-oriented, with strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Formal Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or another quantitatively rigorous discipline.

• CFA designation or progress toward CFA qualification is preferred.

License/Registration/Certification:

• HK SFC Type 1 License or equivalent

Working Conditions:

Role Summary
The Manager, Client Account Services (CAS) supports intermediary and institutional client relationships across the client lifecycle, including selected pre-onboarding, onboarding, and ongoing servicing activities in Japan.
The role independently coordinates moderately complex activities within established frameworks, working across local and global stakeholders to identify operational requirements, manage risks and dependencies, and support consistent client outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

1. Client Lifecycle Management and Servicing

• Serve as the primary operational point of contact for assigned client relationships and servicing activities.

• Coordinate and manage client requests, operational changes, cash flow notifications, reporting enquiries, and account maintenance activities, including stakeholder coordination, client communications, and escalation of client-impacting risks as appropriate.

2. Onboarding and Change Management Support

• Coordinate selected local onboarding and transition activities in partnership with Client Implementation Management (CIM) team and relevant stakeholders, including operational readiness reviews and implementation planning.

• Review investment management agreements, investment guidelines, fee schedules, client obligations, and operational or reporting requirements to identify servicing implications, operational dependencies, required internal actions, and implementation needs, coordinating with relevant stakeholders as appropriate.

3. Client Advocacy and Stakeholder Coordination

• Act as an internal advocate by clearly communicating client requirements, context, urgency, and desired outcomes.

• Bring together relevant stakeholders, establish actions, owners, dependencies, and timelines, and maintain visibility over execution, escalating where client outcomes, controls, or service quality may be at risk.

4. Operational Analysis, Governance and Risk Management

• Analyze servicing requirements and assess their impact on processes, systems, controls, and applicable regulatory or policy obligations, identifying operational risks, exceptions, dependencies, and information gaps and escalating them in accordance with established governance.

• Participate in relevant incident and issue reviews and support agreed remediation actions.

• Maintain accurate records of client-impacting issues, decisions, requirements, obligations, and outstanding actions, and provide transparency to Relationship Managers and stakeholders through issue reporting, trend analysis, servicing scorecards, and periodic service reviews.

5. Process Improvement and Team Contribution

• Participate in initiatives designed to improve client servicing and onboarding processes.

• Identify and recommend opportunities to streamline workflows, reduce manual activities, and leverage automation, AI-enabled capabilities, and other technology solutions to improve efficiency, scalability, controls, and the client experience.

• Serve as a team resource on Japan client servicing and selected onboarding requirements, contributing to documentation, knowledge sharing, and consistent practices.

• Provide day-to-day guidance, knowledge sharing, and training support to less experienced associates within established functional and regional direction.

Qualifications & Experience

• Five or more years of relevant experience in client servicing, onboarding, mandate implementation, or asset management operations.

• Experience independently coordinating moderately complex servicing, onboarding, or mandate change activities across multiple stakeholders.

• Strong knowledge of investment products, Japan market operational requirements, and relevant regulatory and control frameworks.

• Experience reviewing client or mandate documentation and translating requirements into operational actions.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Japanese and English.

description:
Join Hamilton Lane, a global leader in private markets, as we scale to meet the demands of our growing client base. Here, you’ll work with ambitious, high‑performing teams built on integrity, candor and collaboration, backed by our market-leading data and technology. We invest heavily in our people and our partners, giving you the platform to enrich lives, safeguard futures and grow your career.

What We Do
As one of the largest private markets investment firms globally, we provide innovative solutions to institutional and private wealth investors around the world, specializing in flexibility and full-spectrum access. We currently employ approximately 800 professionals operating in offices throughout North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and the Middle East, and have $1.0 trillion in assets under management and supervision, composed of $146.1 billion in discretionary assets and $871.5 billion in non-discretionary assets, as of December 31, 2025.

The Opportunity:

To satisfy the needs of our growing client base, Hamilton Lane is looking to hire an Analyst on our Fund Investment & Managed Solutions (“FIMS”) team in Hong Kong. The FIMS team identifies and reviews private equity and private credit fund managers and works with our global client base to build and manage private markets portfolios. FIMS team members conduct investment due diligence, screen new investment opportunities, contribute to private equity & private credit research reports, and prepare client deliverables as required. Team members are exposed to the world’s best private sponsors and work alongside our leading institutional investors on a global scale.

Your responsibilities will be to:

• Perform the initial review and formulate the initial recommendation on private equity and private credit fund opportunities on a global basis

• Contribute to in-depth due diligence on Asian private equity and private credit fund opportunities, supporting the deal team through to a final investment recommendation

• Support the team to identify new investment opportunities and monitor existing portfolios by attending and capturing accurate notes in manager meetings, quarterly calls and annual meetings

• Develop expertise in emerging technologies and leverage AI tools to enhance project execution and improve efficiency

• Assist with ad-hoc special projects and other duties as needed

Your background will include:

• Up to two years of work experience in the financial services industry, including recent undergraduate or Master’s degree holders; private markets experience is not a requirement but is a plus

• University degree required

• Capacity to learn, absorb and analyze information quickly

• Strong quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to grasp new concepts

• Detail-oriented, responsible and organized, with ability to manage multiple workstreams to deadline

• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft applications required (Excel, PowerPoint)

• Ability to collaborate and work effectively in a team environment

• Fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese

Benefits
At Hamilton Lane, our benefits philosophy is simple: to provide our employees with a competitive suite of benefits and services to help navigate through the complexities and challenges of working, living, raising a family, and eventually retiring.
To do this, Hamilton Lane offers the following benefits:

Enhancing Your Physical and Emotional Health
Employees have access to healthcare coverage, mental health resources, health & fitness reimbursement program, and Wellness Rewards Program.

Developing Your Career
Tuition and certification reimbursement programs are available, along with continual education and development trainings for you to grow with Hamilton Lane.

Supporting Your Family & Community
For our communities, Hamilton Lane provides paid time off to volunteer and compensates for referring qualified candidates that join our team.
For growing family, we offer an adoption reimbursement program, paid time off for new parents and newlyweds, and provide travel support for nursing parents.

Safeguarding Your Financial Wellbeing
Hamilton Lane contributes to retirement programs and offers an employee stock purchasing plan.

Hamilton Lane is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their race, religion, ancestry, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, domestic partner status, or medical condition. As a registered investment adviser, employees of Hamilton Lane may be subject to certain limitations on political contribution and personal investment activities.

description:
We are currently seeking a high calibre professional to join our team as a Manager, Data Analytics .
In this role you will:

• Serve as the “go-to” person within the Data & Analytics organization in HSBC Retail Banking & Wealth for banking data requests from business stakeholders.

• Lead AI-driven and analytics-driven data model design, and manage the end-to-end data transformation program in partnership with multiple teams.

• Lead the DataOps transformation to enable self-serve, high-performant data ETL for both ad-hoc analytical purposes and real-time large Machine Learning / AI model inference.

• Build and maintain data pipelines (ETL/ELT), implement data quality controls, and perform peer code reviews.

• Coordinate and drive cross-market and cross-entity data design discussions to maximize reuse and data synergies.
Lead and/or support data analysis and business insights generation.

To be successful you will need:

• 5+ years’ experience in data-related roles within a financial institution (banking experience strongly preferred).

• Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, PostgreSQL, and cloud-native data pipeline automation tools (e.g., Airflow, BigQuery). Spark experience is a plus.

• Demonstrated experience delivering large-scale data projects or data products using modern engineering practices and tooling (e.g., data pipelines and/or CI/CD workflows).

• Experience designing and developing high-performance solutions for extremely large-scale data processing, storage, and wrangling, ideally including real-time workloads.

• Solid understanding of DevOps, DataOps, and/or MLOps principles.

• Cloud-native data ETL development is preferred

• Experience handling unstructured data is an advantage.

Technology Stack

• Technology stack provisioned in the team including:
• Languages : SQL, Python, Java, JavaScript

• IDE : Visual Studio Code, PyCharm, IntelliJ

• Platforms and Services : Managed Service for Apache Spark, Apache Airflow

• CI/CD : Jenkins, Terraform

• Data warehouse : BigQuery, PostgreSQL, Redshift, Snowflake

• AI: GitHub Copilot, HSBC Productivity Suite

description:
Job Descriptions
Corporate and Institutional Banking Japan Graduate Programme
What you can expect
Whether your degree relates to finance, science or the arts there is a place for you on our Corporate and Institutional Banking (“CIB”) Graduate Programme. Your skills and fresh ideas will help you establish an exciting career in a Corporate Banking role.
Our CIB business is one of the largest banking businesses of its kind. We offer 24-hour coverage of local markets and provide a full range of banking services to our clients. You can expect to work on exciting projects in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and interact with clients and colleagues around the world to create and offer innovative solutions to our clients.
CIB manages HSBC’s largest clients and delivers comprehensive solutions to complex strategic and capital market challenges. You will trade ideas and strategies, and interact with a broad range of clients, from multinational corporates to private equity firms. It’s a career choice that requires dedication, but one that will give you many rewards in return.
What you will do
Corporate Banking : You will gain first-hand experience of how our relationship managers, working closely with our product specialists, create innovative solutions to meet the banking needs of our largest corporate and institutional clients. You will have a chance to understand how we build trusted relationships with our clients, gain a great overview of the breadth of products HSBC can offer and see how we respond to our clients’ need by deploying these products into tailored solutions across multiple countries. You will also see how we help the Bank manage the risk inherent from dealing with these clients, to ensure we foster a sustainable business model.
A dynamic, challenging and diverse environment with on-the-job learning and structured development lies ahead of you. There will be many opportunities to develop your network of contacts within CIB 　 and beyond. You’ll also be able to take part in our sustainability initiatives. Our volunteering programme, Diversity & Inclusion activities, for example, could help you to develop new skills, while contributing to the communities in which we work.
As well as your immediate team, we have Employee Resource Groups ( “ ERGs ” ), also known as networks. They are similar to the clubs and societies that you may have had access to at school, college or university. ERGs are voluntary employee-led groups. Our employees lead eight global networks to promote diversity within the bank [ http://www.hsbc.com/our-approach/diversity-and-inclusion/employee-networks ] : Ability, Balance, Embrace, Faith & Belief , Generations, Nurture , Pride and Strive . We also have common interest groups that connect employees on a variety of different topics. They are open to all employees.
We offer a market-competitive pay and benefits package according to your role and location.
Learning and development
We offer a high-quality learning and development programme. You will begin your rotation program in Tokyo for up to 18 months which consists of a combination of on-the-job training as well as a series of e-learning courses. The on-the-job training is comprised of rotating through teams within the CIB business , which may include relationship coverage, product s , risk management, and client services . JSDA qualification will be required by the end of the programme.
We’ll provide the support, tools and opportunities for you to drive your own career development. Your training will be carefully structured, with events and other opportunities to build your wider HSBC and banking knowledge. You’ll have regular access to business leaders for coaching and advice, while constructive feedback will enable you to measure your performance.
Career paths
If you succeed here, you could continue the work you’re doing in Corporate Banking where you’ll have the opportunity to take your career in a number of directions. This may include taking on international opportunities or working across multiple products and geographies, while feeding your curiosity and developing an understanding of how we can best serve our clients.
Who does this suit?
We are looking for dedicated and courageous people who are:
Passionate role models. Being able to inspire, lead, manage and listen to both individuals and teams is important in building relationships that encourage mutual respect. Looking to the future for our clients is what keeps us ahead of our competition.
Dedicated multi-task players. You might be working on several projects at any one time, meaning you should prioritize and manage your time, while keeping on top of constantly changing markets. Adhering to the rules and regulations we have will ensure you deliver the right results for multiple projects.
Supportive and open-minded team players. Teamwork is an important part of our business, and your development. Having a collaborative attitude and open to feedback will help you solve problems quickly and start to build a network of peers who are there to support you and be supported too.
Opportunity takers. We are an international company that can offer opportunities to motivated, courageous people. Taking on a challenging project will not only be rewarding but will also show that you have the power to explore your interests and drive your career growth.
Intellectual curiosity. Our CIB business has a unique breadth of products in terms of what we offer and where we offer these solutions. Being curious will help you explore new perspectives, build deeper understanding, and accelerate your learning.
Independent and discipline d worker. Ways of working constantly evolv es and we expect flexibility and adaptability to work effectively in different situations.

Q ualifications
The base location for this role is Tokyo.
Open to graduates in 2026, or recent graduates with 1-2 years of working experience and bachelor degree or above from a reputable university.
Fluent in English and Japanese, both written and verbal.

At HSBC we are open to different ideas and cultures, connected to our customers, communities and each other, and dependable, we do the right thing. These are the values that guide us every day. We seek to recruit people who share these values and will help us to sustain them.

Selection Process and Timeline

01

Apply

Answer simple eligibility questions and submit your CV

Eligible candidates will be invited for next stage

02

Value-Based Assessment

30 minutes online assessment to understand how your values align with ours

Complete within 14 days of invitation

03

Skills-Based Assessment

45 minutes online assessment to showcase your skills

Candidates must choose to test in ‘Japanese’ Language

Complete within 10 days of invitation

04

On-Demand Video

Record responses to a series of questions to understand your motivation, communication style and potential fit

Complete within 10 days of invitation

05

Interview

Short-listed candidates will be invited for interviews with the hiring team

06

Offer

Successful candidates will receive official employment offer

*Kindly note that the time listed above are subject to change. The progression to each stage is by invitation only. Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the details.

description:
Join JPMorgan Asset Management in the Japan Product Development, where you will play a pivotal role in shaping our product offerings and driving market growth. This position offers a unique opportunity for career advancement and professional development within a globally recognized firm known for its innovation and excellence in investment management.
As an Associate in the Japan Product Development Team within the JPMorgan Asset Management business, you will collaborate with diverse internal stakeholders to understand market needs and achieve commercial objectives. You will be instrumental in managing product development initiatives, ensuring compliance with local regulations, and supporting sales and marketing efforts. Your expertise will contribute to the firm's reputation as a leader in investment management.
In this role, you will work closely with regional and global teams to identify product gaps and opportunities, leveraging market and regulatory trends to enhance our product range. Your contributions will support the firm's mission to provide exceptional investment management services and expand our market presence in Japan.

Job Responsibilities:

• Develop strong partnerships with internal stakeholders to understand market needs and provide solutions that meet commercial objectives in a timely manner.

• Drive and manage local product development initiatives, liaising with key stakeholders in respect of new funds and product management matters.

• Serve as a subject matter expert on new products, changes to existing products or newly introduced product features, to support sales and marketing efforts.

• Stay informed about local regulatory and industry developments impacting the product range.

• Draft product overview documents for Japan onshore and offshore funds.

• Work closely with the regional Product Development teams located across US, EMEA, and APAC, to ensure consistent and seamless execution of corporate actions.

• Adopt firm-wide best practices in facilitating the governance processes, the individual will be heavily involved in the preparation, review and approval of any new product initiatives at local, regional and global committees.

• Support the local Japan or regional Product Development team in identifying product gaps and opportunities, capitalizing on market and regulatory developments and trends, and reviewing the commercial viability of the local product range(s).

• Actively participate and provide feedback in the implementation of product related systems or other technology projects.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills:

• Bachelor Degree in business, law, or finance; and 5 years of experience in the product development within Japan funds industry.

• Sound working knowledge of traditional mutual funds and regulatory environment in Japan.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex matters in a concise and meaningful way.

• Experience working with geographically distributed and functionally diverse teams.

• Comfort with ambiguity and dynamically shifting priorities, timelines, and demands.

• Experience of working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

description:
A Career with Point72’s IPD Team

Our Investment Professional Development (IPD) team is dedicated to the growth and development of our investment analysts. The team focuses on developing investment professional skills with the goal of driving superior alpha generation and enhancing team investment processes by analyzing, consolidating, and sharing best practices, training the investment team population, and preparing analyses and data with partners across the firm.

What you’ll do

• Strengthen investment professional development by translating research best practices into practical training, coaching, and feedback programs

• Take the lead in organizing activities and events that promote analyst interactions and engagement and proactively interacting with analysts to surface issues and build relationships.

• Interact with portfolio managers and analysts to understand development needs and deliver targeted support for Hong Kong-based investment teams

• Partner with coaches and other subject matter experts across Fundamental Equities management to turn their ideas, frameworks, and methods into clear, practical content for investment professionals

• Coordinate recurring analyst review sessions, coaching discussions, and learning forums that help teams improve research quality and commercial impact

• Develop performance insights using internal data to surface trends, measure progress, and recommend practical interventions for investment professionals

• Support senior leaders on strategic projects focused on talent development, investment process improvement, and team effectiveness

• Maintain disciplined program execution by tracking milestones, preparing materials, and ensuring development initiatives run smoothly

• Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and other control partners to ensure programs and materials align with firm policies and standards

What’s required

• Bachelor's degree with solid financial training

• 3+ years of experience in a buy-side or sell-side public markets role, including equity research, sales, trading, or a closely related function; an understanding of long/short investing strategies is helpful

• Fluency in Mandarin and English for investment discussions, coaching conversations, and stakeholder engagement to interact with employees at all levels of the organization

• Strong understanding of public equities, company analysis, financial statements, valuation, and investment research workflows

• Ability to translate investment feedback and performance observations into practical development materials and recommendations

• Advanced spreadsheet and presentation skills for analysis, reporting, learning content, and senior stakeholder communications

• Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate recurring programs, manage deadlines, and follow through across stakeholders

• Excellent judgment and discretion when handling sensitive investment discussions, performance information, and employee development topics

• Collaborative communication style with the confidence to engage investment professionals, managers, and control partners at multiple levels

• Commitment to the highest ethical standards

We take care of our people

We invest in our people, their careers, their health, and their well-being. When you work here, we provide:

• Health care benefits

• Generous parental and family leave policies

• Mental and physical wellness programs

• Volunteer opportunities

• Support for employee-led affinity groups representing women, minorities and the LGBT+ community

• Tuition assistance

About Point72

Point72 is a leading global alternative investment firm led by Steven A. Cohen with over $58.5 billion in assets under management (as of July 1, 2026). Building on more than 30 years of investing experience, Point72 seeks to deliver superior returns for its investors through fundamental and systematic investing strategies across asset classes and geographies. We aim to attract and retain the industry’s brightest talent by cultivating an investor-led culture and committing to our people’s long-term growth. For more information, visit www.Point72.com .

Responsible AI Specialist (AVP)

Role Purpose
Reporting to the Group Data Office, Responsible AI Lead, you will help validate the bank’s most critical AI solutions, ensuring they are fit for purpose and comply with AI governance standards. The role conducts hands-on testing, identifies risks and limitations, and provides recommendations to support the safe and responsible use of AI across the bank.

Key Responsibilities
1. Model Validation of AI Solutions

• Conduct independent validation of traditional machine learning models across the full model lifecycle.

• Design the validation frameworks, methodologies and testing approaches for GenAI solutions and agentic AI systems.

• Review and challenge model evaluation results, including assessments of performance (e.g. groundedness, factual accuracy, retrieval quality, relevance, and instruction adherence), and evaluate the reliability of LLM-as-a-Judge methodologies through calibration against human-labelled benchmarks.

• Perform structured testing of AI guardrails and assess agentic AI systems for appropriate tool-use permissions, action reversibility, and human-in-the-loop controls.

• Document validation findings, identified limitations, risks, and recommendations and support the communication of validation outcomes.

2. Enablement and Standards

• Contribute to the development and enhancement of the bank’s AI validation methodologies, evidence standards, and reusable testing assets.

• Provide technical expertise to stakeholders across Risk, Technology, Internal Audit, and business functions.

• Monitor evolving AI technologies, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices, and incorporate relevant developments into validation standards and approaches.

What You'll Bring
Must Have

• Advanced degree in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related AI Governance discipline.

• 5–8 years’ experience in model validation and testing within a bank or another regulated environment, with the ability to apply traditional model risk management principles to emerging AI use cases, including Generative AI and agentic AI systems.

• Ability to critically assess and challenge complex AI systems, identify risks, and recommend effective controls.

• Strong understanding of AI lifecycle management, bias and fairness, explainability, controls and guardrails and monitoring concepts.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce decision-ready and regulatory-grade documentation and communicate technical and governance concepts to senior management and non-technical stakeholders.

• Hands-on experience designing and executing GenAI evaluation methodologies and testing frameworks.

• Hands-on experience with ML/GenAI frameworks and cloud-based AI services.

Preferred

• Familiarity with MAS and other regulatory frameworks covering AI risk management, data governance, technology risk, information security, and third-party risk management.

• Experience contributing to the design and implementation of model management, governance, or risk management platforms.

• Exposure to industry forums, regulatory working groups, or governance committees related to AI.

description:
Bank of Singapore opens doors to new opportunities.

At Bank of Singapore, we are constantly on the lookout for exceptional individuals to join our team. We promote a culture of openness, teamwork and fairness. Most importantly, we invest in our people through our programmes that develop them on both professional and personal levels. Besides attractive remuneration packages, we offer non-financial benefits and opportunities to develop your potential within OCBC Group’s global network of subsidiaries and offices. If you have passion, drive and the will to succeed, rise to the challenge today!

As a Service Ambassador, you will greet and assist clients, visitors, and guests while managing the reception and overall, Client Centre experience. You play a key role in creating a positive first impression by delivering exceptional hospitality, professionalism, and personalised service.
A Service Ambassador has a significant influence on the first impressions of our clients and visitors and is therefore responsible for performing the following duties to the highest standards, while creating a warm and welcoming environment.

To be successful in this role, you should consistently demonstrate the following attitudes, behaviours, skills, and values:

Responsibilities
The Service Ambassador is responsible for delivering and maintaining an exceptional level of customer service by addressing concerns promptly, professionally, and effectively. The Service Ambassador is committed to providing outstanding service and driving continuous improvement in the client and visitor experience.

Daily duties:

• Welcome and attend to all invited clients and guests at the Bank of Singapore Client Centre.

• Greet and acknowledge clients upon arrival, escort them to meeting suites, and engage with clients professionally as required.

• Support the daily operations of the BOS Client Centre, ensuring a seamless client experience across all Client Centre levels, meeting rooms, reception areas, and lobbies.

• Attend to client and banker requests, including arranging dining reservations, hotel bookings, transportation, sightseeing activities, and travel-related services before and after meetings. Provide information on flight details, local attractions, and support for presentation or IT-related requirements as needed.

• Anticipate client needs and respond promptly and proactively.

• Build and maintain positive client relationships to ensure a high level of client satisfaction.

• Manage the Client Centre reception counters, direct calls appropriately, and take accurate messages in accordance with the Bank's standard operating procedures.

• Coordinate and manage meeting room and internal event venue bookings, ensuring seamless arrangements for clients, external guests, and internal stakeholders.

• Offer and serve beverages throughout client meetings, ensuring a high standard of hospitality.

• Prepare and serve food and beverages to clients, including food plating and dining services for refreshments, lunch, and special requests.

• Maintain the cleanliness and presentation of all Client Centre areas, including meeting rooms, waiting areas, and pantries. This includes clearing crockery and glassware, cleaning tables, replenishing supplies, and arranging furniture as required.

• Provide administrative and logistical support to the team.

• Assist with company events, client events, and off-site functions when required.

• Perform any other ad hoc duties or responsibilities assigned by the Line Manager.

Requirements:

• Possess at least a Diploma, Advanced/Higher/Graduate Diploma, Professional Degree, or equivalent qualification in Hospitality, Tourism, Hotel Management, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in customer service, hospitality, or a related service industry. Experience as a flight attendant or in luxury hospitality will be an added advantage.

• Customer-focused and proactive, with the ability to communicate professionally and confidently with clients and stakeholders.

• Outgoing, personable, and able to build positive relationships with clients and colleagues.

• Immaculately groomed and exceptionally well-presented.

• Calm, efficient, and well-organized, with strong attention to detail.

• Demonstrate professional etiquette and a genuine passion for delivering exceptional hospitality and guest service.

• Willing to go the extra mile to exceed clients' expectations.

• Proficient in written and verbal communication.

• Computer literate and proficient in using Microsoft Office applications and corporate systems.

• Ability to multitask effectively while maintaining a positive attitude and high standard of service.

• Able to prioritize tasks effectively and work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

• Willing and able to work on a rotating roster, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays when required to support events and business needs.

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

Enterprise Knowledge Management Specialist

ROLE
We are seeking an Enterprise Knowledge Management Specialist within the Data & AI function to establish, operationalize and scale the Bank's Enterprise Knowledge Management Capability.

This role will partner closely with Group Risk Management (GRM), Business Functions, Technology, Compliance, HR and Operations to define enterprise knowledge governance standards, operating models, taxonomy, controls and AI-ready knowledge practices.

Business functions remain accountable for the ownership, accuracy and maintenance of their respective knowledge assets. This role will act as the framework architect, enterprise catalyst and implementation partner - developing the strategy, implementation roadmap, standards, playbooks, governance mechanisms and adoption approach required to bring the framework into practical execution across the Bank.

This role reports directly to Head, Group Data Office.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Enterprise Knowledge Strategy & Operating Model

• Partner with GRM to define and implement the Bank's enterprise knowledge management strategy, roadmap and operating model.

• Position knowledge as a governed enterprise asset supporting productivity, operational resilience, compliance and AI effectiveness.

• Develop practical implementation plans to move from fragmented repositories to trusted, reusable and AI-ready enterprise knowledge.

• Establish business cases, value measures and adoption plans for prioritized knowledge domains.

Knowledge Governance Framework

• Partner with GRM and enterprise stakeholders to establish knowledge governance standards, policies, controls and implementation playbooks.

• Define roles and responsibilities across knowledge owners, stewards, custodians, users and governance forums.

• Design lifecycle management processes covering knowledge creation, review, approval, publication, consumption, refresh, retention and retirement.

• Develop review cadences, quality criteria, certification standards and escalation routines for critical knowledge assets.

Framework Implementation & Change Execution

• Lead phased implementation across priority business and support functions, starting with high-value domains.

• Translate the framework into practical working routines, templates, control checkpoints, training and adoption materials.

• Coordinate cross-functional execution across Risk, Technology, Compliance, Operations, HR and business domain teams.

• Drive change management and behavioural adoption without replacing business ownership of content.

Taxonomy, Metadata & Information Architecture

• Develop enterprise taxonomy, metadata and classification standards for knowledge assets.

• Define standards for ownership, authoritative source identification, versioning, confidentiality, effective date, review date and content status.

• Improve discoverability and reusability of policy, process, control, risk, product, operational and technical knowledge.

• Establish information architecture principles for structured and unstructured knowledge repositories.

AI-Ready Knowledge Foundation

• Define standards for AI-consumable and AI-trustworthy knowledge assets supporting Microsoft Copilot, Enterprise Search, RAG, Knowledge Graphs and AI Agents.

• Partner with Data, AI and Technology teams to improve retrieval quality, grounding accuracy, source traceability and user trust.

• Establish criteria for content certification, knowledge freshness, trust scoring, Identify authoritative knowledge sources and support controls to reduce duplication, outdated content and hallucination risk.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

• Define KPIs, maturity assessments and dashboards for knowledge quality, adoption, search success, freshness, duplication and AI readiness.

• Monitor implementation progress and continuously refine standards based on business feedback, audit observations and emerging AI capabilities.

• Support senior management updates on value realization, risk reduction and enterprise adoption outcomes.

REQUIREMENTS

Experience & Qualifications

• Bachelor's or master's degree in Information Management, Data Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Risk Management or related fields.

• 10+ years of experience in enterprise data governance, information management, knowledge management, enterprise architecture, AI governance, digital transformation or related roles.

• Experience in banking or financial services is highly preferred.

• Proven experience establishing enterprise governance frameworks and driving organization-wide implementation and adoption.

• Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into executable roadmaps, playbooks, operating routines and measurable outcomes.

Knowledge, Data & AI Expertise

• Strong understanding of knowledge lifecycle management, taxonomy, ontology, metadata, information architecture and content governance.

• Familiarity with data governance, AI governance and risk/control operating models in regulated environments.

• Good understanding of Microsoft Copilot, Enterprise Search, RAG architectures, knowledge graphs, semantic indexing, vector databases and AI agents.

• Ability to define AI-ready knowledge standards, authoritative source strategies and trust mechanisms for enterprise AI use cases.

Leadership & Stakeholder Skills

• Strong stakeholder management across Risk, Compliance, Technology, Operations, HR and business functions.

• Ability to influence without direct authority and drive alignment across senior stakeholders and domain owners.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex governance and AI-readiness concepts in business language.

• Strong execution mindset: able to move from framework design to practical implementation, adoption and measurable business value.

What we offer:

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

description:
The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

The Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,300 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

About Liquidnet
Liquidnet is a next-generation agency execution specialist. Powered by technology that helps drive institutional alpha, our trading and liquidity network intelligently and securely connects the world’s investors with the world’s investments.

Established in 1999 on the belief that there was a better way to trade, Liquidnet' journey began with a vision to create a platform that goes beyond traditional transactional models.
We wanted to build a community where traders could connect, collaborate, and execute trades with confidence. Over the years, we've grown from a vision into a thriving ecosystem that empowers the buy side in ways never before imagined.

We are committed to making trading more efficient, intelligent, and accessible. Our purpose guides every decision we make, from the tools we develop to the relationships we nurture with our Members.

Role Overview
This position is responsible for helping in the daily Operations processes of servicing all Japanese domestic and international clients, trading equities in Japan and international markets. In this Trade Services role, you will liaise with the APAC institutional client base in the post-execution (Operations) area and the Front Office (Sales Trading) team to ensure that client delivery is of a high quality. As such, you must possess excellent client service & communication skills, and a confident manner to effectively manage internal/external client expectations and deliver quality services.

The Trade Services Team in Asia has representatives in Sydney, Tokyo and Hong Kong.

Role Responsibilities

• Perform Client onboarding process, Account Opening and Static Data maintenance, mainly for Japanese Onshore accounts

• Ensure timely and accurate processing of client trades and onward submission to the custodian providing operational support to all members

• Collect allocations and booking trades, internal processing of trades (issuance of varies types of confirmation as clients requested and uploading trades to the clearing bank)

• Identify and resolve workflow issues and liaise with internal/external departments and clients to communicate resolution of outstanding issues, ensuring escalation to immediate manager

• Daily/Weekly/Monthly/etc Trade, Tax and Regulatory reporting to Exchanges and Japanese Regulators

• Create and update various statistics for members (trade allocations, pre-match rates/fail rates etc.)

• Initiate new procedures and solutions to improve productivity, system enhancements and increase STP

• Take responsibility for your assigned department projects, (UAT, system enhancements etc.)

• Escalate issue/problem to immediate manager

• Perform pre-matching with both clients and market

• Ensure all reconciliations are completed in a timely manner in order to produce reports to management

• Managing monthly commission claim and reconciliation in different markets

• Managing CSA requests with other internal departments and clients

Experience / Competences
Essential

• Knowledge and understanding of the on-exchange equities trading and settlement

description:
The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

Founded in London in 1866, the Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,200 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

Parameta Solutions
Parameta Solutions is the Data & Analytics division of TP ICAP Group. The business provides clients with unbiased OTC content and proprietary data, in-depth insights across price discovery, risk management, benchmark and indices, and pre and post-trade analytics. Its post-trade solutions offering helps market participants control their counterparty and regulatory risks through a growing range of tools that manage balance-sheet exposure, as well as compression and optimisation services. The Data & Analytics division includes the following brands: Tullett Prebon Information, PVM Data Services, ICAP Information and Burton-Taylor Consulting.

Tullett Prebon
A world-leading intermediary in the wholesale financial and energy markets, Tullett Prebon seeks to maximise value for its clients' trading activities across voice, hybrid and pure electronic channels.

We offer broking services for a wide range of asset classes, including Equities, Credit, FX, Rates and Insurance Derivatives.

Across all asset classes, Tullett Prebon offers e-solutions to give clients the choice to enter prices and execute trades electronically and directly via one of our hybrid electronic trading systems, or to engage with brokers to help identify and negotiate trades.

Role Overview
Parameta Solutions has set exciting objectives to grow its business and increase contribution to group revenues across a five-year period. Aligned to this strategy is the position of a regional account manager covering Japan, to be located in the Tullett Prebon Japan office in Tokyo.

• Ensure every prospective and existing Stripe user has a high-quality experience at every interaction

• Demonstrated ability to independently lead consultative discovery at the executive level — uncovering strategic business needs, not just transactional requirements

• Experience managing and growing a portfolio of enterprise accounts.

• Strong command of pipeline management methodologies (e.g., MEDDIICC) and CRM discipline (Salesforce)

• Proven ability to build and execute strategic territory and account plans with clear objectives, milestones, and risk mitigation

• Experience orchestrating cross-functional teams to advance complex enterprise deals

• Self-directed and highly organised — able to manage competing priorities, set your own direction, and deliver results with minimal oversight

• Experience selling payments, fintech, or infrastructure platform solutions to enterprise customers in Korea

• Familiarity with Korea's enterprise landscape — including the unique dynamics of chaebol structures, local entity requirements, and cross-border expansion challenges

• Experience using conversation intelligence tools (e.g., Gong) to improve sales effectiveness and deal progression

• Ability to understand technical concepts and Stripe's API at a level sufficient to engage in solution design conversations

• Experience with Excel, SQL, or data tools for territory analysis and pipeline management

About the APAC Risk team

The APAC Risk team helps Stripe launch and grow products responsibly across a diverse and rapidly evolving region. We work closely with global and regional partners across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Partnerships, and Risk to identify emerging risks, define practical controls, and make risk decisions easier to execute at scale.

The team supports Stripe’s growth in APAC by combining deep regional context with strong analytical judgment. We assess how fraud patterns, payment methods, user behavior, market structures, and regulatory expectations vary across countries. We use those insights to build strategies that protect Stripe and the broader payments ecosystem while preserving a strong experience for legitimate users.

What you’ll do

As a Fraud Strategist on the APAC Risk team, you will be responsible for identifying and reducing transaction and merchant fraud across Stripe’s products and markets in the region. You will monitor the health of Stripe’s APAC portfolio, investigate emerging threats, and build scalable strategies that reduce losses without creating unnecessary friction for legitimate businesses.

You will work on complex and fast moving problems where the available information is often incomplete and fraud patterns evolve quickly. Your work may range from investigating an anomalous fraud trend to designing a regional control, defining a model feature, improving a manual review workflow, or shaping the risk approach for a new product, payment method, or country launch.

Responsibilities

• Monitor transaction and merchant fraud trends across APAC and investigate anomalous behavior at the merchant, account, and transaction level.

• Define, build, and maintain regional fraud health metrics. Set targets, identify material changes, and communicate the drivers of performance.

• Develop short and long term fraud strategies for APAC markets, products, and payment methods. Translate investigations into clear controls, product requirements, model improvements, and operational actions.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Partnerships, and other Risk teams to scope, prioritize, and deliver fraud mitigation work.

• Assess fraud risks for new country, product, and local payment method launches. Define mitigations before launch and monitor outcomes after launch.

• Balance fraud loss, user experience, operational cost, conversion, and growth when recommending or implementing controls.

• Improve and automate fraud risk workflows through data, internal tools, and agent based solutions where these can increase consistency, speed, or coverage.

• Sound decision making in ambiguous or time sensitive situations, with a willingness to learn and iterate as new evidence emerges.

• Empathy for legitimate users and an ability to balance scaled risk controls with user experience.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with transaction fraud, merchant fraud, account takeover, or abuse in an online payments environment.

• Experience working across APAC markets or with regional payment methods and local market structures.

• Advanced SQL skills or experience with quantitative tools such as Python, R, or Stata.

• Experience partnering with machine learning or Data Science teams on model features, rules, detection, or measurement.

• Experience assessing fraud risk for new products, payment methods, or country launches.

• Experience designing risk controls, monitoring frameworks, operational workflows, or policy.

• Experience using automation, AI tools, or agent based workflows to improve risk processes.

• Experience in a fast moving environment where threats, products, and priorities change quickly.

Product Manager, Global Self-Serve Product

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead.
