Overview
Step into a role where your ideas spark innovation and your impact is felt every day. You will join the Enterprise Commercial - Commercial Executive Group, partnering with enterprise customers to bring relevant technology solutions to their organizations. You will help customers navigate offerings, develop proposals, and move from early conversations through contract agreement.
As a Sr. Commercial Executive, you will shape commercial strategies that address customer priorities while supporting productive, secure technology adoption. You will coordinate across internal teams to structure solutions, evaluate licensing and costs, and negotiate agreements that create value for customers and Microsoft. Join the team to help customers achieve more with Microsoft services.
At Microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth‑mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress, people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.

Responsibilities

• Lead commercial strategy and deal planning for strategic enterprise customers, aligning Microsoft solutions, licensing models, and commercial constructs with customer priorities, transformation objectives, and desired business outcomes.

• Own the commercial strategy for large-scale and complex renewals and strategic deals, developing multi-year deal structures that balance customer value, competitive positioning, revenue growth, profitability, and long-term partnership objectives.

• Develop pricing scenarios, proposals, licensing strategies, and contract structures that support customer value and sustainable commercial outcomes, including complex and customized commercial arrangements where appropriate.

• Partner closely with senior Account Executives and sales leaders to shape the overall account and negotiation strategy, bringing independent commercial judgment and proactively identifying opportunities to improve both customer and Microsoft business outcomes.

• Build a deep understanding of each strategic customer’s business priorities, contractual history, licensing environment, and decision-making process, and translate that understanding into effective renewal and commercial strategies.

• Lead and orchestrate complex commercial negotiations with customers and partners, including pricing, licensing, contractual terms, concessions, and other commercial considerations, engaging senior customer stakeholders when required.

• Coordinate across Account, Specialist, Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, Support, Operations, and Partner teams to resolve complex deal issues, secure required approvals, and drive agreements from early strategy through contract execution.

• Anticipate commercial, contractual, compliance, and execution risks in strategic deals, develop mitigation approaches, and guide internal stakeholders toward timely decisions and successful deal closure.

• Assess commercial, contractual, revenue, and profitability considerations while ensuring adherence to Microsoft policies, compliance requirements, approval frameworks, and applicable business standards.

• Drive strategic product and cloud opportunities as part of the overall commercial relationship, including renewals and opportunities across Azure consumption commitments, Microsoft 365, Copilot, Security, and new commerce models, where relevant to the customer strategy.

• Act as a trusted commercial advisor to senior sales stakeholders and customers, bringing a strategic perspective that goes beyond transactional execution to help shape deals that strengthen long-term customer relationships and Microsoft’s business growth.

Required/Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Business Management, Information Technology, Law, Marketing, Finance, Communication, Education (or equivalent) or related field AND 7+ years of sales and negotiation experience or related work or internship experience; OR

• 10+ years of sales and negotiation experience; OR

• Equivalent experience.

• Fluent Japanese language skills and business-level English communication skills are required.

• Master's Degree in Business Management, Information Technology, Law, Marketing (or equivalent) AND 7+ years of sales and negotiation experience or related work; OR

• Bachelor's Degree in Business Management, Information Technology, Law, Marketing, Finance, Communication, Education (or equivalent) or related field AND 10+ years of sales and negotiation experience or related work or internship experience; OR

• 15+ years of sales and negotiation experience; OR

• Equivalent experience.

Overview
At Microsoft, our Digital Enterprise Business empowers customers through the unique value of the Microsoft Cloud. We build a globally-led, digital-first scale organisation aligned with partners to drive digital transformation. Our team engages with enterprise customers to identify and achieve their business objectives through best-in-class digital engagement and partner co-selling. We focus on modernising sales motions, leveraging AI, Copilot, and Security to deliver customer satisfaction and drive business growth.
This is an exciting role to demonstrate your digital first customer engagment as an Enterprise Digital Specialist - Cloud & AI.
The key of this role is to grow Cloud & AI Sales in the territory:

• Drive Azure Solution Plays: win customer projects to Migrate & Modernize their Estate, Unify Data Platform and Innovate with AI Apps and Agents; securely, leveraging digital tools and signals to uncover new contacts and new workloads

• Build and accelerate pipeline: lead Cloud & AI account/territory plans, leverage sales programs and tools (IAP, LXP, Checklists, etc.) to exceed ACR forecast

• Orchestrate the Cloud & AI sales motions across Account Executives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success Unit & partners

• Drive Microsoft Azure Consumption Commitment (MACC) and Unified Support penetration in majors growth accounts

As a key player in driving digital transformation, you will leverage your fundamental understanding of customers' businesses to initiate impactful conversations in a single solution area, collaborating closely with partners and services. You will work with account teams, partners, and services to track, qualify, and expand new opportunities, while identifying, developing, and proposing solutions that align with customer needs.

Your role involves developing an understanding of external stakeholders' mapping and implementing strategies to accelerate deal closures in collaboration with team members. You will collaborate with Global Partner Solutions (GPS) and a network of partners to cross-sell, up-sell, and co-sell products, solutions, and services, applying the orchestration model to support deal closure.

Additionally, you will research competitor products, solutions, and services, and work with "compete" global black belts (GBBs) to implement strategies that position Microsoft favorably in customer communications. You will manage and orchestrate sales and delivery success through the account and pursuit teams, participate in rhythm-of-business (ROB) meetings to review and plan for accounts in the assigned territory, and collaborate with the extended sales team, partners, and marketing to conduct business analysis and pursue high-potential customers.

Ultimately, you will manage the end-to-end business of the assigned territory, driving success and growth.

Responsibilities
Sales Excellence

• Manages the end-to-end business of the assigned territory; conducts forecasting for accounts and develops a portfolio and territory plan to drive intentional selling aligned with strategic priorities.

• Collaborates with partners and resources and leverages customer insights or industry knowledge; contributes to exploring business and emerging opportunities to optimize the portfolio and support customer innovation.

• Participates in rhythm-of-business (ROB) meetings to review and plan for accounts in the assigned territory.

• Reviews feedback report and coaches others on ensuring customer/partner satisfaction and decreasing dissatisfaction by establishing recovery action plans to improve clients' overall experience; manages and/or orchestrates sales and delivery success through the account team and pursuit team.

Sales Execution

• Identifies customer business needs and technical readiness; collaborates with internal teams, partners, and services to propose prioritized solutions that align with customers' needs; leverages the value propositions to communicate business impact of proposed solutions.

• Implements strategies to help accelerate the closing of deals in collaboration with other team members; implements close plans (e.g., how to map timeline, engage the customer, get customer buy in and commitment) to de-risk and drive predictable deal closure.

• Engages in conversations with customers to introduce how other workloads could enable digital transformation areas that is aligned with the customer's industry; has a fundamental understanding of customers' business to initiate conversations with customers on digital transformation in a single solution area, in collaboration with partners and services; shares learning on digital transformation through seminars, workshops, Webinars, and direct engagement.

• Develops an understanding of external stakeholders' mapping, including who the decision makers and influencers are; participates with account teams (e.g., Account Executives) in communication with business or subject matter decision makers at the customer's/partner's business.

• Identifies opportunities to drive consumption and grow business with existing customers by initiating conversations, providing demos or quotes, and collaborating with partners or internal teams (e.g., Technical Sales Professionals, global black belts [GBBs]); for licensing transactions and project engagements, ensures rapid and robust deployment plan at point of sale that is validated by services and partners; identifies, articulates, and facilitates the removal of blockers to consumption by partnering with internal and external stakeholders.

• Collaborates with team members to discover new opportunities; drives incremental revenue growth through personal campaigns (e.g., portfolio analysis) or internal sources (e.g., marketing, account teams); collaborates with account teams, partners, or services to track, qualify, and expand new opportunities; collaborates with other teams (e.g., account teams) and services to build pipeline; interfaces with customers and builds relationships via social selling; applies Microsoft's sales process (MSP) to determine the quality of the opportunity and whether to proceed.

Scaling and Collaboration

• Applies the orchestration model to support deal closure by identifying and aligning internal stakeholders and leveraging relationships with partners.

• Collaborates with One Commercial Partner (OCP) and with a network of partners to cross-sell, up-sell, and co-sell products, solutions and services; identifies new partners by researching and discussing with partners on customer scenarios; develops joint proposals and consumption plans with partners; implements partner strategies to scale the business.

• Technical Expertise

• Researches competitor products, solutions, and/or services and collaborates with the "compete" global black belts (GBBs) to implement strategies to position Microsoft against competitors in customer communication.

Required/minimum qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field AND 5+ years of cloud technology related sales or Enterprise account management experience.

• Fluency in Japanese (native level) and English for internal communication is essential.

Additional or preferred qualifications

• 2+ years of solution sales or consulting services sales experience.

となります。

Salesの役割では、お客様のニーズ・課題の理解と深堀から新たなビジネスの創出、最適なクラウドソリューションを提案・導入までリードいただきます。
CxOレベルの意思決定者との関係構築を通じて、インフラ、アプリケーションやデータの移行・モダナイゼーション、業務アプリケーションの開発・導入提案、インテリジェントデータプラットフォーム提案など、社内のアカウントチーム・技術チームはもとより、パートナー企業と連携しながら案件創出から導入、Azureビジネスの最大化を図ります。

---
We are seeking an Azure Solutions Specialist Sales Representative to focus on the public sector (primarily government agencies, such as the Central Government and the defense sector).
We are looking for candidates with over 10 years of experience in the public sector, as well as experience in cloud and system integration (SI) businesses, who can maximize Azure business opportunities at a higher level.
The ideal candidate:
・As a candidate for next-generation leadership, you will actively participate in team management and proactively engage with internal and external stakeholders to build new partnerships and relationships.
・You will drive collaboration within the team, contribute to enhancing team performance, and demonstrate strong leadership in delivering value to the company and the market.
・You are committed to continuously striving to achieve various set goals.
In the Sales role, you will lead the process from understanding and delving into customer needs and challenges to creating new business opportunities, and proposing and implementing optimal cloud solutions.
By building relationships with CxO-level decision-makers, you will work in collaboration with internal account and technical teams—as well as partner companies—to maximize the Azure business, from project generation through implementation. This includes infrastructure, application, and data migration and modernization; the development and implementation of business applications; and proposals for intelligent data platforms.

Responsibilities
・エンゲージメント
お客様のニーズ、課題・優先事項の把握から計画実行に向けたビジネスプランの策定。AIビジネスをはじめとする長期的なパートナーシップを構築する。
社内外リソース、パートナーとの関係構築からビジネス活性化し、共に営業戦略（個社・エリア）の立案と実行を進める。

・セールスと管理
担当するアカウントおよびエリアにおける販売目標達成に向けた戦略の立案と実行。AIによる分析および予測ツールの活用により精度を高める。
各ビジネスパイプラインの進捗、達成状況など、各種ツール、リソース、プロセスを用いてforecastの管理を行う。
AIを活用し、提供されたインサイトをもとに新たなビジネス機会を評価し、パイプライン創出につなげる。

アカウントチームと協力し、担当するお客様のアカウントプラン作成から役割分担を明確化し、PDCAを実行する。
自社ソリューションビジネスの最大化を目的に担当するAzureビジネスのみならずM365をはじめとするクロスソリューション連携を視野に、社内組織の横断連携を推進する。
競争の激しいクラウドビジネス環境において、Whyマイクロソフトを念頭にお客様との関係構築から提案、導入、運用時まで継続的に行うことで、市場への価値提供を訴求する。

---
・Engagement
Formulate business plans—from identifying customer needs, challenges, and priorities to executing those plans. Build long-term partnerships, particularly in the AI business sector.
Stimulate business growth by building relationships with internal and external resources and partners, and jointly develop and execute sales strategies (for individual companies and regions).
・Sales and Management
Develop and execute strategies to achieve sales targets for assigned accounts and regions. Enhance accuracy by utilizing AI-powered analytics and forecasting tools.
Manage forecasts using various tools, resources, and processes to track progress and achievement status across each business pipeline.
Leverage AI to evaluate new business opportunities based on the insights provided, leading to the creation of new pipelines.
・Sales Strategy
Collaborate with the account team to create account plans for assigned customers, clarify role assignments, and implement the PDCA cycle.
With the goal of maximizing our company’s solution business, promote cross-functional collaboration within the organization, focusing not only on the Azure business under your responsibility but also on cross-solution integration, including M365.
In the highly competitive cloud business environment, continuously engage with customers—from relationship building through proposal, implementation, and operations—with the “Why Microsoft” mindset in mind to effectively communicate the value we provide to the market.

description:

AIの進化により、企業は業務プロセスそのものをAIで再設計するフェーズへと進んでいます。

本ポジションは、M365 Copilot/Cowork/Autopilotsを含むAgentsをベースに、Dynamics 365、Power Platformなどを活用し、お客様の経営・事業課題を起点とした Business Process Transformationをリードする営業組織のマネージャーです。Solution Sales Managerとして、高い専門性を持つ営業チームを率い、メンバーの成長と成功を支援するとともに、CxOや事業責任者との戦略的な対話を通じて、新たな市場・ビジネス機会の創出から、大規模かつ複雑なTransformationの実現までをリードします。

求めているのは、既存のソリューションを販売するだけではなく、「AI時代の新しい業務とビジネスをお客様とともに創り、それを市場としてスケールさせる」Sales Leaderです。 これまでのEnterprise SalesやSales Managementの経験を土台としながら、AIによる市場変化を新たなビジネス機会として捉え、継続的に学び、俊敏に変化し、スピード感を持ってチームをリードできる方を求めています。次世代のEnterprise市場を、自らのチームとともに切り拓いていただくポジションです。

変化を楽しみ、私たちとともにまだ答えのない新しい市場を創っていく。そんな挑戦者を、ぜひお待ちしています。

Responsibilities
1. ビジネス戦略・パイプライン・売上成長の推進

• 市場・顧客動向を踏まえた営業戦略を策定し、新規ビジネス機会の創出から案件戦略、クロージングまでSales Lifecycle全体をリードする。

• 短期的な売上目標の達成と中長期的なビジネス成長の両面に責任を持ち、継続的かつ健全なPipelineを構築する。

• ForecastとPipelineを高い精度でマネジメントし、チームとして持続的に成果を創出できるSales Disciplineを確立する。

2. AIを起点としたBusiness Process Transformationの推進

• CxO 、事業責任者、業務・ITリーダーとの戦略的な対話を通じて、お客様の経営・事業課題を理解し、AIで変革すべき重要なBusiness Processを特定する。

• M365 Copilot/Cowork/Autopilotsを含めたAgent、Dynamics 365、Power Platform などを組み合わせ、既存業務の効率化にとどまらない、End-to-EndのBusiness Process Transformationを構想・推進する。

• Technology起点ではなくBusiness Outcome起点で、Transformation Agenda、Business Case、ROI、実現ロードマップの形成をリードする。

3. One MicrosoftによるEnd-to-Endのオーケストレーション

• Account Team、Solution Engineering、Customer Success、Engineering、Corporate Team、Partnerなど、社内外の多様なステークホルダーを横断してオーケストレーションする。

• 複雑かつ大規模なTransformation Opportunityにおいて、各チームの専門性を結集し、構想策定からSolution Design、意思決定、契約、導入・活用までをEnd-to-Endで推進する。

• 個別案件にとどまらず、成功事例やパートナーとの連携を通じて、再現可能なSales Motionやエコシステムの拡大につなげる。

4. MicrosoftのAI戦略を市場・顧客の成長機会へ転換

• MicrosoftのAI戦略、Product Innovation、市場・競合動向を理解し、担当市場・業界における具体的な営業戦略とExecutionへ落とし込む。

• AI/Agentによる新しいユースケースや市場機会を継続的に発掘し、お客様のBusiness OutcomeとMicrosoftのBusiness Growthの双方につなげる。

• Customer Obsession、Growth Mindset、Collaborationを重視し、急速な市場変化をビジネス機会へ転換できるチームカルチャーを構築する。

5. 営業組織のリード・人材育成

• 明確な優先順位とアカウンタビリティを持つHigh-Performing Sales Teamを構築し、メンバーの継続的な育成・コーチングを行う。

• Growth MindsetとChallenger Mentalityを持ち、お客様のビジネス課題から新たな価値を提案できる営業人材を育成する。

• チーム全体のSolution Sales、Executive Engagement、案件創出・クロージング力を継続的に高める。

Qualifications
必須要件

• 大手法人向けのEnterprise Sales、Solution Sales、またはBusiness Transformationの経験、および複雑な案件を商談創出からクロージングまでリードした実績

CRMセールスエグゼクティブは、ServiceNowのCRMの市場での成功を牽引する営業職です。これらの製品は、ServiceNow AI Platform上に構築された営業管理、CPQ、オーダー管理、カスタマーサービス管理、フィールドサービス管理といった広範な業務機能を有しています。「CRM built to finish the work」というスローガンのもと、AIネイティブで、あらゆる顧客の要望や問い合わせを「解決」することができる、強力なワークフロー製品群です。

担当アカウントおよび/またはテリトリーにおける四半期・年間の売上目標の達成に向けて、以下の業務を担当いただきます。

• 担当テリトリーのServiceNowパートナーチャネルを支援し、お客様にとって最適な体験を実現

• セールスおよびパートナーエコシステム向けのセールスイネーブルメント

• インサイドセールスからの支援が限られた環境での、見込み顧客の選定と新規商談・継続的な収益源の創出

description:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.

As a member of our Solution Consulting team, you will have a major impact on our future success by supporting  solution sales. You will guide revenue for one of our  products with the support and partnership of Sales, Product Management, and the executive team. This is a hands-on technical consultant who can go wide and deep on solution delivery and solution positioning during sales cycles.
What you get to do in this role:
The Solution Consultant is a technical consultant with the advanced ability to develop, position and provide product-specific solutions during sales cycles while achieving quarterly and annual sales goals for an assigned territory.

• Support product sales as a technical and domain expert of a client-facing sales team

• Lead discovery workshops to determine customers' challenges and give product demonstrations to align our solution with customer needs

• Answer product feature and technical questions from customers, channel partners and ServiceNow colleagues

• Provide feedback to product management about product enhancements that can address customer needs and provide additional value

• Share and learn best practices and re-usable assets with other Solution Consultants to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team

• Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation

• Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

To be successful in this role you have:

• Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

• 7+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience

• Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or technical expertise with cloud software solutions

• Experience working collaboratively with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services

• Territory management skills, including pipeline building and working with Sales counterpart to guide execution excellence

• Travel, as necessary

• Must be fluent in Japanese

• Must be authorized to work in Japan

description:

As a Public Sector Account Executive – Japan, you will own strategic sales into Japan’s government and broader public sector, driving adoption of our data and AI platform across central ministries, local governments, and public institutions. You will lead the full sales cycle, build executive relationships, and collaborate closely with internal and partner teams to support Japan’s digital government and modernization initiatives.

The impact you will have:

• Own and exceed revenue targets by winning new public sector customers across Japan, including central ministries, local governments, government agencies, and public institutions.

• Develop and execute a clear territory and account strategy to identify, prioritize, and win high‑potential public sector accounts.

• Plan, document, and drive the expansion of Databricks usage in newly landed accounts, turning initial projects into broad, high‑impact data and AI platforms.

• Proactively identify new AI and data use cases in government operations and feed these insights into Japan’s public sector go‑to‑market, influencing product direction and regional strategy.

• Use a solution‑oriented, value‑based sales approach that links Databricks to measurable outcomes for public services and citizens.

• Orchestrate Databricks’ internal teams and our ecosystem of partners (SI, cloud, and consulting partners) to run effective sales motions and deliver successful customer outcomes.

What we look for:

• 8+ years of SaaS, cloud, AI, or big data sales experience in Japan, with meaningful exposure to public sector accounts and a proven ability to drive adoption of new technologies through a consultative, solutions‑oriented sales approach.

• Demonstrated ability to navigate complex public sector stakeholder ecosystems, building consensus across multiple departments, budget owners, and decision/approval layers.

• Deep understanding of public sector priorities in Japan, including typical buying processes, buying cycles, decision‑making structures, and the broader ecosystem of partners that support government projects.

• Extensive experience with Japanese government procurement, including familiarity with budget formulation and execution, tender/RFP processes, evaluation criteria, and relevant compliance and security frameworks.

• Strong background in selling usage‑based PaaS/SaaS or data, AI, and ML solutions is highly preferred.

• Solid experience applying structured sales methodologies and processes (e.g., account planning, MEDDPICC, value selling, Command of the Message) to win complex, multi‑stakeholder deals.

• Proven track record of creating strong customer champions and leading collaborative internal and external teams to support implementation and expansion within strategic accounts.

• Clear understanding of how to build a focused partner strategy for the public sector and manage SI, cloud, and consulting partners to jointly win and deliver large, impactful projects.

description:
SLSQ327R384

Databricks is seeking a Lakebase Sales Specialist Account Executive to help customers modernize their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase, our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications. This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams. The role will cover strategic enterprise customers within the Greater China region.

Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity.

The impact you will have

• Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and closing Lakebase opportunities within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team.

• Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency.

• Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences.

• Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders.

• Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists.

• Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references.

• Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape.

• Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs.

• Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization.

What success looks like in this role

This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously:

• Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase.

• Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts.

Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business.

Success in this role requires strength in four areas:

• Business ownership – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.

• Strategic account engagement – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.

• Field enablement – Build and execute enablement plans that empower AEs and SAs to confidently carry the Lakebase conversation even when the specialist is not present.

• Market voice and thought leadership – Develop an internal and external presence by contributing to global AMAs and internal forums, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.

The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.

What we look for

• 7+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals covering Greater China enterprises

• Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders in GCR region.

• Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures, including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies.

• Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners).

• Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions, working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities.

• Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers.

• Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes.

• Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services, ideally within large or strategic accounts.

• Familiarity with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies.

• Understanding of reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications.

• Exposure to AI-native and agent-driven applications that depend on low-latency, highly scalable operational data services.

• Prior experience in a high-growth, category-creating environment, helping shape new plays, messaging, and customer narratives.

• Experience collaborating with partners and ISVs to drive joint pipeline and co-sell motions.

description:
#LI-KO1

コマーシャル・セールス・チームのアカウント・エグゼクティブとして、中小規模の市場において戦略的に新規顧客を獲得し、クロージングすることで、Datadogのビジネス全体の成長に貢献します。確立されたセールス・メソッドとプロセスに沿って営業活動を進め、社内にいる複数の関係者と協力し、顧客独自のニーズを特定し、Datadog製品の価値を明確に伝えます。アカウント・エグゼクティブとして確実なキャリアを構築しながら、Datadogのコマーシャル・セールス・チームとして、一緒に成功を掴みましょう！

Datadogでは、オフィスカルチャーによって築かれる人間関係やコラボレーション、そこからもたらされる創造性を大切にしています。私たちは、従業員それぞれに合ったワーク・ライフ・ハーモニーを実現できるよう、ハイブリッド・ワークプレイスとして運営しています。

業務内容：

• アウトバウンドでの営業活動による新規顧客（ロゴ）獲得に注力

• 継続的かつ充実した製品・セールスのトレーニングを通じて、Datadogのエキスパートになる

• 技術面なデモや交渉などを含めた、すべての販売サイクルを担当する

• セールス・デベロップメント・チームと協力し、潜在顧客の開拓活動を推進する

• CTO・CIOや、エンジニアリング・ITのリーダー層、技術系エンドユーザーを戦略的に開拓する

募集要項：

• IT製品のフィールドセールス経験（クロージング含む）が2年以上

• 好奇心旺盛で新しいテクノロジーに関する知識習得への高い意欲

• 限定されたやり方に捉われず、クリエイティブな新規開拓活動ができる

• フィードバックから学び、継続的に成長し続けるマインド

• テクニカルな製品の取り扱いや、ペースの速い環境での業務に慣れている

• 営業KPI達成の経験があり、高い実績がある

Datadogは、さまざまな立場の人々を大切にしています。誰もが初日から上記の資格をすべて満たすわけではないことは理解しています。それでも構いません。テクノロジーに情熱を持ち、スキルを伸ばしたいと思っている方は、ぜひご応募ください。

福利厚生と成長機会：

• 個々のパフォーマンスと成果に基づく豊かな報酬体系

• 新入社員への株式付与（RSU / 譲渡制限付株式ユニット）および従業員株式購入制度（ESPP）

• 継続的な専門能力開発、製品トレーニング、キャリアパスの提供

• MEDDICとCommand of Messageに関する丁寧な営業研修

• 社内ネットワーク構築のためのメンターおよびバディ・プログラム

• インクルーシブな企業文化、コミュニティ・ギルドへの参加機会

• 幅広く手厚い医療関連の福利厚生制度

• 企業型確定拠出年金（401K）

• ペットの養子縁組と保険プログラム

上記の内容は、就業する国やDatadogでの雇用内容によって異なる場合があります。

世界中のすべての候補者様にご理解頂けるよう、応募情報に関する項目は一部、英語のままで記載されています。全ての求人情報を英語でご確認されたい場合は、 こちら をご覧ください。

description:
We are Datadog's in-house product experts. The Technical Solutions (TS) team enables Datadog's worldwide growth by educating potential clients and ensuring that existing customers are happy and successful. Field CTOs are part of the broader Product Solutions Architecture (PSA) organization, serving as technical multipliers and trusted advisors to our customers' most senior decision makers and key executive stakeholders. They align customer ambitions with Datadog’s technology roadmap, enabling digital transformation while driving sustained growth for both our customers and Datadog.

As Datadog continues to scale, we are creating a Field CTO role to lead our GTM technical strategy for the entire Japan region - establishing thought leadership, building the long-term strategic case for Datadog, and expanding our footprint in the market.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

• C-Level : Strategically guide CIO/CTO/CEO/CISO-level customer and prospect executives in rationalizing their adoption journey, investment and operationalizing of observability.

• GTM : Identifies industry specific trends and their impact and potential during Customers engagements, feeding the top-of-funnel for Product, GTM, BVA and Architecture teams. Co-create industry solutions via collaboration with Product SAs and Product Management.

• Leadership : Demonstrate Datadog's platform as well as thought leadership in Observability and Security, emphasizing our advanced solutions, industry best practices, and dedication to providing organizations with superior visibility and management of their at scale environments.

• Advisory : Be a trusted advisor to Sales leaders as well as customer and prospect executives on ROI, value realization and white-space analysis. Assist with opportunity and adoption strategy for individual customers within their vertical of expertise.

• Collaboration : Collaborate with Product Solutions Architecture (PSA), Sales, Sales Engineering and Marketing in providing high-quality technical resources to a broad audience of practitioners and economic buyers.

• Presentations : Lead architecture and design engagements to demonstrate how Datadog meets the needs of strategic customers. Participate in Executive Brief conversations in Datatadog’s Executive Briefing Center (EBC) with high profile customers and prospects about overall architecture, Observability Best Practices and industry trends.

• Hiring : Assist leadership in recruiting and hiring of top talent for the Product Solutions Architecture and Field CTO teams.

Who You Are:

• Industry Experience: Strong experience of at least 15+ years with Enterprise architecture or Application architecture at scale and ability to map architectures to real world use cases, coupled with deep knowledge of the observability space, cloud, and technological shifts for customers in the Japan region.

• Strategic Thinker : Able to think long term and creatively about a wide variety of technical and business challenges

• Stakeholder Management : Experienced in interacting and influencing key stakeholders (VP+ and C level) in large Enterprise organizations

• Technologist : Hands-on technologist who gains credibility and establishes strong relationships at all levels of the organization

• Presenter : Excellent customer-facing presentation skills for large audiences, comfortable discussing complex technical details as well as with briefing executives or non-technical personas.

• Communicator : Excellent verbal and written communication skills, ability to link product functionality to business objectives, value realization and ROI.

• Education : Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field, Master’s degree preferred

• Native level in Japanese with strong English proficiency (both spoken and written) to communicate effectively with customers in Japan

description:
We are Datadog's in-house product experts. The Technical Enablement Management (TEM) team empowers customers through technical training sessions, ensuring they maximize the value of Datadog. We combine deep technical knowledge with a consultative approach, demonstrating best practices and tailoring training to specific use cases.

As a Manager on this team, you will play a critical role in strengthening our relationships with Sales and Customer Success teams across APJ, developing and coaching the Technical Enablement Managers (TEMs) who report to you, and evolving our enablement programs to better support customer adoption and success. You will lead a distributed team of Technical Enablement Managers covering markets across Asia and ANZ. Manager 2 leaders at Datadog are people-first managers, trusted collaborators, and operational owners. In APJ you will also be the most senior enablement voice in the region, so you will spend as much time building awareness and credibility with Sales and Customer Success as you do managing delivery.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

• Own the positioning and enablement strategy for Sales and Customer Success teams in APJ, driving attach rates by positioning training as a value-added service and increasing consumption of complimentary offerings

• Build demand upstream: engage Sales and Customer Success teams across the region at scale, keep positioning and materials current, and drive consistent use of the request process

• Act as the quality gate for incoming work, scoping requests to the right offering, focusing broad asks into targeted sessions, and aligning demand to business need

• Analyze customer training adoption and feedback, evaluating programs for ROI to inform which offerings to scale, evolve, or retire

• Develop sales tools and enablement resources that help internal teams confidently position and sell training to customers

• Drive consistency in training delivery, content utilization and reporting across the team, evaluating delivery quality and distinguishing facilitation gaps from content gaps

• Build and maintain the intake and capacity-planning mechanisms the team runs on, including pre-session questionnaires, triage, prioritisation frameworks and accurate time tracking, and continuously iterate on tooling and processes to improve efficiency and scalability

• Lead, coach and mentor a team of TEMs across APJ, conducting regular 1:1s, performance evaluations and session shadowing, identifying performance gaps early and managing performance formally when coaching alone is not enough

• Proactively monitor team KPIs (utilization, CSAT, productivity, session delivery against demand, and attendance rates), diagnosing trends and gaps, and assign workload so that TEMs achieve an 80% productivity target while balancing training delivery, content creation and enablement activities

• Champion the use of AI tools within the team to improve productivity from content creation and session prep through to reporting and QA, coach TEMs on effective and responsible use, and identify opportunities to apply AI to scale enablement delivery and improve program ROI

• Actively participate in recruiting, hiring and onboarding across the team and the broader organization

• Collaborate with Technical Solutions leadership, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering and Product teams to address urgent needs and implement process improvements

Who You Are:

• An experienced people manager, results-driven, with a strong focus on executing strategies that drive measurable business impact and revenue growth

• A strong coach and mentor who invests in career development and builds inclusive, high-performing teams, and who has authored the things that let a team scale: career progression frameworks, structured onboarding and a consistent coaching cadence

• Has built demand for a services or enablement function by going out to Sales and Customer Success rather than waiting for inbound requests, and can point to a measurable before and after

• A clear communicator who can influence without authority and align stakeholders around common goals

• Energised by bringing a service to new internal audiences, and able to make the case as compellingly on the twentieth telling as on the first

• Able to hold priorities firmly when demands compete, renegotiating scope with partner teams while keeping the relationship strong

• Deliberate about priorities, with a track record of choosing what not to take on and delegating rather than absorbing

• Culturally adaptable across Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia and ANZ, adjusting approach per market rather than applying one style everywhere

• Direct and transparent, setting clear expectations and healthy boundaries, and calm when plans change at short notice

• Exceptionally self-organised, owning their own scheduling, follow-up and administrative rhythm

• A strategic thinker who balances customer needs with business goals, evaluates program ROI and drives cross-functional alignment, with a track record of implementing scalable enablement programs in a growing company

• Data-driven, comfortable using metrics and KPIs to inform decisions and optimize performance

• Demonstrated capability of utilizing AI tooling and scaling it, with a growth mindset of embracing change and being curious

• Technically proficient, with knowledge of modern infrastructure, monitoring solutions, and cloud technologies

• Experienced (5+ years) in Training, Presales, Post-Sales, Consulting, or another customer-facing role, with a history of success

• Educated in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

• Requires up to 25% travel across the APJ region, primarily to drive and promote enablement adoption with Sales and Customer Success along with team development and cross-functional planning

• インクルーシブな企業文化、コミュニティ・ギルドへの参加機会

description:

We are looking for Mandarin speaking who are based in Kuala Lumpur for our hybrid working model.

Customer Advisory

• Lead and scale effective customer onboarding by leveraging product adoption telemetry to monitor early deployment health, proactively identify and mitigate configuration risks, and guide customers through prescriptive best practices, architectures, and operational strategies that establish a strong technical foundation and accelerate time-to-value and achieve customers’ business outcomes with MongoDB

• Drive ongoing consumption and value realization through a mix of 1:1 and 1:many engagements (e.g., targeted campaigns, webinars, office hours), using data-driven insights to identify trends, opportunities, and risks across a broad customer portfolio and recommending optimal solutions, features, and adoption paths to achieve customers’ business outcomes with MongoDB

Account & Portfolio Management

Experience in managing scaled or pooled portfolios utilizing scalable strategies to enhance customer retention is a plus. MongoDBのミッションとカスタマーサクセスの役割

MongoDBのミッションは、ソフトウェアとデータの力を解き放つことで、革新者が業界を創出、変革、そして常識を覆すことです。私たちは、企業のレガシーワークロードを現代化し、イノベーションを受け入れ、AIの力を最大限に活用できるよう支援することで、あらゆる規模の組織がモダンなアプリケーションを容易に構築、拡張、運用できるようにします。

業界を牽引する当社の開発者向けデータプラットフォーム「MongoDB Atlas」は、業界唯一のグローバル分散型マルチクラウドデータベースであり、AWS、Google Cloud、Microsoft Azureにわたる115以上のリージョンで利用可能です。Atlasによって、お客様はオンプレミスや異なるクラウドプロバイダー間など、あらゆる場所でアプリケーションを構築・運用することができます。当社は世界中にオフィスを構え、毎月175,000人以上の新しい開発者が利用登録を行っており、Samsungやトヨタのような大手企業から、Delivery HeroやLG U+といったAIの革新者に至るまで、多くの企業が次世代のAI駆動型アプリケーションの構築においてMongoDBを信頼しています。

当社のカスタマーサクセスチームは、導入後のお客様との関係構築において要となる存在です。。深いビジネス知識と技術的な知見を融合させることで、カスタマーサクセスはMongoDBをお客様のテクノロジー戦略の中心に位置づける役割を担い、すべてのお客様がその投資の可能性を最大限に引き出せるよう支援しています。

募集職種：カスタマーサクセスマネジメント（The Role）

カスタマーサクセスマネジメント（CSM）の役割は、信頼されるアドバイザーとして、お客様がMongoDBを活用する上での道のりを、支援することです。

担当ポートフォリオとなる顧客アカウントの生涯価値の最大化と成功に責任を持ち、お客様固有のビジネス目標を達成するために、最適なタイミングで最適なリソースへとつなぐ戦略的パートナーとして活躍していただきます。また、顧客維持（、収益実現、およびお客様からの支持・推奨の促進

を推進する役割も担います。

お客様と深い信頼関係を築き、そのニーズを徹底的に理解した上で、アカウントチームや社内リソースをスムーズに活用し、、お客様が最も必要とする領域で目に見える確かなインパクトを提供することが求められます。

【勤務形態】 ハイブリッドワーク（東京オフィスに通勤可能な方を対象としています）

主な職務内容（Key Responsibilities）

顧客へのアドバイザリー（Customer Advisory）

• プロアクティブなリスク特定と運用の最適化: ベストプラクティスや運用戦略を提案することで、プロアクティブにリスクを特定し、システムのデプロイメント・ヘルスを健全に保ちます。お客様の重大な課題に対して最適なソリューションを提供することで、価値創出までの期間（Time-to-Value）を短縮し、MongoDBの導入を通じてビジネス目標を達成できるよう導きます。

• ビジネスレビューの実施と成果への変換: 包括的なビジネスレビュー（QBRなど）を実施し、技術的な健全性や運用パフォーマンスを分析した上で、そこから得られたインサイトを「価値ベースの成果」へと落とし込みます。技術リーダーやビジネスリーダーと連携して目標をすり合わせ、成長と顧客維持を促進する「相互成功計画（Mutual Success Plan）」を推進します。

アカウント＆ポートフォリオ管理（Account & Portfolio Management）

• 顧客成熟度とLTVの向上: 顧客の習熟度、顧客生涯価値（LTV）、顧客維持、および収益実現を推進するアカウントプランの。様々なフェーズにいる担当ポートフォリオの顧客をプロアクティブに管理し、価値実現の最大化、継続利用の促進、そして長期的な成功に向けた戦略を策定・実行します。

• 進捗管理と拡大機会の創出: 重要なビジネス成果指標に対する進捗管理・レポーティングを行い、事業の予測可能性向上に向けて、収益維持および収益実現のフォーキャストを経営層へ報告していただきます。、加えて、顧客へのインパクトを拡大する新たな機会を特定し、プレセールスチームと連携してさらなる成長を支援します。

• 正確なデータ管理とAIツールの活用: 社内システムにおいて綿密なデータ管理（を維持し、顧客インサイトの正確な一元管理（と正確なテリトリー分析を実現します。AIツールを活用して日々のワークフローを効率化し、生産性を向上させ、カスタマーサクセスの成果を最適化します。

社内連携＆顧客の継続利用の促進（Internal Collaboration & Customer Advocacy）

• 顧客の声を社内へ届ける: MongoDB社内における「顧客の代弁者」として、顧客のインサイトを製品ロードマップに反映させます。また、営業、プロダクト、プロフェッショナルサービス、サポート、トレーニングなどの各チームと連携し、顧客ヘルス、満足度、および価値実現を推進します。

• 最適なリソースとのマッチング: マーケティングプログラムやエグゼクティブ・スポンサーとのエンゲージメントを含め、お客様を最適な社内リソースと結びつけます。同時に、顧客との対話から得られた学びをチームに共有し、チーム全体の成功を強化するとともに、顧客価値を最大化します。

求められるスキル・経験（What You Will Bring）

• 実務経験: 高度な技術力を要する製品（従量課金制/コンサンプションベースの製品が望ましい）において、技術系顧客対応職（テクニカルカスタマーサクセス、ソリューションアーキテクト／エンジニアリング、プロフェッショナルサービス／導入支援、テクニカルアカウントマネジメントなど）における5〜7年以上の経験。

• アカウンタビリティ（責任）: エンタープライズ企業またはハイテク業界の顧客ポートフォリオを持ち、顧客のヘルスおよび収益の現実に責任を持った3年以上の経験。

• コミュニケーション能力: 技術的な成果およびビジネスの成果の双方において、周囲に影響を与え、意思決定を促すことができる優れた口頭・書面でのコミュニケーションスキル。

• 学歴・バックグラウンド: コンピュータサイエンス、STEM（科学・技術・工学・数学）分野の学士号、またはそれと同等の技術的な実務経験。

MongoDBについて（About MongoDB）

description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Okta Vision

Okta’s vision is to enable anyone to safely use any technology through a secure, highly available, enterprise-grade identity platform. Our technology secures billions of workforce logins each year.

At Okta, we empower our sales teams through world-class onboarding, ongoing development, and a culture of support and collaboration.

The Opportunity: Enterprise Regional Sales Manager – Indonesia

We are looking for an experienced, high-performing, and commercially driven Enterprise Regional Sales Manager to accelerate Okta's growth across strategic and enterprise accounts in Indonesia.

In this role, you will own a portfolio of Indonesia's largest organisations, focusing on winning net-new enterprise customers and expanding relationships within our existing customer base. You'll develop and execute a territory strategy that drives revenue growth, strengthens Okta's market presence, and builds long-term customer partnerships.

As AI adoption accelerates, identity security is becoming increasingly critical. Organisations must now secure employees, customers, and non-human identities, including service accounts, automation tools, and AI agents. Okta's unified Identity Security Fabric enables organisations to manage and secure identities across their entire lifecycle.

You'll work closely with C-suite executives, technology leaders, and key stakeholders to position Okta as a strategic partner in their cybersecurity, digital transformation, and AI initiatives.

This is an opportunity to shape Okta's enterprise business in Indonesia while helping leading organisations address increasingly complex identity security challenges.

What You'll Be Doing

•
Own and grow the Indonesia enterprise territory: Develop and execute a strategic territory plan covering large enterprise and strategic accounts, balancing new customer acquisition with existing account expansion.

•
Drive net-new business: Identify, prospect, and win new enterprise customers through strategic account planning, executive engagement, and consistent pipeline generation.

•
Expand existing customer relationships: Identify cross-selling, upselling, and platform adoption opportunities to maximise customer value and revenue growth.

•
Build executive relationships: Engage C-suite executives, CIOs, CISOs, and senior decision-makers, establishing Okta as a trusted strategic partner.

•
Lead complex enterprise sales cycles: Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes, develop compelling business cases, and drive opportunities through negotiation and closure.

•
Execute strategic account plans: Identify customer priorities, key stakeholders, competitive positioning, and long-term growth opportunities.

•
Leverage the partner ecosystem: Collaborate with GSIs, regional partners, resellers, and technology alliances to accelerate opportunities and expand Okta's market reach.

•
Orchestrate cross-functional teams: Lead virtual teams across Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Renewals, Services, Partners, and Business Development.

•
Deliver consistent sales performance: Build a healthy pipeline, maintain accurate forecasts, and consistently achieve or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.

•
Establish market leadership: Position yourself as a trusted advisor and thought leader in identity, cybersecurity, and cloud transformation.

•
Represent Okta's values: Embody Love Our Customers, Always Secure, Always On, Build and Own It, and Drive What's Next .

•
Travel as needed to engage customers, partners, and stakeholders across Indonesia.

What You'll Bring

•
10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, with a consistent record of exceeding targets in complex sales environments.

•
Proven success selling enterprise SaaS, cybersecurity, identity, or cloud solutions to large enterprise and strategic accounts.

•
Strong knowledge of the Indonesian enterprise market, including local business dynamics, customer buying processes, and partner ecosystems.

•
Demonstrated success in both net-new logo acquisition and existing account expansion, with strong hunting and strategic account management capabilities.

•
Experience managing complex, high-value enterprise sales cycles involving senior executives and multiple stakeholders.

•
Strong executive presence and the ability to influence C-suite decision-makers, particularly CIOs, CISOs, and technology leaders.

•
Proven ability to develop territory strategies, generate pipeline, and deliver predictable revenue growth.

•
Experience collaborating with GSIs, channel partners, and technology alliances to create and close opportunities.

•
Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and a consultative, customer-focused sales approach.

•
Familiarity with sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC and Command of the Message is preferred.

•
An entrepreneurial, curious, and adaptable mindset with a passion for cybersecurity and innovation.

•
Excellent communication and presentation skills in Bahasa Indonesia and English.

•
A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Their primary objective is to move accounts through the sales pipeline and accelerate the sales cycle for prospects.

• Team up with Field and Partner Marketing teams to help Okta Sales deliver on annual revenue pipeline and balance pipeline objectives through the execution of various field / regional events, programs and campaigns and help facilitate lead funnel management across all activities

• Execute on event strategy, tactical plans and project manage all logistics, onsite execution and post event analysis for our participation

• Coordinate pre-to-post show event marketing strategies and collect post-event feedback and develop post event reports and analysis

• Effectively work cross-functionally - you will help define, project manage and execute on event program goals, messaging, tactics, audience generation/email campaigns, speaker plan, collateral, post-show leads processing & follow-up and other logistics

• Help with the research and development of events, sponsorships, face to face marketing platforms that align to corporate goals

• 3-5 years in marketing execution, event creation and campaign management

• Japanese native and excellent oral and written communication skills in Japanese & English

• Experience managing all aspects of event programs, from planning to reporting and analysis

• Thrives in rapid growth, energising environment and adapts well to change

• A positive, collaborative team player with strong multitasking abilities

• Project management experience covering project planning, event management, promotion and registration, content development, and on-site management

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!

• Excellent presentation skills and confidence in communicating with various stakeholders

• Experience with sales and marketing systems – Asana, Salesforce and Marketo, Tableau a plus

• Experience in B2B Technology marketing

description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人 ：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人 ：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人 ：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター ：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人 ：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における5年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人 ：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人 ：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人 ：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター ：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人 ：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

Role

We are looking for an Account Executive-Majors to join our Sales team in Hong Kong. Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, you will be the driving force behind Zscaler’s growth. You will be responsible for understanding and solving customer pain points through a unique value proposition, focusing on high-impact growth within your territory. By educating key decision-makers on inspiring technology, you will drive the mission forward and ensure customer success.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

•
Deeply understand customer pain points and articulate Zscaler’s unique value proposition to provide transformative solutions

•
Lead with a visionary approach, educating C-level executives and key stakeholders on how our "inspiring technology" can future-proof their organizations

•
Develop and execute a comprehensive territory plan encompassing account coverage, target prospects, partner alignment, and targeted marketing campaigns

•
Apply world-class sales methodologies to consistently overachieve on quarterly and annual revenue targets

•
Partner closely with Sales Engineers to demonstrate both the technical superiority and the tangible business value of Zscaler

Who You Are (Success Profile)

•
You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

•
You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

•
You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

•
You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

•
You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

•
Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• 10 plus years of professional experience in Sales with a consistent history of managing and exceeding a revenue quota

•
Progressive experience engaging with and selling to C-Level executives

•
Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

•
Proven experience leveraging AI-powered sales intelligence, predictive analytics, or conversational AI platforms to optimize enterprise territory planning, accelerate pipeline generation, and enhance strategic decision-making

•
Deep experience selling Security, SaaS, AI or Software solutions

•
A proven ability to work with Channel partners to co-develop pipeline, create joint plans, and lead opportunities to closure

Role

We are looking for a Technical Success Manager to join our Japan team. This is a hybrid role, reporting to the Manager of Technical Success. You will guide customers through their Zero Trust journey as the central post-sales point of contact, helping them adopt and maximize their usage of Zscaler's solutions to secure their digital transformation objectives. Your role centers on providing expert advice, building relationships, and ensuring successful solution adoption for Zscaler’s customers.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

•
Build and nurture relationships with key customer stakeholders and operational service owners to define and prioritize strategic alignment between customer objectives and Zscaler’s goals

•
Offer technical guidance, product insights, and best practices for the integration and expansion of Zscaler solutions through the development of customized technical strategies

•
Provide technical expertise and organizational skills to manage escalations and coordinate resolutions with internal and external teams

•
Identify adoption insights and develop risk mitigation plans proactively to manage and protect assigned customer accounts

•
Participate in the creation and sharing of intellectual capital including training and best practice guides to enhance the Customer Success team's capabilities

Who You Are (Success Profile)

•
You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

•
You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

•
You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

•
You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

•
You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

•
Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

•
5+ years of experience in a customer-facing role (such as Solutions Delivery, Customer Success Management, Technical Account Management, or Sales Engineering) focused on Cloud Services Architectures, Web-based Security, Networking, or Infrastructure Solutions

•
Strong communication and presentation skills in Japanese and English that enable you to consultatively shape and influence internal and external decisions

•
Strong technical acumen with the ability duly to align business challenges to the Zscaler portfolio to meet business and security outcomes

•
Ability to analyze customer data to gain key insights and develop tailored adoption strategies and risk mitigation plans

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

•
Experience leveraging AI-powered analytics or machine learning insight tools to evaluate customer adoption metrics and proactively address account health risks

•
Background in Cloud and Networking Security technologies (such as SD-WAN, MPLS, SWG, DLP, VPNs, or CASB) paired with solid experience in troubleshooting methodologies and escalation management

•
Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCNP, CCIE, or Network+

職務概要

インサイドセールス担当者（ISR）は営業部門に所属し、チャネルパートナーと緊密に連携しながら、法人顧客を対象とした営業活動を行います。AI活用が企業のIT投資を大きく動かすなか、データ基盤・ストレージを起点に、お客様のAI活用とデータ戦略を支援するポジションです。

本ポジションは、SDRおよびISRの両方の役割を担います。

description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

As Distributor Business Development Manager, you will own Elastic's distribution relationships and unmanaged Elastic partner strategy with distribution partners across APJ region.

The successful candidate will connect Elastic's sales teams, partner teams, and distributors in the region. Their main goal is to drive pipeline generation with the help of distributors. They will also enable resellers and execute co-sell strategies. Additionally, they will work on growing new business and increasing expansion ARR through the partner ecosystem.

This role requires a candidate with strong partner sales acumen, regional experience and proven track record of growing business with distributors. You will work with cross-functional teams, and focus on driving execution of Elastic sales plays, deep technical alignment and enablement of distributors and will scale business through distributor led partner ecosystem.

As a business leader, you will conduct executive business reviews with both the distributor and Elastic leadership teams. You should be capable and comfortable delivering demonstrations of Elastic products. You will arrange technical workshops and certification boot camps with distributors and Elastic reseller teams. Additionally, you will create and improve sales plays. And most importantly drive business execution across distributors and distributor-led partner ecosystem.

What You Will Be Doing

Distribution Strategy & Business Planning:

•
Manage business plans with distribution partners. Set quarterly targets for the pipeline and for recruiting resellers. Prioritize segments for Elastic's Enterprise, Public Sector, and Commercial business.

•
Build and maintain executive-level relationships with distribution executive team, and drive business growth initiatives with Elastic Field Sales teams, Managed Partners teams, and distributors

•
Develop and execute a distribution GTM playbook aligned to Elastic's Fiscal year priorities and key performance indicators such as: partner-sourced pipeline, New & Expansion business targets and reseller coverage model.

•
Work with Global Partner Sales Operations to track distributor performance using KPIs. These KPIs include partner-sourced ARR, deal registration volume, pipeline coverage ratio, and reseller activation rates.

Distributor and Partner Ecosystem Enablement and Development:

•
Onsite & Virtual - Independently design and deliver technical enablement programs for reseller sales engineers, architects, and pre-sales teams — onsite at distributor offices, reseller HQs, and industry events, as well as in virtual/webinar formats.

•
Build and maintain a reusable enablement content library: demo environments, hands-on lab guides, discovery decks, competitive battle-cards, and certification study aids tailored to the Elastic platform (Search, Observability, Security).

•
Run monthly/quarterly distributor enablement days with coordinated technical tracks (observability, SIEM/security analytics, vector/AI search) and business tracks (program updates, incentives, pipeline reviews).

•
Drive reseller technical certifications and training completions through proactive cohort scheduling, remediation support, and accountability reporting back to Elastic Partner Enablement.

•
Deliver or co-deliver Elastic product demonstrations for reseller-led opportunities, serving as the technical point of contact for pre-sales support through distribution when a dedicated SE is unavailable.

Reseller Ecosystem Development:

•
Identify, recruit, and enable net-new resellers through distribution partners; manage tiering and partner program alignment.

•
Drive reseller activation through demand generation programs, MDF utilization, and joint marketing motions with distributors

•
Maintain a healthy, active reseller pipeline across APJ markets

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

•
Partner with Elastic Regional Sales field managers (RVPs, AEs) to integrate distribution into account and territory planning.

•
Own execution across Elastic account segments - Work with Global Partner Sales Operations & Strategy on distributor discount structures, incentive programs, and data integrity within Salesforce/Impartner.

•
Collaborate with Elastic's Marketing team to develop and deploy partner-funded demand generation campaigns through public sector distribution partners.

•
Escalate and resolve distributor-facing channel conflicts, pricing disputes, and deal registration exceptions in coordination with Global Partner Sales leadership and Deal Desk.

What You Bring

•
7+ years of channel sales or partner management experience, with at least 3 years focused on distribution.

•
Demonstrated track record of driving partner-sourced revenue through distributor-managed reseller ecosystems.

•
Proven ability to independently deliver sales pitches and business value proposition to partners, ability to showcase product or solution demos, co-deliver hands-on workshops, and lab-based training — to Sales and technical audiences (SEs, architects, pre-sales).

•
Experience building or managing a self-sustaining partner enablement program: content design, delivery cadence, certification tracking, and outcomes measurement.

•
Hands-on fluency with at least one of the following domains: observability/monitoring, SIEM/security analytics, log management, or enterprise search — sufficient to lead credible technical conversations and live product walkthroughs.

•
Deep familiarity with account segments and how channel partners serve and execute business with Enterprise, Public Sector and commercial customers.

•
Experienced with diverse region and working directly with partners based in different countries across APJ - Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder distributor relationships across sales, marketing, and executive functions.

•
Strong command of channel mechanics: deal registration, margin stacking, MDF management, reseller tiering, and co-sell program execution. - Proficiency in Salesforce CRM for pipeline management, reporting, and partner attribution workflows.

•
Excellent executive communication skills — written, verbal, and presentation — and equal comfort presenting to a CISO as to a room of reseller SEs. - Willingness and ability to travel onsite to distribution and reseller locations (estimated 20%–30%) for enablement events, QBRs, and partner marketing activities.

Bonus Points

•
Direct experience with Elastic (ELK/ECE/ECK), Splunk, Datadog, CrowdStrike, or another enterprise observability or security analytics platform — including hands-on configuration or demonstration capability.

•
Familiarity with partner program platforms (Impartner, Alliances, Salesforce PRM) and co-sell tools (Tackle/Clazar, WorkSpan). - Working knowledge of cloud marketplace procurement (AWS MP, Azure MP, GCP MP) as a transactional vector through distribution.

•
Prior experience owning or supporting partner attribution framework rollouts or channel operations transformations.

•
Background in working or partnering and contributing to designing formal sales or technical training content for partner ecosystem.

Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role

Elastic, the Search AI company, is looking for a high-energy Inside Account Executive to drive net-new revenue and expansion within the Japanese territory. You’ll be the owner of a defined territory where you’ll build your own pipeline, tell the Elastic Search AI story, and close, multi-stakeholder deals in a consumption-based model.

To excel as an IAE at Elastic , you need a blend of high-level technical curiosity and the gravitas of a value-based seller. Because Elastic isn't just a "product" but a versatile search, observability, and security platform, the role requires moving beyond simple transactions to solving complex data problems.

What You Will Be Doing

• Be responsible for your territory & build pipeline: Develop and implement a proactive outbound cadence (email, call, social).

• Deep discovery & qualification: Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like MEDDPICC.

• Value storytelling & demos: Craft and deliver tailored narratives and live demos that map Elastic’s Search, Observability, and Security capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

• Mutual deal strategy & forecast accuracy: Collaborate with customers to build formal close plans and keep your CRM up-to-date.

• Negotiation & closing: Lead high-stakes contract and pricing discussions—defend your value, structure give/get trades, and land multi-year consumption commitments.

• Domain & cloud acumen: Position Elastic as the Search AI platform of choice by speaking fluently about cloud economics, usage-based pricing, and modern data architectures.

• Cross-functional partnership: Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and RevOps to accelerate deals and drive exceptional customer outcomes.

What You Bring

• Proven SaaS quota‐carrying success: 3+ years closing deals, consistently overachieving targets in a consumption-based or usage-model environment.

• Discovery & qualification skills: Demonstrated ability to apply MEDDPICC or equivalent frameworks to drive focused pipeline and eliminate low-probability deals.

• Compelling value storytellers: Track record of delivering presentations and demos that tie product capabilities to real euros saved, revenue gained, or risk mitigated.

• Well honed negotiation skills.

• Collaborative mentality & coach-ability: A learner who partners with internal teams, incorporates feedback, and embodies Elastic’s values of community.

• Open Source passion: Genuine appreciation for open-source communities and the Elastic model—bonus if you’ve sold or advocated in an OSS context.

• Fluency in Japanese and English

Bonus Points

• Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.

If you’re driven to build your own pipeline, master complex deal cycles, and help customers unlock the power of Search AI, we’d love to talk.

Apply today!

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
