description:
About Team & About Role
Rubrik’s Channel team is how we bring cyber resilience to the organizations across Japan that people rely on every day, including hospitals, banks, government bodies, manufacturers and utilities. As Channel Development Manager for Japan, you’ll own the relationships with our reseller, SI and distribution partners and turn them into a repeatable engine for pipeline and Partner Initiated Deals. This is an individual contributor role with real autonomy over which partners you invest in, how you plan with them, and how fast you help them grow.

Rubrikのチャネルチームは、病院、銀行、官公庁、製造業、公益事業など、人々の日常を支える日本全国の組織にサイバーレジリエンスを届ける役割を担っています。日本担当チャネルデベロップメントマネージャーとして、リセラー、SI、ディストリビューターとのパートナーリレーションを統括し、パイプラインとパートナー起点の案件(Partner Initiated Deals)を継続的に生み出す仕組みへと育てていただきます。本ポジションは個人貢献型(IC)の役割で、どのパートナーに投資するか、パートナーとどのように計画を立てるか、そしてパートナーの成長をどれだけ早く後押しするかについて、大きな裁量があります。

What You’ll Do

• Build and execute joint business plans with key Japan resellers, SIs and distributors, so partners have a clear path to growing their Rubrik business and Rubrik has a clear view of where it will come from.

• Drive Partner Initiated Deals and net-new pipeline by working with partner sales teams to identify, qualify and close opportunities alongside Rubrik Account Executives.

• Run account mapping and joint planning sessions between Rubrik field teams and partners, opening access to partner customer bases, both existing accounts and new logos.

• Lead enablement for partner sales and SE teams, so partners can position, demo and deploy Rubrik independently and customers see value from day one.

• Develop and manage distribution relationships, using them to extend Rubrik’s reach into the mid-market, public sector and regional enterprise accounts.

• Identify, onboard and grow new partners that fill gaps in regional, vertical or solution coverage.

• Work with Channel Marketing and Field Marketing to plan and host partner and customer events and campaigns that put Rubrik in front of the right buyers.

• Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers at your partners, earning Rubrik a place as a strategic vendor in their portfolio.

• Report on partner performance, pipeline and forecast to Channel and Sales leadership, giving the business a clear read on Japan.

主な業務内容

• 日本の主要なリセラー、SI、ディストリビューターと共同ビジネスプランを策定・実行し、パートナーがRubrikビジネスを拡大するための明確な道筋と、Rubrikが売上の見通しを把握できる状態をつくる。

• パートナーの営業チームと連携し、Rubrikのアカウントエグゼクティブとともに商談の発掘、案件化、クロージングを行い、パートナー起点の案件と新規パイプラインを創出する。

• Rubrikのフィールドチームとパートナーとの間で、アカウントマッピングおよび共同プランニングセッションを実施し、既存顧客・新規顧客の両面でパートナーの顧客基盤へのアクセスを広げる。

• パートナーの営業チームおよびSEチームのイネーブルメントをリードし、パートナーが自立してRubrikの提案、デモ、導入を行え、お客様が初日から価値を実感できる状態をつくる。

• ディストリビューターとの関係を構築・管理し、ミッドマーケット、公共部門、地方の大企業顧客へのリーチを拡大する。

• 地域、業種、ソリューションのカバレッジに不足がある領域で、新規パートナーを発掘、オンボーディングし、成長を支援する。

• チャネルマーケティングおよびフィールドマーケティングと連携し、適切な購買層にRubrikを届けるパートナー向け・顧客向けのイベントやキャンペーンを企画・開催する。

• パートナーの経営層・意思決定者との信頼関係を築き、パートナーのポートフォリオにおけるRubrikの戦略的ベンダーとしての地位を確立する。

• パートナーの実績、パイプライン、フォーキャストをチャネルおよびセールスのリーダーシップに報告し、日本の状況を明確に共有する。

Experience You’ll Need

• Strong track record in a channel development, channel sales or partner management role at a technology vendor, working with resellers, SIs and distributors in Japan.

• An Account Executive who has successfully managed client accounts may transition into a Channel Development Manager role.

• Good working knowledge of the data protection, data management, cybersecurity or storage market.

• Established relationships and a strong reputation with Japan partners and distributors.

• Experience identifying, initiating and closing deals with partners in close coordination with direct sales teams.

• Experience running quarterly and annual planning for partner sales activity and reporting on pipeline and forecast.

• Confidence presenting to larger audiences and hosting events with partners and end customers.

• A collaborative approach to working across Sales, Systems Engineering, Marketing, Alliances and Sales Operations.

• Business-level fluency in Japanese and English proficiency at a beginner level, to work with Japan partners and with regional and global teams.

求める経験・スキル

• テクノロジーベンダーにおけるチャネルデベロップメント、チャネルセールス、またはパートナーマネジメントの実績があり、日本のリセラー、SI、ディストリビューターと協業した経験

• 顧客アカウントの運営で成果を上げたアカウントエグゼクティブが、チャネルデベロップメントマネージャーへ転身することも可能です

• データ保護、データ管理、サイバーセキュリティ、またはストレージ市場に関する実務的な知識

• 日本のパートナーおよびディストリビューターとの確立した関係と高い評価

• 直販チームと緊密に連携し、パートナーとの案件の発掘、開始、クロージングを行った経験

• パートナー営業活動の四半期・年間計画の策定と、パイプラインおよびフォーキャストの報告の経験

• 大規模な聴衆の前でのプレゼンテーションや、パートナー・エンドユーザーとのイベント開催に自信を持って取り組める方

• セールス、システムエンジニアリング、マーケティング、アライアンス、セールスオペレーションと協力して業務を進める協調的な姿勢

• 日本のパートナーや地域・グローバルチームと業務を行うための、ビジネスレベルの日本語、および初級レベルの英語力

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience selling or partnering on competitive backup and recovery or cyber resilience solutions.

• A background running partner enablement or training programs.

• Experience building joint solutions with adjacent security and infrastructure vendors (e.g. identity, endpoint, network or storage).

• Experience acquiring and onboarding new partners.

歓迎する経験・スキル

• 競合するバックアップ・リカバリーまたはサイバーレジリエンスソリューションの販売、またはそれらでのパートナー協業の経験

• パートナーイネーブルメントまたはトレーニングプログラムの運営経験

• 隣接するセキュリティ・インフラベンダー(ID、エンドポイント、ネットワーク、ストレージなど)との共同ソリューション構築の経験

• 新規パートナーの開拓およびオンボーディングの経験

title: Large Enterprise Account Executive
excerpt: What You’ll Do • Define and execute a territory plan for Japan’s large enterprise accounts, owning bookings growth from first conversation to close • Generate net new pipeline through your own prospecting and outreach, opening doors at accounts that have never worked with Rubrik • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, using a disciplined qualification methodology to forecast accurately and win • Present Rubrik’s cyber resilience solutions in complex data center and cloud environments, helping customers see how fast they can recover when it matters most • Partner with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik partners to co-sell and scale your territory
description:
Large Enterprise Account Executive, Japan

Rubrik’s Sales organization is a united group of elite cross-functional sales professionals that help companies & government entities achieve resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. We offer continuous professional growth and opportunity through our world-class sales enablement program. Our One Rubrik selling approach provides all the resources you need to exceed your goals, maximize your earnings potential, and take your career to the next level. All this while doing something truly purposeful, protecting the world's data.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll own new logo growth across Japan’s large enterprise market, with the autonomy to shape your territory and the backing of a global team and a world-class enablement program to take your career to the next level. We are seeking a relentless self-starter who is hyper-focused on acquiring new logos by discovering and developing new opportunities, managing pipeline, and executing account strategies, while also encouraging existing customer expansion. The AE must drive pipeline generation daily while working with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik Channel Partners to exceed sales quotas.

Rubrikのセールス組織は、企業や政府機関がサイバー攻撃、悪意ある内部関係者、事業中断に対するレジリエンスを実現できるよう支援する、部門横断型のエリートセールス・プロフェッショナルの集団です。世界トップレベルのセールス・イネーブルメント・プログラムを通じて、継続的な成長の機会を提供します。「One Rubrik」セリングアプローチにより、目標達成、収入の最大化、そしてキャリアの飛躍に必要なあらゆるリソースをご活用いただけます。そしてそれは、世界のデータを守るという、真に意義のある仕事を通じて実現できます。

エンタープライズ・アカウント・エグゼクティブとして、あなたは日本の大企業市場における新規顧客(ニューロゴ)獲得を担います。テリトリーを自らの裁量で切り拓くことができ、グローバルチームと世界トップレベルのイネーブルメント・プログラムがあなたのキャリアの飛躍を支えます。私たちが求めているのは、新たな商機の発掘と育成、パイプライン管理、アカウント戦略の実行を通じて新規顧客の獲得に徹底的にこだわり、同時に既存顧客の拡大も推進できる、粘り強く自律的な方です。AEは、セールスエンジニア、セールス・デベロップメント、チャネル・デベロップメント、Rubrikのチャネルパートナーと連携しながら、日々パイプライン創出に取り組み、セールスクォータの達成を目指します。

What You’ll Do

• Define and execute a territory plan for Japan’s large enterprise accounts, owning bookings growth from first conversation to close

• Generate net new pipeline through your own prospecting and outreach, opening doors at accounts that have never worked with Rubrik

• Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, using a disciplined qualification methodology to forecast accurately and win

• Present Rubrik’s cyber resilience solutions in complex data center and cloud environments, helping customers see how fast they can recover when it matters most

• Partner with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik partners to co-sell and scale your territory

• Share local market insight with Rubrik leadership, helping shape how we grow in Japan

• Collaborate with and learn from a high-performing One Rubrik sales team that invests in your continued growth

主な業務内容

• 日本の大企業アカウントを対象としたテリトリープランを策定・実行し、最初の商談からクローズまで、ブッキングの成長に責任を持つ

• 自らのプロスペクティングとアウトリーチを通じて新規パイプラインを創出し、Rubrikとこれまで取引のなかった企業との接点を開拓する

• 複数のステークホルダーが関わる複雑な営業サイクルをリードし、規律ある案件評価(クオリフィケーション)の手法を用いて、正確な予測と受注を実現する

• 複雑なデータセンターおよびクラウド環境において、Rubrikのサイバーレジリエンス・ソリューションを提案し、いざという時にどれだけ迅速に復旧できるかをお客様に示す

• セールスエンジニア、セールス・デベロップメント、チャネル・デベロップメント、Rubrikのパートナーと連携し、共同で販売を進めながらテリトリーを拡大する

• 現地市場に関する知見をRubrikのリーダーシップと共有し、日本での成長戦略の策定に貢献する

• 継続的な成長を支援する、高いパフォーマンスを誇る「One Rubrik」セールスチームと協働し、互いに学び合う

Experience You’ll Need

• 10+ years of enterprise Account Executive experience selling Security, Infrastructure, Data, or SaaS solutions

• A track record of landing net new logos in large enterprise accounts, with at least 3 years at a large company (1,000+ employees) and experience in a hypergrowth environment (ideally large company followed by startup or scale-up)

• Strong, consistent achievement as an AE, evidenced by President’s Club, top-performer awards, or sustained quota attainment

• Proven ability to self-source deals and build pipeline from scratch through your own outbound prospecting, rather than relying on customer or partner referrals

• A repeatable new logo pipeline generation process you can walk us through, from cold account to qualified opportunity

• Hands-on experience with MEDDIC or MEDDPICC, or another proven enterprise qualification methodology

• A stable career with meaningful tenure and measurable impact in each role

• Experience working with channel partners and selling complex solutions

求めるご経験

• セキュリティ、インフラ、データ、またはSaaSソリューションを扱うエンタープライズ・アカウントエグゼクティブとしての10年以上の経験

• 大企業アカウントにおける新規顧客(ニューロゴ)獲得の実績。大手企業(従業員1,000名以上)での3年以上の勤務経験、およびハイパーグロース環境での経験(大手企業からスタートアップ、スケールアップへというキャリアが望ましい)

• President’s Club、トップパフォーマー表彰、または継続的なクォータ達成などで裏付けられた、AEとしての安定した高い実績

• 顧客やパートナーからの紹介に頼らず、自らのアウトバウンド活動によって案件を創出し、ゼロからパイプラインを構築した実証済みの能力

• 未開拓のアカウントから有望な商談(クオリファイド・オポチュニティ)に至るまでの、再現性のあるニューロゴ・パイプライン創出プロセスを具体的に説明できること

• MEDDICまたはMEDDPICC、もしくはそれに準ずる実績のあるエンタープライズ向け案件評価手法の実務経験

• 各職務において意義ある在籍期間と測定可能な成果を残してきた、安定したキャリア

• チャネルパートナーとの協業経験、および複雑なソリューションの販売経験

Above all, you will have the ability to operate in a fast-paced, changing environment, self-starter, and operate in a highly matrixed organization. Demonstrate Rubrik’s RIVET values and be a role model, collaborating effectively and creating a positive environment .

何よりも、変化の激しい環境で成果を出せること、自ら率先して行動できること、そしてマトリックス型の組織で円滑に仕事を進められることが重要です。RubrikのRIVETバリューを体現し、ロールモデルとして、周囲と効果的に協働しながら、前向きな職場環境を築いていただける方を求めています。

description:
About Team & About Role

Rubrik's sales organization helps hospitals, banks, schools and government agencies stay resilient against cyberattacks, malicious insiders and operational disruption, and you'll do it for one of the fastest-growing corners of the data estate: unstructured data on NAS. As the Sales Specialist for NAS Cloud Direct, you own the number for this product in your territory. You'll be the go-to expert in the field, with the tools, enablement and One Rubrik selling motion to take your career, and your earnings, as far as your results allow.

You'll work alongside Core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development and our partners, and you'll be the consolidated voice of the field and customer back to Product Management, Product Marketing and PnP.

What You'll Do

• Own bookings growth for NAS Cloud Direct across new and existing accounts, building and executing a territory plan that meets and exceeds quota

• Drive daily pipeline generation to land net new logos, opening doors with customers who need to protect massive volumes of unstructured data without adding more on-prem backup infrastructure

• Qualify, build and close strategic opportunities in mid-enterprise accounts, and expand within the existing Rubrik base alongside Core AEs

• Present NAS Cloud Direct within complex data center and cloud design conversations, helping customers see how they get faster, simpler recovery from ransomware and other disruption

• Co-sell with Core AEs, Sales Engineers, distributors, resellers and VARs to build repeatable partner-led momentum

• Champion and evangelize the product inside and outside Rubrik, training the field on positioning, objection handling and competitive differentiation so more teams can sell it with confidence

• Bring market and customer feedback to Product Management and Product Marketing, shaping what we build next and how we take it to market

• Share what's working with fellow Product Line Specialists, so the whole team learns faster

Experience You'll Need

• 5+ years of field technology sales experience, ideally selling data protection, storage, cloud infrastructure or NAS-related solutions

• A consistent track record of landing net new logos and consistently overachieving quota

• Strong experience building and managing pipeline across many accounts and verticals

• Comfort positioning a technical product in complex data center and cloud environments, and building champions across technical and business buyers

• Experience working with channel partners, distributors and resellers to co-sell and grow a territory

• A driven, goal-oriented "get it done" mindset and the self-direction to generate your own momentum

Preferred Qualifications

• Exposure to unstructured data challenges and enterprise NAS platforms

• Experience selling complex, multi-stakeholder solutions into mid-enterprise accounts

• Background in product-specialist or overlay sales models

• Familiarity with the competitive landscape in data protection and cloud storage

• Understanding of MEDDPICC for sales qualification & COtM sales methodology

description:
Small Enterprise Account Executive, Japan

Rubrik’s Sales organization is a united group of elite cross-functional sales professionals that help companies & government entities achieve resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. We offer continuous professional growth and opportunity through our world-class sales enablement program. Our One Rubrik selling approach provides all the resources you need to exceed your goals, maximize your earnings potential, and take your career to the next level. All this while doing something truly purposeful, protecting the world's data.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll own new logo growth across Japan’s large enterprise market, with the autonomy to shape your territory and the backing of a global team and a world-class enablement program to take your career to the next level. We are seeking a relentless self-starter who is hyper-focused on acquiring new logos by discovering and developing new opportunities, managing pipeline, and executing account strategies, while also encouraging existing customer expansion. The AE must drive pipeline generation daily while working with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik Channel Partners to exceed sales quotas.

Rubrikのセールス組織は、企業や政府機関がサイバー攻撃、悪意ある内部関係者、事業中断に対するレジリエンスを実現できるよう支援する、部門横断型のエリートセールス・プロフェッショナルの集団です。世界トップレベルのセールス・イネーブルメント・プログラムを通じて、継続的な成長の機会を提供します。「One Rubrik」セリングアプローチにより、目標達成、収入の最大化、そしてキャリアの飛躍に必要なあらゆるリソースをご活用いただけます。そしてそれは、世界のデータを守るという、真に意義のある仕事を通じて実現できます。

エンタープライズ・アカウント・エグゼクティブとして、あなたは日本の大企業市場における新規顧客(ニューロゴ)獲得を担います。テリトリーを自らの裁量で切り拓くことができ、グローバルチームと世界トップレベルのイネーブルメント・プログラムがあなたのキャリアの飛躍を支えます。私たちが求めているのは、新たな商機の発掘と育成、パイプライン管理、アカウント戦略の実行を通じて新規顧客の獲得に徹底的にこだわり、同時に既存顧客の拡大も推進できる、粘り強く自律的な方です。AEは、セールスエンジニア、セールス・デベロップメント、チャネル・デベロップメント、Rubrikのチャネルパートナーと連携しながら、日々パイプライン創出に取り組み、セールスクォータの達成を目指します。

What You’ll Do

• Define and execute a territory plan for Japan’s large enterprise accounts, owning bookings growth from first conversation to close

• Generate net new pipeline through your own prospecting and outreach, opening doors at accounts that have never worked with Rubrik

• Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, using a disciplined qualification methodology to forecast accurately and win

• Present Rubrik’s cyber resilience solutions in complex data center and cloud environments, helping customers see how fast they can recover when it matters most

• Partner with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik partners to co-sell and scale your territory

• Share local market insight with Rubrik leadership, helping shape how we grow in Japan

• Collaborate with and learn from a high-performing One Rubrik sales team that invests in your continued growth

主な業務内容

• 日本の大企業アカウントを対象としたテリトリープランを策定・実行し、最初の商談からクローズまで、ブッキングの成長に責任を持つ

• 自らのプロスペクティングとアウトリーチを通じて新規パイプラインを創出し、Rubrikとこれまで取引のなかった企業との接点を開拓する

• 複数のステークホルダーが関わる複雑な営業サイクルをリードし、規律ある案件評価(クオリフィケーション)の手法を用いて、正確な予測と受注を実現する

• 複雑なデータセンターおよびクラウド環境において、Rubrikのサイバーレジリエンス・ソリューションを提案し、いざという時にどれだけ迅速に復旧できるかをお客様に示す

• セールスエンジニア、セールス・デベロップメント、チャネル・デベロップメント、Rubrikのパートナーと連携し、共同で販売を進めながらテリトリーを拡大する

• 現地市場に関する知見をRubrikのリーダーシップと共有し、日本での成長戦略の策定に貢献する

• 継続的な成長を支援する、高いパフォーマンスを誇る「One Rubrik」セールスチームと協働し、互いに学び合う

Experience You’ll Need

• 8+ years of enterprise Account Executive experience selling Security, Infrastructure, Data, or SaaS solutions

• A track record of landing net new logos in large enterprise accounts, with at least 3 years at a large company (1,000+ employees) and experience in a hypergrowth environment (ideally large company followed by startup or scale-up)

• Strong, consistent achievement as an AE, evidenced by President’s Club, top-performer awards, or sustained quota attainment

• Proven ability to self-source deals and build pipeline from scratch through your own outbound prospecting, rather than relying on customer or partner referrals

• A repeatable new logo pipeline generation process you can walk us through, from cold account to qualified opportunity

• Hands-on experience with MEDDIC or MEDDPICC, or another proven enterprise qualification methodology

• A stable career with meaningful tenure and measurable impact in each role

• Experience working with channel partners and selling complex solutions

求めるご経験

• セキュリティ、インフラ、データ、またはSaaSソリューションを扱うエンタープライズ・アカウントエグゼクティブとしての10年以上の経験

• 大企業アカウントにおける新規顧客(ニューロゴ)獲得の実績。大手企業(従業員1,000名以上)での3年以上の勤務経験、およびハイパーグロース環境での経験(大手企業からスタートアップ、スケールアップへというキャリアが望ましい)

• President’s Club、トップパフォーマー表彰、または継続的なクォータ達成などで裏付けられた、AEとしての安定した高い実績

• 顧客やパートナーからの紹介に頼らず、自らのアウトバウンド活動によって案件を創出し、ゼロからパイプラインを構築した実証済みの能力

• 未開拓のアカウントから有望な商談(クオリファイド・オポチュニティ)に至るまでの、再現性のあるニューロゴ・パイプライン創出プロセスを具体的に説明できること

• MEDDICまたはMEDDPICC、もしくはそれに準ずる実績のあるエンタープライズ向け案件評価手法の実務経験

• 各職務において意義ある在籍期間と測定可能な成果を残してきた、安定したキャリア

• チャネルパートナーとの協業経験、および複雑なソリューションの販売経験

Above all, you will have the ability to operate in a fast-paced, changing environment, self-starter, and operate in a highly matrixed organization. Demonstrate Rubrik’s RIVET values and be a role model, collaborating effectively and creating a positive environment .

何よりも、変化の激しい環境で成果を出せること、自ら率先して行動できること、そしてマトリックス型の組織で円滑に仕事を進められることが重要です。RubrikのRIVETバリューを体現し、ロールモデルとして、周囲と効果的に協働しながら、前向きな職場環境を築いていただける方を求めています。

description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Singapore

About the Department

The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.

The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.

About This Role

In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of public sector and enterprise accounts in the Philippines market . The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.

You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.

Role Responsibilities

• Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.

• Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.

• Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.

• Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.

• Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.

• Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.

• Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).

• Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.

Required Experience

• Fluent in English and Tagalog to engage with customers in Philippines

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

• Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.

• Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.

• Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.

• Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.

• Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.

• Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).

• Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.

• Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.

• Ability to travel as required.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role
Join Anthropic's Customer Success team as one of the founding members of our Japan Customer Success team as we pioneer the future of enterprise AI adoption. As a Customer Success Manager at Anthropic, you'll be the strategic partner and trusted advisor to our most complex customers across Japan, helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities: API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code.
You'll develop genuine partnerships with customers, gaining a deep understanding of their business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us.
In partnership with the broader account team, you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives. You'll work closely with them to provide best practices and guidance, and support them as their usage (consumption and seat based) grows and evolves.
Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, implement change management strategies, optimize use cases, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies. That makes you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business.
As one of the founding members of our Customer Success team in Japan, you'll help shape how we build the function in-region. That includes establishing regional processes, developing new customer relationships, and representing Anthropic's brand in a high-growth market alongside a small, growing team. You'll operate with significant autonomy while maintaining strong alignment with global teams. This requires someone who thrives in ambiguous environments and can work effectively across time zones.
Key responsibilities

• Build trusting, strategic relationships with key Japanese customer decision makers to understand their business and objectives, identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion

• Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions

• Leverage your deep knowledge of the customer and regional nuances to proactively drive usage planning, understanding current and future consumption and adoption and how it creates realized value for the customer

• Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities, proactively addressing underutilization across both our consumption-based and seat-based products to drive full value from contracted commitments

• Serve as the customer's thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic's product roadmap, driving awareness of new products, and engaging Product PMs as the voice of Japanese customers

• Document and quantify customer value realized through business outcomes, ROI, and impact metrics to build compelling internal business cases for continued and expanded investment

• Identify potential use cases and lines of business not currently onboarded, partnering with customers to discover new applications for Claude across different departments, teams, and workflows

• Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement

• Own the customer experience across their lifecycle: manage comprehensive account and success plans grounded in the customer's business objectives, conduct Quarterly Business Reviews, and serve as the primary conduit between the customer and Anthropic

• Build Anthropic's brand and customer relationships as part of our founding in-region CS team, developing Japan-specific processes, playbooks, and best practices where needed that account for regional business cultures

Minimum qualifications

• Experience in customer-facing roles (Customer Success, Consulting, Solutions Architect, Solutions/Functional Consultant, Success Engineer or similar)

• Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns

• Experience explaining and demonstrating technical products to various audiences

• Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple customer relationships

• Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems

• Fluency in English and Japanese

Preferred qualifications

• 6+ years of experience in relevant field

• Experience driving success across both consumption-based and seat-based business models, with understanding of different expansion levers and success metrics for each

• Strategic mindset to identify growth opportunities and translate them into actionable expansion plans

• Cross-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs

• Experience working in and building a growing region, while navigating across time zones with US-based headquarters

• A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality. You are a true team player

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role
Japan is one of our fastest-growing partner markets, and partner demand for training and certification is ahead of our capacity. You will be our in-market enablement owner for Japan. You will take the global programs built by our Curriculum, Certification, and Applied AI teams and make them work for Japanese system integrators, from global integrators with large Japan practices to regional and specialist firms, so their teams can confidently sell and deliver Claude.
You work as the Japan extension of the SI Enablement Lead, in close partnership with the Japan Partner Account Managers (PAMs). The PAMs own the commercial relationship, the joint business plan, and executive alignment. You own readiness: what ready looks like for practitioners inside Japanese SIs, and the path that gets them there.
What you will do

• Serve as the enablement counterpart to Japan SI alliance, practice, and L&D leaders, working alongside the Japan PAMs.

• Build and execute a readiness plan for 3-5 regional priority partners (based on leadership priorities), while guiding the rest through scaled offerings.

• Define what ready means for an individual practitioner in a Japanese SI (demonstrated skill, not course completions), building on Partner Enablement’s global competency framework and adapting role definitions to how Japanese SIs staff and organize delivery teams.

• Partner with the training team on the instructor-led portfolio, bringing the right training to market with localized delivery partners.

What this role does not own

• Partner relationships. Japan PAMs own the commercial relationship, joint business plan, pipeline targets, and executive alignment.

• Building curriculum and certification. The Training & Curriculum and Certification teams build these once, centrally. You activate them in Japan and bring back what needs to change.

• The external training delivery bench. Delivery partners run the sessions. You partner with them and the training team to bring the right programs to market.

• 1:few or one-off enablement. The focus is on repeatable, 1:many programs.

Qualifications

• 5+ years in partner enablement, technical training, partner programs, or alliances in Japan, ideally with or inside Japanese SIs or a hyperscaler’s Japan partner team

• Working knowledge of how Japanese SIs build, staff, fund, and certify a technology practice

• Experience delivering or coordinating workshops, instructor-led training, or certification programs

• Experience building enablement as a repeatable program, with some tiering of coverage (hands-on for priority partners, programmatic for the rest)

• Ability to define and track outcome measures beyond attendance and completions

• Credibility with partner practice, alliance, and L&D leaders

• Self-directed, comfortable prioritizing independently and working with a manager in a different time zone

• Excellent program management skills, a systems mindset, and comfort operating in ambiguity

• Strong presence in front of an audience

• Native Japanese and fluent business English

Preferred

• Experience with Claude or other LLM platforms

• Experience with a hyperscaler certification program in Japan

• A background localizing technical content

• Existing relationships at Japanese SIs

• Experience working with training vendors or an authorized training partner model

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Description

Airbnb is a mission-driven company dedicated to helping create a world where anyone can belong anywhere. It takes a unified team committed to our core values to achieve this goal. Airbnb's various functions embody the company's innovative spirit, and our fast-moving team is committed to leading as a 21st century company.

The AirCover team is charged with ideating, building, launching, and managing the AirCover business inside of Airbnb. We have a huge responsibility to our community of Hosts and Guests to be there when things don’t go exactly as planned with their reservations. We have a lot of work to do in the coming years and we are looking for someone who will help us manage all of the things that need to be done to deliver best-in-class services to our community.

The Claims Experience team is responsible for providing premium support for our users by tailoring the experience and services we offer to their own specific needs so that everyone can host and travel with confidence. We develop a deep empathy and understanding of each of our customer’s desires, and go above and beyond to create personalized interactions that leave lasting impressions throughout the end-to-end claims process.

The team drives operational success across each of the Aircover products, delivering Seamless Execution through the quality and speed of our interactions, whilst focusing on customer retention and the continued growth of our Airbnb community.

About you

• You are passionate about delivering exceptional and tailored experiences for our customers, anticipating their needs and understanding what great looks like for the user experience

• You are someone who thrives in taking initiative in a fast-moving environment, bringing a growth mindset and bias toward execution.

• You foster strong customer relationships by actively engaging with users and identifying opportunities to enhance the service experience

• You are knowledgeable and experienced in the end to end claims process and take full ownership for reaching a complete final resolution with care and attention

• You identify gaps in workflow, process or policy whilst striving to provide upward feedback as required

How you’ll make an impact

• You will be responsible for understanding the unique needs of our customers and go above and beyond to create personalized interactions that leave a lasting impression throughout the end-to-end claims process.

• You will treat customers with consistency, fairness and empathy so that they feel heard and understood, and will tailor the support provided to their specific needs to resolve issues efficiently and to a high level of mutual satisfaction.

• By enhancing the customer experience from end to end you will help drive retention rates and ensure that everyone can travel and host on Airbnb with confidence.

In this role you’ll get to

• Evaluate, investigate and resolve claims submitted across our Aircover products (including but not limited to Host Damage Protection claims) including claims of high value and complexity that require complex investigation and negotiations to reach satisfactory outcomes

• Closely monitor for fraud detection and mitigate risks associated with bad actors to protect the Airbnb brand and community

• Verify all relevant facts and evidence to determine case resolution outcomes whilst following internal policies and workflows

• Go above and beyond to create personalized interactions and exceptional premium support throughout the end-to-end claims process, tailoring the experience offered whilst ensuring each user’s needs and preferences are met with the highest level of care and attention

• Provide continuous education and guidance for users about our Aircover products, terms and policies to enable the seamless resolution of their requests

• Work closely with stakeholders and third party claims administrators to align on case strategies and ensure a timely resolution is reached for our users

• Communicate regularly with Supervisors and Manager to provide feedback on the status of claims

• Maintain high levels of confidentiality whilst conducting investigations

• Identify gaps in workflow, process or policy whilst striving to provide upward feedback as required to further improve the experience for our customers

• Act as subject matter expert for change initiatives and/or cross functional projects taking place across the Aircover Scaled Ops and Optimization org, including assisting internal stakeholders to test, refine, ideate, and deploy new internal products and processes

• Support the training and mentoring of new hires throughout the onboarding process

• Support existing team members by sharing best practices, providing technical expertise on case consults, approvals and escalations in order to help improve overall performance of the team

We are looking for people who have

• 5+ years in a fintech or customer experience role , with a minimum of 1+ years experience handling insurance claims, preferably including first and third party property damage claims

• Critical thinking skills with a proven track record in solving challenging customer problems and making claims decisions with consistency and fairness whilst adhering to policy terms and workflows

• Strong verbal and written communication skills with experience interacting with customers through multiple channels including email, messaging and phone

• Active listening skills to understand user needs and provide personalized recommendations and assistance

• Ability to explain complex and sensitive issues to customers with confidence and clarity

• Analytical skills with the ability to organize and work independently with rapidly changing priorities

• Negotiation skills to ensure customer issues are resolved in a timely and efficient manner

• Solution and outcome-oriented with an ability to balance fraud prevention alongside a positive user experience

• Calm and Empathetic with ability to adapt to any situation by personalizing responses and educating our community whilst remaining level headed in challenging situations

• A regular work schedule of 5 days per week (40 hours), mutually agreed with your Supervisor, which may include weekend days and company wide / public holidays

Preferred experience

• Experience working on change initiatives and/or cross-functional projects to meet strategic goals.

• Experience working with internal stakeholders and third party administrators to resolve complex claims in a detailed, effective and timely manner.

• Proficiency in English and Japanese language.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join
The Community and Product Policy team creates and evolves principled policies that establish the rules of the road for guests and hosts across Airbnb. We solve complex marketplace and Trust & Safety challenges using data, stakeholder collaboration, and excellent judgement to support our community at scale. We team up with our cross-functional partners to create clear and accessible policy enforcement guides and to continuously measure, maintain, and improve our policies. We handle policy escalations and consults from across the business to ensure tough calls are resolved in accordance with our principles.

The Difference You Will Make

• You are a seasoned policy expert, with experience handling complex escalations

• You love solving problems and have a track record of strong cross-functional collaboration

• You’re an experienced communicator, with exceptional writing skills and presentation skills, including to senior executive audiences

• You are principled and rigorous — you incorporate diverse perspectives in pursuit of the best decisions and outcomes possible

• You are fluent with AI tools for gaining operational efficiency, but you exercise excellent judgement and know human expertise and supervision is paramount

• You can build and interrogate prompting, automated workflows, data queries, and stress-test model output before it reaches a decision-maker — you know when a number is not trustworthy and how to course correct

• You are a team player who thrives in a fast-moving environment and brings a strategic mindset to your work

As a Consults and Escalations Manager in Community Policy , you will work across the business to understand every aspect of a case. You’ll provide timely policy analysis and corresponding enforcement recommendations, and continuously evaluate and improve our policies to handle new issues as they arise. You will resolve individual user matters and translate what you learn into policy insights and recommended changes — using your case handling expertise alongside AI and data tooling you will detect patterns across escalation volume. You'll automate things like detection and reporting, but you'll make the judgment call, document the reasoning, and own the outcome. You will help our leaders understand recurring issues and how we can fix them in the future. This role will serve as an important player in developing our global policy improvements and will have a direct impact on the peace of mind of millions of Airbnb community members around the world.

A Typical Day

• Drive complicated escalations and issues towards a solution

• Advise our operations teams on cases where there are policy gaps to arrive at a solution that is guided by Airbnb’s principles and values

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across the business including but not limited to the Global Operations, Supply, Public Policy, Legal, Product, Trust and Safety, Communications and Partnerships

• Build AI-assisted detection of repeat policy questions and gray areas, turning consult volume into a standing signal to help drive trainings and policy clarifications

• Query, join, and visualize operational data to evaluate policy performance and pressure-test policy improvement recommendations before they reach leadership

• Design and ship workflows that reduce avoidable consults, cut handling time on the rest, and measure the gain

• Exercise final judgment on ambiguous, high-exposure escalations, and make the reasoning exceptionally clear to Legal, Ops, and executives

Your Expertise

• 6+ years experience in an Operations, Policy, Legal, or Trust and Safety role

• A track record of strong leadership in handling issues and escalations

• Demonstrated capacity for critical thinking, research, and analysis; strong attention to detail

• Exceptional writing and presentation abilities to explain and simplify complex information to others

• Thoughtful business judgment, strategic thinking, and ability to work well under pressure

• Experience working in a matrix and driving solutions to complex problems through cross-functional collaboration

• Fluency in data analysis and demonstrated use of AI tools to create operational leverage — with the discipline to validate any output and the judgment to know what should not be delegated to a model

Preferred Experience

• Experience working closely with operations teams, preferably in the Trust and Safety space

• Experience building or piloting AI/LLM-assisted workflows in operations, policy, or compliance

• Familiarity with quality measurement or QA frameworks for frontline teams

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Vendor Performance Management team oversees a network of high-performing vendor partners, ensuring they deliver maximum value across the CBO organization.

The Difference You Will Make

The Workforce And Vendor Excellence team is responsible for generating supply to enable guests to book vetted local professionals directly in the Airbnb app. As a Vendor Performance Manager, you will be the primary operational owner for strategic vendor relationships critical to scaling and managing the Homes program .

You will be responsible for ensuring our vendors meet and exceed service level agreements (SLAs), drive continuous performance improvement, and maintain strict adherence to Airbnb’s quality standards. This role requires a strong blend of analytical rigor, negotiation skills, and a passion for operational excellence within a global vendor network.

A Typical Day

Performance Management & Reporting

• KPI & SLA Oversight: Own the end-to-end performance of key operational vendors, developing, tracking, and reporting on critical metrics related to quality, efficiency, compliance, and cost.

• Data Analysis: Conduct deep-dive analysis on vendor data to identify root causes of performance gaps, service failures, and emerging trends. Translate complex data into actionable insights for both internal stakeholders and vendor leadership.

• Operational Process Optimization: Maximize CRM effectiveness by streamlining workflows, optimizing reporting, and ensuring data accuracy to significantly boost internal operational efficiency.

• Establish Scalable Infrastructure: Proactively architect scalable operations for all new initiatives and pilots. Partner with planning teams to ensure vendor capacity is fully aligned with short-term and long-term business forecasts.

• Business Reviews: Lead and facilitate business reviews with vendor partners, driving accountability and documenting clear action plans for improvement and growth.

• Forecasting & Capacity: Partner with internal planning teams to ensure vendor capacity aligns with short-term and long-term business forecasts.

Strategic Partnerships & Improvement

• Continuous Improvement: Identify, scope, and lead process improvement projects with vendors, focusing on enhancing quality, reducing operational friction, and improving the overall host/guest experience.

• Contract Adherence: Ensure vendors strictly comply with all contractual agreements, security requirements, and policy updates.

• Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify and mitigate operational and compliance risks within the vendor ecosystem.

Internal Stakeholder Management

• Serve as the operational liaison between vendors and internal teams (e.g., Product, Policy, Legal, Training, Finance).

• Synthesize vendor feedback and performance to inform product development and the Homes business.

• Provide regular updates to senior leadership on vendor performance and impact.

Your Expertise

Required Qualifications

• 10+ years of professional experience , with at least 5 years focused on vendor management, supplier relationship management, or outsourced operations performance in a high-volume, global environment.

• Strong Analytical Skills: Proven ability to analyze large datasets, synthesize performance trends, and use data tools (e.g., Excel, Google Sheets, SQL proficiency strongly preferred) to drive decisions.

• Technology & CRM Proficiency: Deep working knowledge of CRM systems (especially Salesforce) and sales enablement tools (MixMax, Gong) to optimize sales processes and operational efficiency.

• Operational Excellence: Deep understanding of contact center operations, quality assurance methodologies, and process improvement frameworks (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma).

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and influence stakeholders at all levels, both internally and externally.

• Project Management: Experience managing complex operational projects with clear timelines, deliverables, and cross-functional dependencies.

Preferred (Great to Have)

• Experience in the Tech, Travel, or Gig/Sharing Economy sectors.

• Familiarity with two-sided marketplace dynamics and the complexities of host/guest support.

• Experience launching new programs or standing up operations with a vendor from scratch.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

Agoda is a travel booking platform and accommodation is at our core. As our accommodation partners are a key to our success, we work hard to ensure their success. That is why the Market Management team of Agoda’s Partner Services specializes in strategic account management. We serve as consultants, offering strategic advice on how best to excel on Agoda’s commercial platform. We are direct contributors to what makes Agoda one of the market leaders because we understand accommodation needs and offer innovative solutions. From Bangkok to New York and beyond, our team has footprints in over 50 locations around the world. With the help of industry-leading technology, we work and collaborate globally to bring together the best ideas from diverse perspectives. The Market Management team invests in long-term relationships that spans borders and cultures and results in incredible value for Agoda, our partners, and our customers.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

• Manage a portfolio of hotel partners and serve as the main point of contact for day-to-day commercial matters

• Build and maintain strong partner relationships through regular communication, business reviews, and performance discussions

• Monitor and analyze key business metrics, including production, availability, rate competitiveness, pricing, cancellation trends, and Direct Share performance

• Identify performance gaps and recommend practical actions to improve visibility, conversion, and revenue results

• Support partners in adopting Agoda’s programs, promotions, pricing tools, and inventory optimization opportunities

• Work with cross-functional teams to resolve partner issues, support escalations, and ensure timely follow-up

• Prepare account updates, business reviews, and performance summaries for both internal and external stakeholders

• Maintain accurate account records, activity tracking, and follow-up actions in relevant internal systems

• Stay informed on market trends, competitor activity, and internal product or program updates that may impact partner performance

• Contribute to team targets and business priorities by supporting partner growth and improving portfolio results

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

• Experience in account management, sales, business development, or partner management

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into actions

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills

• Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Commercial mindset with strong problem-solving and negotiation skills

• Proficiency in business tools such as Excel, CRM systems, and presentation software

• Native/Fluent Japanese and business-level English communication skills

It’s Great if you have:

• Experience in the online travel, hospitality, e-commerce, or technology industry

• Familiarity with hotel distribution, revenue management, and pricing concepts

In this role, you’ll get to:

• Identify, pitch and build new supplier relationships for Agoda focusing on the B2B and wholesale market.

• Introduce and explain the strategic benefits of the new B2B solution product.

• Grow bookings, revenues and gross profit of assigned hotel partners through long-term relationship building and strategic partnership development.

• Using data to develop business solutions and maximize Agoda’s accommodation availability, content competitiveness and business growth for hotel partners.

This is a high-impact, highly visible role at the intersection of commercial negotiations, strategic partnerships, and cross-functional leadership.

While this is an individual contributor role, you will function as Agoda’s commercial face in-market, working directly with C-level executives of our partners, supported by global teams across Product, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and more.

This is a rare opportunity to join a start-up within a global leader, with the autonomy to move fast, take bold bets, and directly shape Agoda’s Flights success story.

What You’ll Do:

• Set the strategy: define and execute market strategies for Singapore and Malaysia, balancing growth, profitability, and long-term competitive positioning.

• Lead commercial negotiations: Own pricing, availability, and commercial terms with airline partners to maximize Agoda’s competitiveness.

• Be the market voice: Act as the go-to expert on Singapore and Malaysia aviation and online travel, sharing insights with internal teams and shaping Agoda’s product and growth strategy.

• Deliver partner success: Build deep, trusted executive-level relationships with suppliers, driving joint initiatives that enhance distribution, revenue, and customer experience.

• Drive execution excellence: Ensure partners’ day-to-day needs are met by collaborating with Agoda’s regional supply teams, operations, and product specialists.

• Analyze and optimize: Use data and insights to drive decision-making, identify opportunities, test solutions, and iterate quickly.

• Innovate at scale: Conceptualize and launch new commercial models, distribution initiatives, and customer-facing features that unlock growth.

• 5+ years of experience in the Flights / OTA / airline industry with strong exposure to commercial negotiations, distribution, and market strategy (experience in Singapore and Malaysia highly preferred).

• Proven track record of delivering growth through partnerships, negotiations, and strategy execution.

• Commercial acumen with the ability to balance short-term results and long-term market building.

• Strong executive presence and communication skills in English and Mandarin; able to manage complex conversations at senior levels.

• Entrepreneurial mindset with hands-on execution capabilities and comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

• Analytical rigor; demonstrated ability to use data to shape decisions and influence stakeholders.

• Experience developing and executing end-to-end business plans that cut across commercial, operational, legal, and marketing dimensions.

This role is based in Singapore. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position, and candidates are expected to have valid work authorization in Singapore.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

Supply is a team of creative entrepreneurs that develop solutions for Agoda’s accommodation partners and promote Agoda’s top and bottom-line growth. We design tailored business and product solutions with our partners and help them generate measurable value. Members of our team are empowered and supported to grow their market(s) or accounts. We develop win-win relationships and leverage Agoda’s unique accommodations portfolio and tech solutions to bring our partners the advantages they seek. Utilizing our strong brand and resources, we roll out new product to increase the visibility of Agoda, introduce more travelers to our great products and service and deliver significant revenues to the overall business.

The Opportunity:

As a Strategic Account Manager your key objective is to grow the coverage and quality of Agoda’s supply network by remotely managing a portfolio of hotel partners in Japan. You will be responsible for maximizing partner engagement, driving portfolio performance, and improving supply metrics through digital-first account management at scale.

In this role, you’ll get to:

•
Identify, pitch and build new supplier relationships for Agoda focusing on the B2B and wholesale market

•
Introduce and explain the strategic benefits of the new B2B solution product

•
Grow bookings, revenues and gross profit of assigned hotel partners

•
Using data to develop business solutions and maximize Agoda’s accommodation availability, content competitiveness and business growth for the hotel partners

•
Evaluate existing partnerships and determine if any actions needed to optimize the performance. Identify, prioritize, negotiate, contract and onboard non-participatory hotels, ensuring favorable terms and conditions.

•
Formulate project ideas, determine where opportunity exists and implement new approaches.

•
Work in a data-driven environment

•
Research and troubleshoot rate and availability issues to help hotels maximize their booking performance; e.g., problems with connectivity, rate mapping, extranet management, etc.

•
Prepare pitch presentations and materials

•
Manage regular weekly/monthly supplier and internal reports

What you’ll need to succeed:

•
Minimum 5 years’ experience in account management, business development, or supply/e-commerce role.

•
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to influence external/internal stakeholders.

•
Think out-of-the-box to develop and implement solutions for unique challenges when negotiating with hotel partners

•
Ability to drive insights out of data and articulate the findings

•
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint

•
A team player with a professional “get it done” attitude and work ethic.

•
Strong prioritization and planning skills; must be comfortable with making trade-offs.

•
Curiosity to learn and willingness to try new approaches. Comfortable in a two-way feedback culture.

•
Adapts well to and is energized by change

It’s Great if you Have:

•
B2B and wholesale markets experience preferred

•
Experience in hotel or travel industry, especially OTA channels preferred, but not necessary

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

As a client account manager of the Greater China Export business, you’ll help to drive revenue growth for the largest advertisers on Pinterest:

What you’ll do:

As a Client Account Manager (Growth – Torso) in the Greater China Export business, you will own a portfolio of high‑potential torso advertisers and help them grow into future flagship partners on Pinterest. You will manage approximately 10–20 verticalized books (for example, Apps, Ecommerce, Gaming, and other performance‑driven export verticals), drive measurable business results, and build scalable playbooks for this segment.

• Build and nurture relationships with a portfolio of high‑potential torso advertisers in the Greater China Export business, proactively engaging them on performance, optimization, and new opportunities.

• Own a verticalized book (for example, Apps, Ecommerce, Gaming) and tailor strategies to the needs, seasonality, and maturity of each vertical and advertiser.

• Gain a deep understanding of partners’ export business goals and turn data into compelling stories and actionable insights to help them succeed on Pinterest.

• Become an expert in Pinterest campaign best practices, with a particular focus on lower‑funnel and performance products relevant for export advertisers.

• Understand how to drive results, optimize campaigns, and deliver clear performance updates and recommendations to partners.

• Actively lead and participate in client meetings (for example, business reviews, optimization sessions) to understand objectives and challenges across your portfolio.

• Cross‑sell and upsell opportunities that contribute to the team’s ability to exceed revenue targets, using structured playbooks and testing frameworks.

• Advise advertisers on media strategies across targeting, bidding models, creative, measurement, and alpha/beta testing opportunities.

• Provide partners with guidance and expertise on product and service best practices and features, and maintain up‑to‑date fluency on Pinterest’s evolving ad product roadmap.

• Work closely with cross‑functional teams (for example, SS&O, Product, Measurement, Creative Strategy, Performance Solutions) to solve complex challenges and scale successful approaches across torso segments.

• Maintain accurate forecasts and pipeline visibility for your portfolio, highlighting key opportunities and risks.

• Contribute to the development and documentation of torso‑segment playbooks, including vertical best practices and operating cadences, and share learnings with the broader team.

What we’re looking for:

• 4+ years of experience in digital advertising or media sales, managing performance‑oriented advertisers and owning client relationships.

• Experience working with Greater China Export advertisers is required; experience with Ecommerce, Retail, Apps, or Gaming advertisers is highly desirable.

• Demonstrated ability to manage a scaled portfolio of accounts (for example, 10–20 accounts or books) with clear prioritization, structured operating rhythm, and strong execution.

• Track record of compelling, data‑backed storytelling and recommendations that drive measurable impact.

• Strong communication skills and experience managing multi‑stakeholder projects across geographies and functions.

• A team player who can operate in a fast‑paced environment with both technical and non‑technical partners.

• Expertise in digital advertising and media sales, including campaign optimization, analytical problem solving, and platform/product knowledge.

• Technical foundation with relevant experience in performance‑oriented channels (for example, Search, Shopping, Display, or Social advertising technologies).

• Fluency in business Mandarin and English is a must for business purpose

• Comfortable with business travel.

• Bachelor’s degree is required.

Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.

• As such, this role will need to be in the office or in front of our customers for in-person collaboration, typically 2 days per week, and therefore needs to be in a commutable distance to our Singapore City based office.
