Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

About the role

Pinterest brings millions of people the inspiration to create a life they love. As an Editor for Japan, you will help Pinners discover relevant ideas through high-quality content curation, Japanese-language editorial writing and trend-led experiences.

You will work with regional and global Editorial partners, Japan Creator Partnerships, Product and Sales to improve content quality, support business needs and bring Japanese seasonal and cultural trends to life on Pinterest.

What you’ll do

• Curate visually compelling, culturally relevant and inclusive content for Japanese Pinners across a range of categories including Entertainment, Art, Fashion or Beauty and seasonal moments.

• Execute editorial programming from content selection, Japanese copywriting and visual assets handling through launch, performance review and optimization.

• Create, edit and review Japanese headlines, descriptions, articles, page copy, emails and localized materials for accuracy, natural expression, brand consistency and local relevance.

• Plan and develop optimized web or email contents for the Japanese audience.

• Curate content that supports client and business needs while maintaining a useful, inspiring Pinner experience.

• Use platform data, search behavior and market signals to identify trends, audience needs and opportunities to improve content quality and new-user acquisition.

• Share performance insights and editorial recommendations with cross-functional and global stakeholders.

• Use AI tools to improve research, analysis and workflow efficiency, while independently validating output for accuracy, cultural nuance, quality and brand safety; own final editorial decisions.

• Manage multiple priorities and stay current on Japanese trends, creators, brands, publishers and audience behavior, particularly among Gen Z.

What we’re looking for

• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in editorial, content, curation, publishing, media, marketing, lifestyle, technology or a similarly fast-paced consumer environment.

• Native-level Japanese, plus business-level English for global collaboration.

• Strong editorial judgment and knowledge of the Japanese content market, consumer behavior and local trends.

• A data-informed, customer-centered approach to analyzing content performance and turning insights into action.

• Demonstrated ability to use AI-enabled tools responsibly and critically evaluate the quality and appropriateness of outputs.

• Ability to manage multiple projects independently, communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across functions and geographies.

• Experience with CMS tools, Google Workspace and Excel or similar tools.

• Experience with Canva, Figma or Adobe Photoshop; SEO-oriented content development is a plus.

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.

• As such, this role will need to be in the office or in front of our customers for in-person collaboration, typically 2 days per week, and therefore needs to be in a commutable distance to our Tokyo City based office.

日本語

ポジションについて

Pinterest は、インスピレーションを見つけたり、アイデアをまとめたり、ショッピングを楽しんだりといったポジティブな体験ができるビジュアル探索プラットフォームです。日本担当のエディターとして、質の高いコンテンツキュレーション、日本語コンテンツの編集・執筆、トレンドを軸とした体験づくりを通じて、ユーザーが素晴らしいアイデアを発見できるよう支援するエディターを募集します。

リージョナルおよびグローバルのチーム、日本のコンテンツパートナーシップチーム、プロダクト、セールスと連携し、コンテンツの品質向上、ビジネスニーズの支援、日本の季節性や文化的トレンドをPinterest上で魅力的に表現することに取り組むポジションです。

業務内容

• エンターテインメント、アート、ファッション、ビューティーなどのカテゴリや季節毎のイベントにおいて、日本のユーザーが楽しめる、魅力的で包括的なコンテンツをキュレーションする。

• 日本語の編集枠におけるプログラムのコンテンツの選定、日本語コピーの執筆、ビジュアルアセットの取り扱いから公開、パフォーマンスのレビュー、最適化まですべてを一貫して担当する。

• その他日本語コンテンツに関する各業務、見出し、説明文、記事、ページコピー、メール、翻訳資料などの作成・編集・レビューを行い、ユーザーの目に触れる日本語コンテンツの正確性、自然な表現、ブランドの一貫性、ローカル市場との関連性などを担保する。

• 日本のオーディエンスに特化したWebコンテンツやメールコンテンツを企画・制作する。

• 素晴らしいインスピレーションを得られるユーザー体験を維持しながら、クライアントおよびビジネス上のニーズに応えるコンテンツをキュレーションする。

• プラットフォームデータ、検索行動、市場シグナルを活用し、トレンド、オーディエンスのニーズ、コンテンツ品質向上や新規ユーザー獲得の機会を特定する。

• パフォーマンスに関するインサイトと編集上の提案を、部門横断およびグローバルの関係者と共有する。

• AIツールを活用してリサーチ、分析、業務フローの効率を高めつつ、正確性、文化的ニュアンス、品質、ブランドセーフティの観点から出力内容を独立して検証し、最終的な編集判断に責任を持つ。

• 複数の優先事項を管理しながら、特にZ世代を中心とした日本のクリエイター、ブランド、出版社、オーディエンスの人気コンテンツや行動について、常に最新の知見を持つ。

応募要件

• 編集、コンテンツキュレーション、出版、メディア、マーケティング、ライフスタイル、テクノロジーなど急速に変化するBtoC環境で、3年以上の関連実務経験をお持ちの方。

description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

The Pinterest Business Marketing team is composed of highly skilled marketing generalists, able to flex with equal strength among marketing strategy, copywriting, project management, cross-functional team leadership, event planning and creative oversight. Most importantly, we are business marketers, able to capture hearts and minds with engaging, inspirational work that drives business impact. Expect to roll up your sleeves, grow quickly, pivot often and learn a lot.

As an Integrated Marketing Manager, you will define and deliver our B2B marketing strategy for the Greater China Region. This role requires strong B2B marketing background, project management expertise and a proven ability to influence and manage partners towards a common goal. You will partner closely with Business Marketing leadership, cross-functional partners and our external global sales partners to lead marketing strategy that supports revenue goals.

What you’ll do:

• Define and deliver the local marketing strategy to support the business in the Greater China Region, leveraging best practices, learnings, industry trends and insights on both Pinterest and competitors

• Develop & own key initiatives that are aligned to global business marketing strategies to shift advertiser perceptions and behaviours. This includes strategies across industry marketing, owned events, content marketing, trade media and industry body partnerships, executive engagement, scaled education and success story creation

• Develop scalable processes to enable our global sales partners in the region, offering consultation and guidance to ensure their success

• Work closely with local and global teams to ensure that global programs resonate locally and meet local sales and marketing needs.

• Measure the impact of local marketing initiatives and adjust strategies as needed to achieve business goals

• Manage budgets, timelines, and resources to ensure successful execution.

What we’re looking for:

• Minimal 6-8 years experience in integrated marketing including previous experience working with resellers/agencies

• Strong comfort level with B2B marketing

• Must have proven integrated marketing experience in the Greater China region including deep understanding of local insights, media landscape, and digital platforms.

• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

• Excellent organisational and project management skills to effectively handle multiple projects, stakeholders and deadlines

• Fluency in business Mandarin, Simplified Chinese and English is a must.

• Strong written and verbal communication/presentation skills across the above languages to influence internal and external partners

• Familiarity with social media platforms and their advertising capabilities, with a specific focus on Pinterest (prior experience a plus)

• Basic analytical skills, with the ability to learn how to analyse data and derive actionable insights

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business or equivalent work experience

Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement

We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.

This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration once per week and therefore needs to be in a commutable distance from one of the following offices.

description:
Job Description

Thomson Reuters is a content-driven technology company with more than 27,000 employees in over 70 countries. It serves professionals in legal, tax, audit, accounting, compliance, government, corporate and media fields. Most of its revenue comes from recurring subscriptions to information and software products that combine its own content, expert knowledge and easy-to-use workflows.

Its "Fiduciary-Grade AI" standard sets the bar for AI used in high-stakes work: the AI must be built on authoritative content, protected by strong privacy and security, shaped by experts, and produce results that can be checked. The company also gives back through the Thomson Reuters Foundation, which supports press freedom, human rights and access to legal help, and through its Social Impact Institute.

Key Responsibilities
In this opportunity as a Deal Desk Consultant, you will be responsible for

• Be the go-to consultant for the frontline. Engage from the early stages of a deal and shape the strategy, structure and commercial approach for large, complex opportunities.

• Speed up deals. Spot blockers early, navigate internal approvals and processes, and own the issues that stand between a deal and its close.

• Coach and educate. Help front line teams understand our policies, Rules of Engagement and best practices, and enable front line to spend more time with their customers.

• Prioritize with agility. Balance competing demands across countries, deal sizes and deadlines while keeping quality and governance intact.

• Know the business. Build a deep understanding of our products and the markets we operate in across Asia and GCR, and use it to give relevant, credible advice.

• Partner across functions. Work with Legal, Finance, Customer to Cash, Tax, and other teams to keep execution smooth from quote to cash.

• Make it better. Share insights from the field, support process improvements, create feedback loops, and help roll out new policies and processes.

Required Qualifications
You are an ideal fit for the Deal Desk Consultant role if your experience includes

• Bachelor's degree and at least 5 years relevant experience.

• Ability to work in complex matrix environment. A self-starter who thrives with autonomy, manages your own workload, and keeps us informed without needing day-to-day supervision.

• Experience in a SaaS and AI enabled services industry, with a solid grounding in solution selling and complex commercial deals

• Proven experience supporting sales teams on large, complex new deals and renewals.

• Solid commercial acumen and familiarity with legal clauses with commercial impact in customer contracts.

• Curiosity about the products we sell and the markets we serve

• Confidence and empathy when working with frontline and senior sales leaders

• Strong prioritization skills and agility in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment

• The ability to coach others on policy and best practice in a way that builds buy-in, effectively evolve the status quo and enhance working practices.

• Experience in customer contracting or the full sales cycle

• Experience in leveraging AI tools, data-driven reporting and process improvement

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with SAP, Bid Automation tools like Qvidian (upland software)

• A high-visibility role supporting one of our highest-growth regions

• Cultural awareness and the ability to build trust with colleagues across different countries and working styles

• Experience with Salesforce, CPQ/order capture tools, AI tools and advanced excel skills to build commercial models and understand pricing tools.

#LI-TL1

What’s in it For You?

• Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.

• Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

• Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

• Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

• Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

• Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

• Making a Real-World Impact:  We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Job Description

As Deal Desk Manager, Asia, you’ll shape and support large, complex deals across Asia and GCR. Partnering closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Product to structure smart deals that drive growth and lasting value for our customers.

You'll sit in Singapore alongside VPs and Senior Leaders, so your impact will be visible, immediate and valued. You'll manage a small team of Deal Desk Consultants and join a close-knit team of about 10 in Deal Desk and much larger Revenue Operations team, with opportunities to grow across multiple Rev Ops functions.

You'll lead a team that helps Sales close complex, high-value deals while protecting margin, reducing risk, and drive ease of doing business for internal and external stake holders.

Key Responsibilities
In this opportunity as a Deal Desk Manager - Asia, you will be responsible for

• Shape complex deals. Structure non-standard pricing, multi-year and ramp deals, bundles, and usage-based models that win business and stay profitable.

• Lead and grow a Deal Desk team. Coach your people, set a high bar, and be the go-to escalation point for Sales.

• Be the trusted advisor. Give Sales leaders clear negotiation options and commercial guidance and push back with data when needed.

• Own governance without slowing deals down. Run approval workflows and discount guardrails, collaborating across functions like Legal, Finance, Professional Service, and Segment on contract terms, billing, and revenue recognition. Ensure Sales teams are operating within the Rules of Engagement and Commercial Policy, directly partnering with cross-functional teams to driving governance, compliance, and efficiencies through simplification/standardization/systematic and automated solutions.

• Build the playbook. Create repeatable templates, pricing guidelines, and processes that shorten cycle times and free Sales to sell.

• Bid Management. Manage and collaborate time critical bids and tenders and play pivotal role to improve the quality of tender submission and improving win rates.

• Drive automation and insight. Partner with Sales Ops and Systems teams on process improvements, and use data on cycle time, discounting, and approval turnaround to find and fix bottlenecks.

• Change Management. Coach Sales / Business Segment teams on changes in processes, policies, and best practices to improve performance and release Sales capacity to focus on core Sales activities.  Provide feedback/insights back to teams/functions that support the commercial activities including Pricing, and Commercial Policy.

Required Qualifications
You are an ideal fit for the Deal Desk Manager - Asia role if your experience includes

• 10+ years total experience, of which 6+ years in Deal Desk, Sales Ops, or Commercial Finance at a SaaS or software company.

• 4+ years leading people or teams, ideally across regions

• Experience structuring complex, non-standard enterprise deals

• Strong grasp of SaaS and Subscription metrics (ARR, ACV, TCV, NRR) with proven experience in building financial models

• Hands-on knowledge of Salesforce, and CPQ, CLM tools. Experience with Bid Automation tools like Qvidian a definite plus.

• Contract literacy and confident in working with Legal on redlines

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders and stay calm under tight deadlines

• Bachelor's degree or professional qualifications like CA, CPA. MBA a plus.

• Curiosity about the products we sell, customers and markets we serve.

• Confidence and empathy when working with frontline and senior sales leaders

• Cultural awareness and the ability to build trust with colleagues across different countries and working styles

• A self-starter who thrives with autonomy, manages your own workload, and keeps us informed without needing day-to-day supervision

Preferred Qualifications

• High visibility, with a direct line to Sales, Finance, and Legal leadership

• Real ownership: you'll shape policy and process, not just enforce it

• A clear path to grow across Revenue Operations

Business Development Manager, Global Trade Solutions
The Business Development Manager for Global Trade Solutions at Thomson Reuters is a key role that requires a highly skilled and experienced professional to drive sales growth and deliver expert solutions to customers. The successful candidate will be responsible for accumulating and sharing knowledge and best practices with the broader sales team, with a focus on complex, high-value sales opportunities.

This role will involve working collaboratively with sales executives, client executives, and key account managers to drive sales growth, with a major emphasis on opening up new business and retaining existing customers. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of the industry and be able to provide expert product knowledge to drive sales and renewals to close. This is a strategic and consultative sales role that requires excellent communication and interpersonal skills, as well as the ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

About the role

In this opportunity as a Business Development Manager, you will:

• Accumulates expertise and demonstrates mastery of specific product/content.
• Possess a deep understanding of the most relevant customer needs within area of specialism.
• Identifies how customer needs can be addressed through different product options and configurations to deliver the most impact.
• Shares knowledge and best practices with broader Sales team by supporting on pursuits.
• Defaults to engaging customers through virtual channels for the majority of deals.
• Acts as overlay support to drive sales towards close.
• Focuses on more complex, higher value new logo and incremental sales (upsell/cross-sell) opportunities.
• Works in a pooled team across accounts within subsegment, rather than account or territory aligned.
• Gathers and shares best practices across the broader Sales teams to support account/territory strategies.
• Grow sales in collaboration with Sales Executives, Client Executives and Key Account Managers utilizing specialist knowledge to deliver gross sales.
• Major emphasis on opening up new business, both within existing accounts and new customers.
• Assist in key retention situations as required.
• Does not deliver technical demonstrations and requirements gathering, as digital trials and demos become available.
• Provide deep product expertise to drive sales and renewals to close:
o New logo sales
o Existing account incremental sales
o May not be individually quota carrying, where primarily pooled across a large number of deals

You're a fit for the role of Business Development Manager, if you have the following qualifications:

• Minimum of 5 years' experience in a professional field sales or IT Solutions SaaS business development role

• Proven experience of solution selling, driving complex sales engagements; selling a solution that spans multiple departments in a company and requires their approval

• ERP selling experience/ experience with one of the major ERP platforms, especially in the supply chain module

Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Team:

The Ads Marketing team shapes our core advertising positioning and drives the go-to-market strategy to bring this positioning to life through compelling, differentiated messaging and narratives. By activating these messages across both targeted and scaled channels, the team aims to build widespread awareness and excitement among our advertisers and partners. This role will report to the Director of Ads Marketing, APAC, based in Singapore.

The Opportunity:

As the marketing manager for Export markets (primarily China), you will be supporting the growth of Netflix ads for this dynamic audience. You will lead the development of marketing plans and execute the plans with excellence, ensuring alignment with regional and global objectives. This role requires a strategic marketer with strong executional and operational skillsets. You will develop and land the Netflix ads narrative through innovation and creativity. You will also engage in broader business strategies and actively pursue learning and development opportunities, continually growing and evolving as a Netflix marketer and leader. This role will be based in Singapore.

Core Responsibilities:

• Co-develop the marketing plans for Export, from the core narrative to dynamic go-to-market strategies that position Netflix ads a must-buy platform for export clients

• Synthesize business objectives to define key audiences and optimal channels for activation. Ensure marketing initiatives align with overarching business goals through effective communication with stakeholders.

• Collaborate with data analytics teams to enrich the value proposition for advertising partners. Influence the definition of upcoming research considering the long term vision of the brand for the export business.

• Develop owned Netflix events to drive best-in-class execution in close collaboration with the events team. Lead Netflix Ads’ presence at local/ international industry events and custom client engagements, ensuring impactful representation and relevance at each touchpoint.

• Develop holistic scaled channels plan to reach the right audience, at the right time with the right messages.

• Deliver consistent updates to leadership, providing a comprehensive view of successes, challenges, and opportunities.

• Ensure transparent and effective communication with leadership to facilitate informed decision-making.

Who We Are Looking For:

• Independent, strategic Thinker: Able to translate data and insights into actionable plans for your audience. Willingness to challenge the norm and think outside the box independently to achieve your goals.

• Passion for creative, flawless execution: Have a real drive to set high standards of executional, innovative excellence which surprise and delight our key audiences. Demonstrated ability to collaborate with creative partners to generate and implement creative campaigns and manage multiple projects and deadlines by prioritizing activities effectively based on their importance and urgency. Highly organized to keep track of and manage minute details in complex projects.

• Strong cross-functional collaborator: Able to engage with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and integration, leveraging strong interpersonal skills to drive cohesion and effective teamwork

• Strong Communicator: Able to clearly articulate your ideas and plans to influence effectively and bring stakeholders along with you on the journey.

• Comfortable with ambiguity: A self-starter who is able to forge their own path forward vs. following a predetermined path

Other Qualifications:

• 12+ years of experience in B2B marketing, digital advertising or marketing communications

• Proficient in Mandarin and English

• Familiarity with China export market is preferred

• Familiarity with CTV, OTT, or streaming landscape is preferred

• You have an entrepreneurial mindset with agility of learning and are eager to flourish in our unique company culture (see Who We Are ).

Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Team:

The Ads Marketing team shapes our core advertising positioning and drives the go-to-market strategy to bring this positioning to life through compelling, differentiated messaging and narratives. By activating these messages across both targeted and scaled channels, the team aims to build widespread awareness and excitement among our advertisers and partners. This role will report to the Director of Ads Marketing, APAC, based in Singapore.

The Opportunity:

As the marketing manager for South East Asia, you will be supporting the launch and expansion of Netflix ads in this dynamic region. You will lead the development of our launch plans and execute the plans with excellence, ensuring alignment with regional and global objectives. This role requires a strategic marketer with strong executional and operational skillsets. You will develop and land the Netflix ads narrative through innovation and creativity. You will also engage in broader business strategies and actively pursue learning and development opportunities, continually growing and evolving as a Netflix marketer and leader. This role will be based in Singapore.

Core Responsibilities:

• Lead and develop the launch plans for South East Asia, from the core narrative to dynamic go-to-market strategies that position Netflix ads a must-buy platform for advertising clients

• Synthesize business objectives to define key audiences and optimal channels for activation. Ensure marketing initiatives align with overarching business goals through effective communication with stakeholders.

• Collaborate with data analytics teams to enrich the value proposition for advertising partners. Influence the definition of upcoming research considering the long term vision of the brand in South East Asia.

• Develop owned Netflix events to drive best-in-class execution in close collaboration with the events team. Lead Netflix Ads’ presence at local/ international industry events and custom client engagements, ensuring impactful representation and relevance at each touchpoint.

• Develop holistic scaled channels and plan to reach the right audience, at the right time with the right messages.

• Deliver consistent updates to leadership, providing a comprehensive view of successes, challenges, and opportunities.

• Ensure transparent and effective communication with leadership to facilitate informed decision-making.

Who We Are Looking For:

• Independent, strategic Thinker: Able to translate data and insights into actionable plans for your market. Willingness to challenge the norm and think outside the box independently to achieve your goals.

• Passion for creative, flawless execution: Have a real drive to set high standards of executional, innovative excellence which surprise and delight our key audiences. Demonstrated ability to collaborate with creative partners to generate and implement creative campaigns and manage multiple projects and deadlines by prioritizing activities effectively based on their importance and urgency. Highly organized to keep track of and manage minute details in complex projects.

• Strong cross-functional collaborator: Able to engage with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and integration, leveraging strong interpersonal skills to drive cohesion and effective teamwork

• Strong Communicator: Able to clearly articulate your ideas and plans to influence effectively and bring stakeholders along with you on the journey.

• Comfortable with ambiguity: A self-starter who is able to forge their own path forward vs. following a predetermined path.

Other Qualifications:

• 12+ years of experience in B2B marketing, digital advertising or marketing communications

• Familiarity with CTV, OTT or streaming landscape is preferred

• You have an entrepreneurial mindset with agility of learning and are eager to flourish in our unique company culture (see Who We Are ).

description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Executive Feedback & Coaching team supports senior leaders at critical moments in their leadership journey through M360 and Executive Coaching. Our work helps leaders gain deeper insight into their impact, identify the leadership shifts that matter most, and translate those insights into sustained change.

As an Executive Coach, you will deliver both M360 and executive coaching to Netflix leaders. You will combine strong coaching capabilities with expertise in stakeholder feedback, assessment, and leadership development to help leaders understand the patterns that drive their impact and make meaningful shifts in how they lead.

This is a highly contextual role. You will develop a deep understanding of Netflix’s culture, business, and leadership environment and use that context—alongside data, assessment, and coaching expertise—to support leaders navigating complex roles and organizational dynamics.

Responsibilities
The role is grounded in four core capabilities: Executive Coaching, Feedback & Insight Integration, Stakeholder Management, Decision-Making, and Practice Stewardship.

Feedback & Insight Integration

• Lead both Onboarding and Growth M360 experiences for senior Netflix leaders.

• Conduct discovery to understand the leader’s role, business context, stakeholder landscape, and development priorities.

• Conduct stakeholder interviews and synthesize complex qualitative feedback into clear, concise, executive-ready insights.

• Integrate M360 feedback, Hogan and other relevant assessments, ESS data, and real-time feedback to help leaders understand the patterns underlying their impact and inform coaching.

• Write high-quality development-focused reports that clearly identify leadership strengths, opportunities, and priority shifts.

• Lead feedback debriefs and development-planning conversations that help leaders translate insight into meaningful action.

• When appropriate, integrate M360 and coaching into a connected development experience tailored to the leader’s needs.

• Apply sound judgment about when to coach, challenge, provide perspective, or create space for reflection based on the leader, business context, and development objective.

Executive Coaching Capability

• Provide high-quality, inclusive executive coaching aligned with ICF competencies and ethical standards.

• Partner with leaders to establish clear development goals grounded in their role, business context, feedback, and development needs.

• Help leaders identify the beliefs, behaviors, and patterns that shape their impact, and translate insights into focused development and sustained change.

• Maintain clear contracting and alignment with leaders, managers, and HRBPs while preserving the trust and confidentiality required for effective coaching.

• Engage in regular coaching supervision and ongoing development of your own coaching practice.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Build strong partnerships with HRBPs and Talent partners to identify development needs, shape leader engagements, and ensure the right support is provided at the right time.

• Develop a strong understanding of the businesses and leadership populations you support so that coaching and feedback remain grounded in current Netflix context.

• Navigate complex organizational dynamics, stakeholder systems, and cross-cultural contexts while maintaining appropriate coaching boundaries and confidentiality.

Practice Stewardship

• Contribute to the continued evolution of M360, Executive Coaching, measurement, and other EFC products.

• Support external coaches and facilitators with Netflix context and quality guidance where appropriate.

• Maintain accurate portfolio and engagement data and use feedback and measurement to continuously improve the quality of your work.

• Contribute actively to a strong coaching community through case consultation, supervision, shared learning, and peer feedback.

Skills & Experience
We are looking for someone who:

• Has significant experience coaching and consulting with senior leaders in complex, global organizations.

• Demonstrates strong executive coaching capability and a client-centered, development-focused approach.

• Holds an ICF or equivalent coaching certification at PCC/MCC level, or ACC with 10 or more years of Executive Coaching Experience with mid- to executive-level leaders.

• Has experience using psychometric and leadership assessments, including Hogan or comparable tools, to deepen leadership insight and development.

• Demonstrates the ability to understand organizational culture, business context, power dynamics, and stakeholder systems—and incorporate those insights appropriately into development work.

• Builds trust and credibility with senior leaders while maintaining the candor required to support meaningful growth.

• Demonstrates effective listening and questioning skills to recognize patterns, challenge assumptions, and help leaders generate insight rather than simply provide advice.

• Demonstrates the ability to synthesize large amounts of qualitative and quantitative information into clear, concise, executive-ready insights and written reports.

• Has strong judgment about when to coach, challenge, provide perspective, or create space for reflection.

• Works effectively across cultures and adapts their approach to different leaders, businesses, and regional contexts.

• Manages work effectively, exercises sound judgment, and adapts well to different work environments with autonomy.

• Has a strong practice of self-reflection, supervision, feedback, and continuous development.

• Collaborates effectively with HRBPs, Talent partners, peers, and external practitioners while maintaining appropriate coaching boundaries and confidentiality.

Nice to Have

• Experience working as an internal executive coach, leadership consultant, HRBP, or senior Talent practitioner.

• Experience with executive assessment, leadership development, team effectiveness, or organizational development.

• Experience working in technology, entertainment, media, or other fast-moving creative environments.

• Graduate education in Organizational Psychology, Human Development, Organizational Leadership, or a related field.

• Proficiency in coaching in additional languages to support cross-cultural leadership needs.

This role is specifically to support advertisers based in APAC who are looking to reach global audiences in our 12 ads markets.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and conduct measurement studies and generate insights on campaign effectiveness that convey the story of Netflix’s Ads globally to advertisers, with a focus on reach and frequency, brand health performance, and conversion.

• Integrate measurement outputs to craft a compelling narrative, present insights independently to clients and agencies, and offer guidance on optimising their media mix.

• Partner with advertisers to create category-specific learning agendas & playbooks

• Partner with the Export Advertising Sales and Account Management teams to address day-to-day measurement requests

• Offer expert advice to cross-functional partners and advertiser clients on KPIs and measurement strategies, enhancing media plan effectiveness on Netflix

• Use proprietary and syndicated tools to create regular/ad-hoc reporting for stakeholders (both internal and external) on the Netflix Ads audience

• Manage the day-to-day measurement study process with third-party vendors from end to end including sales requests, vendor intake, survey drafting, analysis, report creation, and presentation. Work closely with Sales Account Managers to ensure studies are launched smoothly and wrapped successfully.

• Mine, collect, and retain information on trends in campaign effectiveness within Netflix and the media industries to develop and present case studies

• Support team projects, ensuring all projects are delivered on time and maintain high standards. Build and promote processes for efficient working methods across the team.

• Internal and external stakeholder management (i.e. advertisers, clients, data analytic vendors, etc.)

Experience & Skills

• 8-10 Years experience in media research and measurement at Streaming, TV, digital media companies or media agencies, ideally related to China coutbound/ Export media campaigns.

• Strong knowledge of the advertising landscape, across all media channels and methods of buying

• Strong understanding of brand marketing via media channels

• Strong understanding of media conversion measurement techniques

• Strong understanding of methodology, data, and systems from research providers (e.g. Nielsen, Macromill, Kantar, etc.) and direct digital technology and analytics

• Experienced in campaign effectiveness measurement including Reach & Frequency, Incremental lift, Brand lift, Sales lift, A/B testing, Marketing Mix Models, Search lift and bespoke campaign effectiveness studies

• Experienced in digital advertising or marketing analytics across full funnel metrics

• Experienced in insights generation and storytelling to convey audience behaviour and preferences

• Highly curious, always looking for the meaning behind data

• Self-starter and self-motivated with strong communication skills and expertise in managing larger-scale, complex projects.

• Highly organised and experienced in building and following processes to make working methods more efficient.

• Flexible and open-minded: Able to thrive in a startup environment with ambiguity

• Builds strong relationships with clients and colleagues; values diverse perspectives for better decision-making.

• Excellent writing and presentation-building skills

• Proficient in English and Mandarin Chinese

Preferred Tools & Technical Skills

• Highly preferred to have worked with Export advertisers in APAC or Greater China, or have worked with platforms or agencies in China

• Familiarity with large-scale data environments and analysis tools (e.g., SQL, Python/R, BigQuery) commonly used in global digital advertising platforms

• Proven expertise in advanced measurement methodologies

• Comfort in analyzing large and disparate data sets to glean meaningful insights

description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Job Description
The Launch Manager acts as the strategic center of every title’s journey to the members —serving as the conductor of launch excellence, a trusted expert on launch strategy, and an architect of cross-functional interactions. You own end-to-end accountability for platform launches, translating business objectives into product merchandising decisions and driving the partnerships necessary for seamless execution.

As the Launch Manager, you are the on-the-ground product expert, overseeing the lifecycle of merchandising behaviors and promotional strategy to ensure high-quality launches. You will manage the launch strategy for your local slate, serving as the connective tissue that aligns cross-functional partners, mitigates risks, and drives member value.

Across each of these dimensions, you will bring proactive judgment, clear communication of tradeoffs, and a relentless drive to surface the right solution at the right time.

In this role you will:

As the Conductor of Launch Excellence

• Serve as the connective tissue for End-to-end title and merchandising campaign launch — proactively gathering, centralizing, and disseminating the right context to keep all cross-functional partners aligned on priorities, dependencies, and decisions

• Own the quality and accountability for bringing all content to life on our platform. This involves positioning, presenting and packaging the intricate web of creative assets and aligning timelines across multiple cross-functional teams.

• Be the control tower troubleshooting high-stakes bottlenecks, and identifying risk patterns across the slate — not just single titles — to surface systemic issues before they escalate.

As a Trusted Expert on Launch Strategy

• Be the on-the-ground product and merchandising expert for Japan, translating business, consumer, and local market objectives into clear product merchandising decisions — including knowing what not to do on platform and why.

• Partner deeply with local Content and Marketing teams to architect data-driven strategies for content discovery that is optimized for member experience

• Evaluate novel and complex asks — weighing impact, risk, dependencies, and opportunity cost — and apply sound judgment on when to proceed, push back, or escalate.

• Proactively surface the real issue beneath the ask — diagnosing root causes and bringing forward solutions, not just flagging problems.

As an Architect of cross-functional Interactions

• Build strong bridges and tight partnerships with cross-functional partner teams

• Effectively communicate context, priorities, and trade-offs to our partner teams with regards to established title merchandising levers and launch strategies

• Support and influence new strategies and workflows to increase impact and launch excellence.

• Encourage and model risk-taking, data-informed decision-making, and constant innovation.

• Serve as the primary point of escalation for title-level merchandise and launch issues or failures.

Role Requirements:

• Minimum 5-7 years of project management experience in a fast-paced and agile environment.

• Demonstrated ability to translate business and consumer objectives into product strategy, with strong intuition for what 'good' looks like in a launch context.

• Systems thinker who can identify patterns across a portfolio, evaluate tradeoffs rigorously, and communicate risks and recommendations persuasively to diverse stakeholders.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in Japanese and English

• Strong relationship management and expectation-setting skills.

• Track record of modeling accountability and ability to collaborate, influence, and partner effectively with internal stakeholders.

• An earnest and inclusive team player who will be a great steward of the Netflix culture
